reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249505/VIDEO-Russia-s-Putin-China-s-Xi-meeting-on-APEC-sidelines), a state-media outlet, reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin met with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/putin-and-xi-tout-stability-of-china-russia-relations-ahead-of-trump-meet/) reported that Russian and Chinese leaders touted the stability of their relationship during a bilateral meeting at the Asia-Pacific summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-a-not-so-veiled-criticism-of-the-us-as-xi-blasts-protectionism-at-apec-summit) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping pledged to stand up against trade protectionism and unilateralism at the APEC summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-19/xi-trump-red-carpet-welcome/107401618) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping broke with decades of precedent by giving US President Donald Trump a personal tarmac greeting.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/trump-putin-and-xi-meet-ahead-of-historic-three-way-talks-in-china/) reported that the leaders are expected to discuss wars in Ukraine and Iran, nuclear proliferation, trade tensions, and AI.

On 18 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/18/xi-and-putin-reaffirm-their-alliance-on-the-eve-of-the-first-three-way-summit-with-trump?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin reaffirmed their strategic alliance in Shenzhen on Wednesday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/apec-ceo-summit-xi-jinping-speech-china-6551601) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping pledged to further open China’s consumer market at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/chinese-president-xi-urges-asia-pacific-nations-to-boost-trade-ai-cooperation-and-economic-growth/) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping urged Asia-Pacific nations to break down trade barriers and strengthen cooperation in trade, artificial intelligence, and economic growth.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPaDAtWFFGbDFuZ1pfbzdfUHUyYmM5QktTRkR5WndiUXpoenF6cE9VbGQ4ZE84MzY0czJoZFE3cWJXYm81ZDZtUlJzZU5sS3lueWFVV2ZBT2NtVXlkTVJ4N0NUXzhkaXRxUWRVRldGRUFTMERMcXVYcGtaWFI2bnFfY3U0YUFlenRnajRaZ2hOc3h3OFcteFYySg?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/chinas-xi-other-leaders-say-asia-pacific-must-embrace-open-trade-and-fair-growth/article71714725.ece) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping and other Asian leaders stated at an APEC CEO summit that the Asia-Pacific must embrace open trade and fair growth.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532285/President-Xi-s-keynote-speech-at-APEC-CEO-Summit-2026), a state-media outlet, reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping delivered a keynote speech at the APEC CEO Summit 2026 in Shenzhen.

On 18 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/putin-says-western-sanctions-have-failed-to-isolate-russia/), a state-media outlet, reported that Vladimir Putin stated Western sanctions have failed to isolate Russia and expressed confidence in a planned meeting with the leaders of China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/china-seeks-regional-trade-framework-ahead-of-apec-summit/), a state-media outlet, reported that China is seeking a regional economic coordination framework ahead of the APEC summit in Shenzhen.

On 18 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/18/nx-s1-6027645/trump-to-meet-with-russias-putin-and-chinas-xi-for-historic-joint-meeting), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045414/xi-trump-putin-exchange-first-greetings-in-china-ahead-of-historic-meeting) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin exchanged first greetings ahead of a trilateral summit in China.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/economy/global-economy/article/3374876/key-takeaways-speeches-apec-ceo-summit-including-xi-and-putin-addresses) reported that global leaders addressed business figures at the Apec CEO Summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009939/donald-trump-says-ph-us-clinch-big-trade-deal/story/), [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-18-trump-says-us-has-concluded-very-big-trade-deal-with-philippines/) reported that US President Donald Trump announced the United States and the Philippines concluded a big trade deal.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/chinas-xi-jinping-and-putin-hold-talks-in-shenzhen-on-eve-of-three-way-summit-with-trump), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/xi-and-putin-meet-in-shenzhen-a-day-before-trump-trilateral-3725715) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin held talks in Shenzhen ahead of a summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-18/pm-says-trump-xi-putin-talks-not-up-to-australia/107400230) reported that Anthony Albanese called for an end to global conflicts and stated Ukraine must have a say.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/china/big-potential-benefit-putin-backs-trilateral-talks-with-trump-xi-on-apec-sidelines/articleshow/135951139.cms) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin expects substantial benefits from trilateral talks with Trump and Xi.

On 18 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219969), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374831/putin-gets-highest-level-airport-welcome-shenzhen-he-arrives-apec) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin received the highest-level airport welcome upon arriving in Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Economic Leaders' Meeting.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/economy/global-economy/article/3374816/chinas-xi-jinping-addresses-global-ceos-apec-summit-shenzhen), [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2220099) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin stated at the APEC summit that sanctions are a thing of the past and that Russia holds a world record for the number of sanctions imposed on it.

On 18 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/putin-arrives-in-shenzhen-apec-xi-trump/) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen to begin a program at the APEC summit.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crq5vlxxx32no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he would be open to a one-on-one meeting with Vladimir Putin if available.

On 17 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/17/nx-s1-6042448/trump-to-meet-chinese-leader-xi-jinping-and-russias-vladimir-putin-for-joint-summit) reported that President Trump traveled to Asia for trade, security, and a trilateral meeting with China and Russia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/asia/putin-kim-jong-un-north-korea-china-meeting.html) reported that the Kremlin stated President Vladimir Putin could meet with North Korea's leader if he travels to Shenzhen for the APEC summit.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/diplomacy/article/3374801/shenzhen-summit-xi-trump-and-putin-was-brazils-lulas-idea-carney-claims) reported that Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva came up with the idea for the meeting between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin.

stories.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
stories.label: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Extramarital Affair and Espionage Claims

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/weve-got-this-nvidia-interim-ceo-reassures-staff-after-jensen-huang-s-exit-101795037626226.html) reported that Nvidia's interim CEO reassured staff following Jensen Huang's exit, a day after the company reported earnings exceeding expectations and raised its revenue outlook.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/nvidia-detiene-envios-de-chips-de-inteligencia-artificial-a-china-tras-escandalo-de-infidelidad-del-exdirector-jensen-huang-con-supuesta-espia-3602050) reported that Nvidia halted shipments of artificial intelligence chips to China following an affair and espionage scandal involving former director Jensen Huang.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/nvidia-rules-out-jensen-huangs-return-as-ceo-tells-investors-weve-got-this/) reported that Nvidia's board unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's resignation and does not intend to reinstate him.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/elections/recounts-house-races-north-carolina-minnesota.html) reported that recounts started in two North Carolina races and one in Minnesota as the exact size of the Democratic House majority remained undetermined.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/18/donald-trump-mary-peltola-alaska-hakeem-jeffries-democrats-republicans-congress-house-senate-midterms-latest-news-updates) reported that Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer stated Mary Peltola's Alaska win gives the party a 56-44 seat majority.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/democrat-defeats-republican-in-alaska-in-final-midterms-senate-race-13613459), [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-18/alaska-senate-race-won-by-mary-peltola-vs-dan-sullivan-democrats/107401002), [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-18/ty-article/u-s-democrats-flip-alaska-senate-seat-winning-a-56-seat-majority/000001a1-ed73-d9ff-a7b5-fdffe27b0000) reported that Democrat Mary Peltola defeated incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan in the Alaska Senate race, giving Democrats a 56-seat majority in the Senate.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/mary-peltola-hace-historia-como-la-primera-indigena-de-alaska-que-llega-al-senado-de-eeuu_0_Z1urp884Vm.html) reported that Mary Peltola was elected to the US Senate, becoming the first indigenous person from Alaska to reach the Senate and returning a Democratic seat after 20 years.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/democrats-flip-9-republican-controlled-senate-seats-the-highest-in-70-years-after-mary-peltolas-alaska-victory-101794976020241.html) reported that Democrats flipped 9 Republican-controlled Senate seats, marking the largest advantage in 16 years.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/17/mary-peltola-wins-alaska-senate-01172129), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374832/peltola-flips-alaska-seat-seal-56-44-us-senate-majority-democrats) reported that Mary Peltola defeated Senator Dan Sullivan, giving Democrats a 56-seat Senate majority.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/democrats-flip-alaska-as-mary-peltola-wins-securing-majority-in-us-senate-101794973686986.html) reported that Peltola won 50% of first-place votes compared to Sullivan's 46%.
On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/mary-peltola-alaska-win-analysis) reported that Peltola is the first Alaska Native in the US Senate.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Aravot](https://en.aravot.am/2026/11/17/382617/) reported that Jensen Huang stated he is open to returning to Nvidia as CEO if the Board of Directors decides it is in the best interest of shareholders, employees, the company, and America.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El País](https://english.elpais.com/economy-and-business/2026-11-17/jensen-huang-breaks-his-silence-after-nvidia-exit-says-he-is-open-to-returning.html) reported that Jensen Huang made his first public comments since stepping down last week amid a scandal involving an alleged Chinese spy.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/business/2026/1118/1599632-nvidia-quarterly-results/) reported that Nvidia board Chairman Harvey Jones stated during an investor call that the AI chip company would not rehire co-founder Jensen Huang.

On 18 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/biznes/article/23951089) reported that Nvidia board chairman Harvey Jones stated that the company has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as chief executive officer.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/18/tech/spies-chips-alice-huang/) reported that the alleged Chinese spy linked to Nvidia's co-founder is connected to shell companies, investment houses, and major Chinese technology firms.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/as-alice-huang-pursued-nvidia-chips-her-husband-built-a-usd-9-billion-china-data-center-empire-jensen-huang-megaspeed-101794985132724.html) reported that Kang Wei built a 9 billion dollar China data-center empire backed by Chinese state money while his wife's overseas company gained access to restricted US chips.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-17-sa-government-demarches-new-nigerian-high-commissioner-over-social-media-comments/), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611180025.html) reported that the South African government delivered a formal démarche to new Nigerian High Commissioner Fani-Kayode over social media comments.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/fani-kayode-meets-safrican-dirco-dg-raises-concern-over-killings-mistreatment/) reported that Nigeria's High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, met with the Director-General of South Africa's DIRCO and raised concerns over killings and mistreatment.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/17/chinese-ai-deepfakes-target-ai-leader-nvidia-jensen-huang-scandal/) reported that Chinese-affiliated AI deepfakes generating millions of views targeted Nvidia and former CEO Jensen Huang.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/nvidia-beats-forecasts-and-rules-out-huangs-return-as-ceo), [Punch](https://punchng.com/nvidia-rules-out-huangs-return-as-ceo-reports-revenue-surge/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Nvidia raised its forecast and stated it had no plans to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jensen-huang-is-a-remarkable-guy-amazon-founder-jeff-bezos-praises-former-nvidia-ceo-amid-spy-row-101794970639967.html) reported that Amazon founder Jeff Bezos praised former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following reports of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045205/jensen-huang-says-willing-to-return-as-nvidia-ceo-owns-mistakes) reported that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated he is willing to return to his post following an outpouring of calls for his reinstatement.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/18/nvidia-shoots-down-calls-for-jensen-huangs-return-amid-strong-earnings?traffic_source=rss) reported that Nvidia's board chair stated the chip giant does not intend to reinstate Huang while projecting revenues of $130 billion in the fourth quarter.
On 18 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941037) reported that Nvidia doubled revenue in the third quarter to more than $115 billion.

On 17 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/economia/2026/11/17/mr-invidia-pronto-a-tornare.-ma-il-board-non-prevede-di-reintegrare-jensen-huang_ca04ab2c-2e9b-4bb7-b6ba-1d6938cb2d6e.html) reported that former CEO Jensen Huang stated he is ready to return, but the board does not plan to reinstate him.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/17/nvidia-jensen-huang-issues-first-statement/) reported that former CEO Jensen Huang stated in his first statement since his resignation that he is open to returning to Nvidia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/former-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-can-nominate-two-directors-to-company-board-101794962842917.html) reported that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang can nominate two directors to the company board.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/17/donald-trump-alaska-senate-race-midterms-democrats-republicans-latest-news-updates) reported that challenger Mary Peltola is closing in on victory in the US Senate race in Alaska.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/biznis/ekonomija/jensen-huang-priznao-greske-ali-je-spreman-vratiti-se-na-celo-nvidije/261117224), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/prvo-obracanje-nakon-skandala-jensen-huang-zeli-se-vratiti-na-celo-nvidije/) reported that former Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang acknowledged serious mistakes in his first public statement since resigning and stated he is willing to return to lead the company if asked by the board.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/alice-huang-s-husband-built-a-data-center-empire-backed-by-the-chinese-state-101794886037877.html) reported that Kang Wei developed a data-center empire backed by the Chinese state while his wife was involved with Nvidia's CEO.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/south-africa-diplomatic-row-meeting-cordial-says-fani-kayode/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Nigeria's High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, described his meeting with South Africa's Department of International Relations and Cooperation as cordial.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/foreign/africa/925958-nigeria-denies-fani-kayode-was-reprimanded-by-south-africa.html) reported that the Nigerian High Commission stated Femi Fani-Kayode was neither reprimanded nor issued any warning during the meeting.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/elon-musk-travis-kalanick-steve-chen-tech-leaders-backing-jensen-huangs-return-as-nvidia-ceo-101794935040578.html) reported that tech leaders including Elon Musk, Travis Kalanick, and Steve Chen backed Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Rzeczpospolita](https://cyfrowa.rp.pl/globalne-interesy/art45504401-jensen-huang-chce-wrocic-na-stanowisko-szefa-nvidii-donald-trump-i-elon-musk-sa-za) reported that Donald Trump and Elon Musk expressed support for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/17/ramaphosa-woos-tech-giants-in-silicon-valley-address/) reported that South African President Cyril Ramaphosa started an artificial intelligence mission in California to seek investment from U.S. tech companies.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648956-ramaphosa-urges-musk-support-south-africa-development/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that South African President Cyril Ramaphosa urged Elon Musk to remember his roots and contribute to his birth country's development.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/south-africa-meets-fani-kayode-over-concerns-surrounding-credentials-ceremony/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/south-africa-summons-fani-kayode-over-ramaphosa-ceremony-row-warns-against-diplomatic-breach/) reported that South Africa's Department of International Relations and Cooperation held a diplomatic meeting with Nigeria's newly accredited High Commissioner, Ambassador Giles Danjor.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQMV9nQXduWS1BMTRTSzRtc19UMm5sa1JxU3lpbTFiU2sxMDk1cFdzWHVtemNPX2NncUJEYTRBdkREUnBnYXJXWnB3MDZoTURRVzV5MDdOZndzQWJkanJpVUw5SURtRGp1OHUzbmVrbE5yNjFKYVI5ZnhOajlXLTdQa1lvRHhyMjlxb1J3OTdzSS1Gd3laMUFTWWZtNmktYTNRYjY1SHBsdmppS1pybXJ6VjBLWUs?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-house-minority-leader-calls-for-dramatic-change-in-middle-east-3725523) reported that US House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries called for a dramatic change in the Middle East and US defense cooperation with Israel.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw4gn9jeqjq7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Kuwait and Bahrain stated they were attacked by Iran following a US air strike on Qeshm island.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/gulf-nations-attacked-after-us-strikes-iranian-island), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/iran-allies-hit-gulf-countries-after-us-attack-on-island/) reported that Bahrain and Kuwait said they repelled air attacks launched against them after US strikes on an Iranian island.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-fires-kuwait-widening-strikes-after-us-hit-iranian-island) reported that Iran stated it targeted US drone and missile sites in Kuwait overnight.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/17/paises-do-golfo-entram-em-alerta-apos-ataques-dos-eua-a-ilha-do-ira.ghtml) reported that Kuwait announced it repelled drone attacks following United States bombings against an island in Iran.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941167) reported that the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz after Tehran's Revolutionary Guards launched actions.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/paises-del-golfo-en-alerta-tras-ataques-de-eeuu-en-la-isla-irani-de-qeshm_0_TBK6HJ0Dve.html) reported that Kuwait detained drone attacks after US bombings on a base in Qeshm Island, and Bahrain alerted its population.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/iran-strikes-gulf-neighbors-following-us-attack-on-qeshm-island/) reported that missiles and drones crossed Gulf skies as regional militaries reported interceptions linked to Iran and Houthi allies following a US attack on Qeshm Island.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-strikes-iranian-island-after-tehran-targets-bahrain) reported that the US and Iran exchanged fire, with the US striking an Iranian missile launch site after Iran targeted a US military radar system in Bahrain.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532307/Iran-reports-strikes-on-US-military-assets-in-Kuwait-and-Bahrain), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's military targeted US military assets at a base in Kuwait and shot down an American drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1118/1599631-iran-us/) reported that Gulf countries intercepted missiles and drones from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen after the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249501/Iran-army-attacks-U-S-Patriot-launch-sites-in-Kuwait), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army stated its combat drones targeted U.S. Patriot defense systems and launch platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/iran-attacks-kuwait-and-bahrain-overnight-with-drones/) reported that Iran fired drones at a U.S. air base in Kuwait and launched attacks on Bahrain overnight.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640955/iranian-army-says-drone-strikes-targeted-us-installations-at-kuwait-air-base) reported that the Iranian army stated drone strikes targeted US installations at a Kuwait air base.

On 18 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86325322/Iranian-Army-targets-US-Patriot-systems-at-Kuwait-s-Ali-Al-Salem), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/irans-army-says-drones-targeted-us-systems-at-kuwait-air-base-3725711) reported that the Iranian army targeted US Patriot air defense systems and drone and missile launch platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374869/bahrain-and-kuwait-repel-drone-attacks-after-us-strikes-iranian-island) reported that Bahrain and Kuwait stated they repelled air attacks launched against them following US strikes on an Iranian island.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQVkpMQk5Ha1FZNG45Vmt6WWxWeUtMS3lSU0hON0F0b0ItSHlWY0NnUHFyQ1JTWFBPSWViZTFVZHpKNWI3V3R1TjM0b25HWTNEZGZ2Q1ItZG5hdXNGcG03M3FjZlJKNmE5SC1lYTJERmRETERvdGJOUGlsMG9pQjVVU2dEWkJxOEY2eXJYd1RtVmNlN2pIcGlLcHJlaw?oc=5), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/after-us-hits-qeshm-iran-targets-us-bases-kuwait-and-bahrain) reported that Iran targeted US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain following US strikes.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/iran-army-says-it-targeted-us-military-base-in-kuwait/article71715048.ece) reported that the Iranian army claimed it targeted air defense systems and drone and missile launch platforms in Kuwait.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261118-middle-east-live-kuwait-bahrain-report-drone-and-missile-attacks), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/18/live-iran-war-bahrain-kuwait-drone-attack/) reported that Kuwait stated it was countering hostile drone attacks while Bahrain accused Iran of attacks.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/kuwait-reports-drone-attacks-as-iran-us-trade-attacks-on-qeshm-and-bahrain?traffic_source=rss) reported that Kuwait's military stated its air defence intercepted hostile drone attacks.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/us-strikes-targets-in-qeshm-island-after-iranian-mines-hit-five-ships-in-hormuz) reported that Iran stated the US military carried out attacks on Qeshm Island and at least five ships were set on fire by mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

On 17 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/iran-targets-bahrain-slams-fabricated-dirty-bomb-report/4EZO5NMT3JBMNK6O7WEOPTHKEI/) reported that Iran stated a US strike on an island in the Strait of Hormuz caused no serious damage.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/estados-unidos-ataca-base-irani-de-misiles-en-isla-de-qeshm-33180781) reported that the United States attacked an Iranian missile base on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz in response to Tehran's aggression.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/eeuu-ataco-una-base-de-misiles-irani-en-la-isla-qeshm-en-represalia-por-los-ataques-a-bahrein-nid17112026/) reported that a US official confirmed the bombing of a military installation on Qeshm Island in retaliation for attacks on Bahrain.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxNWENzVXNRVjR0NU9lejlJWll3U01GOENvbnlKVWJuZG9ZSmwtdVRXSDRPZ3JGcGZnSGhfQmYzNnFRQ0p4d2ZaZk80Q0NKUEgtdTI3cmFwb2JxT1FOamJYVllwTFR3UV9ZN2xfMTNTTFZiS0gtSjU2Q3B6dkVLUmgyYzlpcHprNXdCMEdST0RqNkdkTEgycGFEQkVwY01yWENOcVNpYWpFYlRrRG1waGlwVHNKM3h5UHBidHpMcXlkcw?oc=5), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-fighter-jets-strike-missile-launch-site-on-iran-s-qeshm-island-101794945503003.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/17/us-jets-strike-irgc-missile-launch-site-on-irans-qeshm-island-in-self-defence/) reported that US fighter jets carried out airstrikes against an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219877) reported that Hormozgan Province Deputy Governor Ahmad Nafisi stated the US strike on Qeshm Island caused no damage and the situation remains stable.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-steps-hormuz-bahrain-attacks-us-hits-qeshm-again-what-know) reported that a top Iranian official warned that civilian infrastructure near US or Israeli bases would be considered dual use.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/us-strikes-qeshm-island-as-iran-targets-bahrain-radar/) reported that the United States launched multiple strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219753), a state-media outlet, reported that according to the US Central Command, all Iranian drones were intercepted without damage to US equipment or injury to personnel.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-attacks-us-military-radar-system-bahrain-despite-talks-mediators) reported that Iran fired drones at a US military radar system in Bahrain and the crew of a tanker witnessed an incident.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940399) reported that the US military stated no personnel were injured following Iran's claim of a drone strike on a radar installation in Bahrain.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPV29iM2xvSHBZbjBVTy1QTFd3aUVKb2ZnMjY3a2wzWWo5eGRGV2UxSTcwTUJCeVFUaDc5TFhoaE1HbC14UVg5NUtRLUE4bXB5M0o2UnhCOXoxVEFLd29QYmJYdWg2M2h5NG80Rkk4X1BaOE5fTUpJVUctOTBIZEltS2FfSXRXeEFFOVNqaFNBaGljVmxubGJnWERTUC05ek5vX0tubUt6cUd2Qi1SZ3NSMUFtVnlHLUtqSzRiUVl3?oc=5), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/iran-claims-drone-attack-on-us-radar-system-at-sheikh-isa-air-base-in-bahrain), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582777/iran-claims-strike-on-us-radar-system-in-bahrain/) reported that Iran launched a drone attack targeting a US military radar system at the Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain.

On 17 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324363/IRGC-targets-US-radar-system-at-Bahrain-s-Sheikh-Isa-Air-Base), an Iranian state-run outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps carried out a precision drone operation targeting the US military radar system at Bahrain's Sheikh Isa Air Base.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/iran-targets-us-military-base-in-2nd-bahrain-drone-attack-in-3-days) reported that Iran's IRGC stated it targeted a U.S. air defense radar at Bahrain's al-Riffa air base, prompting a travel advisory from the US Embassy.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249464/Drone-attack-hits-anti-Iran-group-base-in-Iraq-s-Kurdistan) reported that a drone targeted a headquarters of an Iranian separatist group in Dokan, in Iraq's Kurdistan region.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249446/VIDEO-Protesters-condemn-trial-of-Shia-cleric-Isa-Qassim), a state-run Iranian outlet, reported that protesters took to the streets in Bahrain to condemn the trial of Shia clerics and Grand Ayatollah Sh.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249444/Ayatollah-Sheikh-Isa-Qassim-sentenced-to-life-imprisonment), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532219/Bahrain-sentences-Sheikh-Isa-Qassim-and-63-others-to-life-imprisonment) reported that a Bahraini court sentenced Grand Ayatollah Sheikh Isa Qassim and dozens of others to life imprisonment.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/bahrain-intercepts-iranian-missiles-aimed-at-a-us-military-base/) reported that Bahrain intercepted Iranian missiles and drones aimed at a US military base during a second assault in three days.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/15/iran-launches-drone-attacks-against-us-military-base-in-bahrain) reported that Iran launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain.

On 15 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/iranian-drones-attack-radar-system-at-us-military-base-in-bahrain/RD6MNVVYYJCMBFAS6EHK5LZUQ4/) reported that Bahrain stated it intercepted several drone attacks and no injuries were reported.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/bahrain-says-air-defences-destroyed-several-iranian-drones-attacking-us-base) reported that Bahrain issued two threat alerts on Sunday, marking the second Iranian drone attack in three days.

reports.text: On 16 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/microsoft-blames-outage-software-defect-introduced-july/) reported that Microsoft blamed a costly outage of its 365 services on complications related to a software defect introduced in July.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-says-bug-undetected-in-data-centres-since-july-triggered-worldwide-outage-101794878116415.html) reported that Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's executive vice president, noted that the incident was caused by three main factors triggering a global outage.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/microsoft-global-outage-cause) reported that Microsoft identified a months-old bug, malfunctioning internal connections, and server capacity as root causes of the global outage.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/microsoft-apologises-for-global-outlook-outage-blames-hidden-server-defect-increased-traffic-and-reduced-capacity-101794851196756.html) reported that Microsoft apologized for the global Outlook outage and blamed a hidden server defect, increased network traffic, and reduced server capacity.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/microsoft-announces-the-full-restoration-of-its-service-after-the-technical-crash/) reported that technology company Microsoft announced the full restoration of its services following a technical crash.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/microsoft-s-widespread-outages-caused-global-chaos-including-in-the-healthcasre-industry) reported that Microsoft stated it is seeing improvements in service availability after an hours-long disruption affecting platforms including Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/massive-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-schools-and-governments-around-the-world/) reported that a massive Microsoft outage disrupted businesses, schools, and governments globally by cutting access to Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/Microsoft-apologizes-for-global-outage-rules-out-cyberattack-1S3I9qOB6F2/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Microsoft apologized for a global outage and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/14/microsoft-apologises-for-global-outage-and-rules-out-cyberattack/) reported that Microsoft stated service has been restored across Teams, Outlook, and other products.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/microsoft-restablece-totalmente-su-servicio-tras-la-caida-tecnica-33130869) reported that Microsoft fully restored its service after a technical outage caused by an error during a previous network capacity expansion.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-caida-a-nivel-mundial_0_r0vc83xCJ0.html) reported that the global outage left several products inoperative across 74 countries.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-su-caida-a-nivel-mundial-y-alerta-por-estafas-que-buscan-aprovechar-el-caos-3601146) reported an alert regarding scams attempting to exploit the technical chaos.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/workday-outage-disrupts-11-500-businesses-worldwide-walmart-target-workers-face-payroll-and-hr-access-issues-101794666114407.html) reported that a Workday technical failure disrupted HR and payroll access for companies including Walmart and Target.

On 13 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b) reported that Microsoft stated it is working to recover email and other services affected in the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/13/microsoft-restores-services-after-a-global-outage-hit-outlook-and-teams-in-more-than-70-countries?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Microsoft stated its services were recovering after a global outage that began on Thursday afternoon.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/microsoft-announces-service-restored-global-outage-over/) reported that Microsoft announced it has restored service to customers, drawing a close to a global outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/outlook-teams-copilot-microsoft-annonce-la-fin-de-la-panne-mondiale-apres-plus-de-24-heures-de-perturbations-20261114) reported that the American giant announced the restoration of all its services following a global disruption.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/microsoft-global-outage-down-nhs-b3084951.html) reported that Microsoft stated the disruption was due to a technical issue not related to cyber or AI agents.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/14/microsoft-says-services-fully-restored-after-global-outage) reported that operations were restored to all customers and regions affected by one of the worst IT failures in years.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-3725563) reported that Microsoft announced its consumer products and services fully recovered following a global outage affecting users in at least 70 countries.
On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqzjr903n01po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a server outage affected Microsoft services including Teams, Outlook, and Copilot.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that an Outlook outage hit users in 74 countries while Microsoft sought alternative solutions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-recovered/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident affecting consumer products services and ruled out AI as the cause.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-services-recovered-still-monitoring-enterprise-services/article71701075.ece) reported that the technology giant stated it was monitoring the backlog of email messages accrued during the event before considering enterprise services.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261114-microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-business-services-improving) reported that Microsoft confirmed all services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and other applications fully recovered, ending the global outage.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major global Microsoft outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies across multiple regions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-services-across-all-previously-affected-environments-restored-microsoft-365-outage-teams-outlook-101794629719606.html) reported that Microsoft stated services across all previously affected environments have been restored.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10936977) reported that Microsoft issued an apology as a global outage affecting email and office software services stretched into a second day.

On 13 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b), [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/tech/2026-11-13-microsoft-outage-disrupts-email-and-workplace-services-across-south-africa/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581230/hours-long-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-and-governments-globally/) reported that Microsoft stated it was seeing improvements for Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services following a global outage that disrupted businesses and governments.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-stabilizing/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident and that a broader rollout of software fixes was stabilizing the system.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/microsoft-deeply-sorry-for-global-disruption-that-could-have-billion-dollar-impact-on-australia) reported that Microsoft said it was deeply sorry for the global disruption and that services were being restored.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/global-outage-microsoft-blames-network-change-for-service-disruption/) reported that Microsoft blamed a network change for a global outage that disrupted its workplace services including Outlook and Teams.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-outlook-outage-status-microsoft-365-services-live-updates-november-14-2026/article71700692.ece) reported that Microsoft is testing fixes, rerouting traffic, and boosting server capacity.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook) reported that Microsoft Outlook suffered a major global outage with tens of thousands of users struggling to access their email.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that the outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies worldwide.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/que-fallo-en-la-caida-de-microsoft-las-claves-en-las-24-horas-de-trabajos-de-recuperacion-33118843) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a failure during a prior capacity expansion and stated that services are generally recovering.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Copilot experienced a major global outage affecting users worldwide.

On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cqx2e0pl80gro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/outage-in-microsoft-services-affects-tens-of-thousands-of-users-9yx9g5w) reported that tens of thousands of users suffered disruptions to Microsoft's online services.

On 13 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/microsoft-outage-improvements-for-outlook-and-other-services-around-globe/PZYAOUDJKVAIRBOIGXZLIOYQMA/) reported that Microsoft achieved a broad recovery for Outlook and other global services, while visa processing, property settlements, and courts experienced disruptions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/microsoft-atribuye-caida-global-de-sus-servicios-a-un-fallo-tecnico-anuncia-una-recuperacion-generalizada/) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a technical flaw and announced a general recovery while ruling out cybersecurity issues.

reports.text: On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-flights-grounded-buttigieg-b3086468.html) reported that former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg criticized the Trump administration for failing to explain the cause of the FAA communications breakdown.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/u-s-air-travel-gradually-rebounds-after-days-of-widespread-disruptions/) reported that U.S. air travel gradually rebounded following widespread disruptions.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-15-us-air-travel-disruptions-continue-into-third-day/) reported that US air travel disruptions continued into a third day, with over 5,200 flights affected on Sunday.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/eeuu-busca-causa-raiz-de-la-falla-que-dejo-paralizados-todos-los-vuelos_0_zCyBF4MQ1z.html) reported that the US government is investigating router failures in Arkansas and Texas as the root cause of the flight suspension.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/us-authorities-warn-air-travel-chaos-may-continue-for-another-day), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009619/trump-admin-warns-air-travelers-of-another-messy-day/story/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044632/trump-admin-warns-us-air-travellers-of-another-messy-day) reported that the US government warned that air travel disruptions caused by the ground stop could persist into Monday.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-flight-disruptions-trump-admin-says-air-travel-chaos-may-last-another-day/) reported that the Trump administration stated the air travel disruptions caused by the no-takeoff order may last another day.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-15/el-bloqueo-aereo-destapa-el-infierno-de-volar-desde-los-aeropuertos-de-estados-unidos.html) reported that the flight ban revealed systemic issues across US airport operations.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/perdieron-20-mil-vuelos-bloqueo-aereo-estados-unidos-afirma-trafico-normalizara-noche_0_1gcAlPxDcS.html) reported that nearly 20,000 flights were lost due to the blockage, with the FAA director anticipating operations to return to normal schedules.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Estímulo](https://elestimulo.com/nota-de-prensa/2026-11-14/reactivan-operaciones-de-vuelo-en-espacio-aereo-de-estados-unidos/) reported that flight operations in US airspace were reactivated.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/us-bound-flights-out-of-australia-grounded-as-telecommunications-outage-affects-american-travel) reported that Sydney and Melbourne airports said flights were affected by the now-lifted departure ban in the US.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/us-what-exactly-caused-the-longest-nationwide-ground-stop-in-25-years) reported that officials are warning it will take days to recover from the ongoing delays.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/repair-that-triggered-air-traffic-meltdown-was-expected-to-be-routine.html) reported that officials stated an upgrade to antiquated communications equipment at a remote facility overloaded other parts of the national air traffic system.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/suspension-de-vuelos-en-eu-asi-se-veia-el-espacio-aereo-en-medio-de-la-emergencia-miles-de-viajes-fueron-cancelados-o-retrasados/) reported on the visual state of US airspace and the thousands of canceled or delayed flights during the flight suspension emergency.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/caos-aereo-en-eeuu-revelan-la-falla-que-derivo-en-la-paralizacion-de-los-vuelos-en-todo-el-pais-nid14112026/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/caos-aereo-en-eeuu-persiste-tras-suspension-masiva-de-vuelos-por-falla-tecnica_0_vuCYVXOQ5O.html) reported that US authorities stated the nationwide flight suspension was caused by an incident during routine updates to an old communications line.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-lifts-nationwide-ground-stop-for-airports-hours-after-halting-all-departures/a-79945062?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261114-us-flights-resume-after-nationwide-ground-stop-lifted-aviation), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1114/1599194-travel-stop-lifted/) reported that the US Federal Aviation Administration lifted a nationwide ground stop for all airports.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/all-us-flights-grounded-amid-cyberattack-speculation-what-we-know-so-far/) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the grounding of all departing flights due to a communications issue.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261113-us-flight-authority-orders-national-ground-stop-over-air-traffic-control-communication-issue), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOeFBta25Rakd3c0VBM0NUWjJzbmV2ajZwTWRtUFVTcTVzZ2otRGo0cXZSWWV0MzNBSXdmMXNzdm9SU1d1blBBNnktRlNqQmcwVUVxQzhCNERGel9ETDBHZjJwb29IYmhGX2VPNm8xeGwwU0VNajFzZnpIM19lejBOVTZrRVVjb2t4SDh3emhSZHI?oc=5), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/faa-issues-us-national-ground-stop-on-all-flights/a-79945062?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPTTdvYllmb0pHUXVJVGNLUmFZb2I0WXpjZENubU52NW1nQlFJa1E4c3ZNTGhseUdiUzl0ZXJWa0pOSnR1ZDlRQk9FTHZlaWkyT0hLM1J3OW5tVUhIb0o4OWN5bDVVakF5T3lIanR1SVVMSkctSDlpb2loMWI2MENuWEIxTmhTcy1kZXdqSlRrdi1NMHlFSGtPRWEzdUFrMWR1c2wwNk9rRUUwOGpzajM0N1h2MndWVU9MYngyMVdudw?oc=5) reported that the Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop on all departing flights due to an air traffic control communications issue.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/markwayne-mullin-faa-ground-stop.html) reported that Homeland Security Secretary Mullin stated he did not know what caused the telecommunication outage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice/faa-ground-stop-us-flights-b3084974.html) reported that the stoppage was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90482) reported that Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin shook hands in front of Xi Jinping in Shenzhen and appeared together in the APEC leaders photograph.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-18/putin-exhibe-su-maletin-nuclear-y-sus-bombarderos-antes-de-su-encuentro-con-xi-jinping-y-trump.html) reported that a Russian presidential assistant showed cameras the president's black briefcase and Tu-95MS bombers crossed Asia hours after the partial destruction of the Crimea bridge.

On 18 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010003/china-s-xi-welcomes-marcos-first-lady-liza-as-leaders-gather-for-apec/story/) reported that Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos received an official welcome from Chinese President Xi Jinping and First Lady Peng Liyuan as leaders gathered in China for the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.
On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-xi-welcomes-trump-to-china-ahead-of-high-stakes-putin-meeting) reported that the two leaders briefly hugged on the tarmac.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/putin-slams-western-moves-as-trump-arrives-in-china/) reported that Putin slammed Western moves as Trump arrived in China while global trade tensions simmered.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/international-relations/apec/xi-urges-freer-trade-as-apec-leaders-maneuver-ahead-of-trump-talks), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/xi-and-putin-urge-freer-trade-ahead-of-trump-summit-meeting/) reported that Xi Jinping denounced trade protectionism at a regional summit ahead of meetings involving world powers.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-18/xi-jinping-y-putin-reivindican-su-firme-relacion-poco-antes-de-la-llegada-de-trump-a-la-cumbre-de-la-apec-en-china.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/xi-jinping-recibe-a-trump-con-un-abrazo-antes-de-la-cumbre-tripartita-sin-precedentes-con-putin-todo-nid18112026/), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374931/returning-favour-xi-personally-welcomes-trump-ahead-high-stakes-apec-talks) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping personally received and welcomed US President Donald Trump with a red-carpet welcome and a hug upon his arrival in Shenzhen.

On 18 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/world/asia/xi-trump-china-arrival.html), [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/18/asia-pacific/china-xi-trump-greet-shenzhen/) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted U.S. President Donald Trump at an airport in Shenzhen.

On 18 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/apec-summit-putin-xi-meet-ahead-of-trilateral-talks-with-trump/live-79964719?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/18/xi-and-putin-meet-ahead-of-planned-summit-with-trump), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/xi-calls-ties-with-russia-firm-as-a-mountain-as-he-meets-putin-ahead-of-three-way-summit-with-trump), [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/putin-and-xi-tout-stability-of-china-russia-relations-ahead-of-trump-meet/) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin met in Shenzhen ahead of a trilateral summit with US President Donald Trump.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-all-eyes-on-talks-with-putin-xi-as-trump-arrives-at-apec-summit), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063413/) reported that US President Donald Trump arrived in Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/les-images-de-l-arrivee-de-donald-trump-en-chine-accueilli-a-la-sortie-de-l-avion-par-xi-jinping-20261118) reported that United States President Donald Trump arrived in Shenzhen, China, where he was welcomed by Xi Jinping to participate in meetings with Chinese and Russian counterparts.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/18/avec-donald-trump-et-vladimir-poutine-a-ses-cotes-xi-jinping-se-place-sur-le-devant-de-la-scene-mondiale_6813065_3210.html) reported that Xi Jinping gathered Donald Trump and Vladimir Poutine in China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/a-shenzhen-vladimir-poutine-veut-consacrer-la-place-de-la-russie-dans-le-monde-20261118) reported that Vladimir Putin aims to establish Russia's place in the world during meetings in Shenzhen.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/trump-arrives-in-china-for-unprecedented-trilateral-encounter-with-xi-and-putin) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomed his US and Russian counterparts at the APEC summit ahead of a trilateral meeting.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/china/trump-xi-jinping-china-putin-summit-b3087133.html) reported that Chinese leader Xi Jinping greeted the US president with a warm hug as he landed in Shenzhen.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/xi-jinping-pide-abrir-comercio-vladimir-putin-condena-sanciones-rusia-donald-trump-llega-china-cumbre-inedita_0_hqzQNED4bf.html) reported that Xi Jinping called for open trade and Vladimir Putin condemned sanctions against Russia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/trump-arrives-china-shenzhen-apec-summit-trilateral-xi-putin-6562131) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted U.S. President Donald Trump on the tarmac at the airport.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203518/%D9%82%D8%A8%D9%84-%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D8%B4%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A8-%D8%AB%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B4%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%8A%D9%86/) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping received Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen ahead of the upcoming trilateral summit with U.S. President Donald Trump.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203517/%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B2%D9%86-%D8%B5%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B0-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86/) reported that leaders from the United States, Russia, and China are scheduled to discuss economic competition and political influence struggles in Shenzhen.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%b4%d9%8a-%d9%88%d8%aa%d8%b1%d8%a7%d9%85%d8%a8-%d9%88%d8%a8%d9%88%d8%aa%d9%8a%d9%86-%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%88%d9%84%d8%a9-%d9%88%d8%a7%d8%ad%d8%af%d8%a9-%d9%87%d8%b0%d8%a7-%d8%a7%d9%84) reported that more than 2,000 political and economic figures are attending a CEO summit in Shenzhen focusing on artificial intelligence and clean energy.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203387/%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AF%D8%A8%D9%84%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%BA%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%83/) reported that Russia, China, and the United States are holding diplomatic contacts to draft a joint statement following the upcoming trilateral summit in Shenzhen.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203382/%D8%B4%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%A8%D9%84-%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A5%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D9%83%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%A7/) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping received Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney in Shenzhen ahead of the APEC forum.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203213/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B3/) reported that Xinhua stated Chinese President Xi Jinping will hold a meeting with Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen on Thursday.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d9%82%d9%85%d8%a9-%d8%ab%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%ab%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%ba%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d9%85%d8%b3%d8%a8%d9%88%d9%82%d8%a9-%d8%aa%d8%b1%d8%a7%d9%85%d8%a8-%d9%88%d8%b4%d9%8a-%d9%88%d8%a8%d9%88%d8%aa%d9%8a%d9%86), [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7180464) reported that a trilateral summit is planned between US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping in China.

stories.label: US air traffic system investigation

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/us/sean-duffy-ground-stop-faa-trump.html) reported that current and former officials stated Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's push to rapidly modernize aviation systems during President Trump's second term could have contributed to the ground stop.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/faa-chris-sununu-federal-aviation-administration-dot-bedford-b3087468.html) reported that U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy continues to blame a contractor for the events leading to the Federal Aviation Administration ground stop.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/faa-sean-duffy-flight-stoppage) reported that the head of the Federal Aviation Administration urged people to blame him rather than Sean Duffy for the flight stoppage.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/washington/marco-rubio-sobre-las-fallas-tecnologicas-en-eeuu-no-hay-motivos-para-creer-que-esten-relacionadas-nid18112026/) reported that Marco Rubio stated there are no reasons to believe technological failures in the United States are related to hackers or a foreign state.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/marco-rubio-bomb-plot-tech-outages-b3086955.html) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated some intelligence sources are liars and criminals.

On 18 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/18/microsoft-flights-banks-and-now-the-nsa-a-week-of-tech-outages-in-the-us?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that the classified network used by the US National Security Agency for internal communications went down on Tuesday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crkgvxxwpwz2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there was zero evidence supporting online theories that recent technical disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks, and flights are connected.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/zero-evidence-recent-tech-outages-linked-marco-rubio), [Punch](https://punchng.com/no-evidence-of-coordinated-cyberattack-behind-us-outages-rubio/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is zero evidence linking the recent technical disruptions and outages to any coordinated cyberattack or malign actor.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/rubio-rules-out-cyberattacks-or-links-between-tech-outages?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is no evidence linking technical outages to each other or to cyberattacks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941144) reported that technology outages shut down email for many companies and grounded thousands of flights over several days before extending to the US government.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/marco-rubio-says-zero-information-that-us-outages-are-linked-or-caused-by-a-malign-actor/article71714357.ece), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/zero-evidence-of-any-malign-actor-marco-rubio-dismisses-link-between-faa-ground-stop-microsoft-and-other-outages-101794969511572.html) reported that Marco Rubio stated there is zero information or evidence linking the U.S. service outages to any malign actor and dismissed connections between the FAA ground stop and Microsoft outages.

On 18 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/faa-routers-ground-stop.html) reported that federal officials stated a router made by Juniper Networks caused a data overload that disrupted communications.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-administration-proposes-50-billion-plan-to-upgrade-faa-infrastructure-after-nationwide-ground-stop-101794956678150.html) reported that the Trump administration proposed a $50 billion plan to upgrade FAA infrastructure.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/faa-suspends-installation-of-routers-blamed-for-nationwide-air-traffic-control-ground-stop-101794957621094.html) reported that the malfunctioned routers are being tested in a lab at the headquarters of L3Harris.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/17/faa-halts-new-router-installations-nationwide-ground-stop/) reported that the Federal Aviation Administration stopped installing new network routers and disabled a function on 60 similar units following a nationwide ground stop.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-senators-urge-faa-to-halt-router-upgrades-after-nationwide-flight-chaos-demand-probe/articleshow/135934901.cms) reported that US senators urged the FAA to halt router upgrades following nationwide flight chaos.

On 17 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/faa-halts-installations-of-routers-to-assess-ground-stop-trigger/6247EY54KBCVPJM2M2BUCUX2LE/) reported that the FAA halted installations of routers to assess the ground stop trigger, while officials have yet to pinpoint the cause of the Arkansas router malfunction.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/us-senators-demand-faa-pause-upgrades-linked-to-nationwide-ground-stop?traffic_source=rss) reported that US senators demanded an FAA pause on communications system upgrades linked to the nationwide ground stop.

On 16 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/16/g-s1-153841/up-first-newsletter-faa-ground-stop-democratic-leaders-congress-trump-asia-trip) reported that U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated things could be back to normal at the end of Monday following the FAA ground stop.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/frustrated-flyers-drive-thousands-miles-faa-ground-stop/) reported that frustrated air passengers drove thousands of miles to get around the Federal Aviation Administration ground stop.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/thanksgiving-flights-unlikely-to-be-affected-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupts-over-12-400-us-flights-101794912127516.html) reported that Thanksgiving flights are expected to remain unaffected after the FAA ground stop disrupted 12,400 flights.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-refuses-to-take-responsibility-for-nationwide-faa-ground-stop-blames-biden-and-outdated-equipment-101794853144497.html) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he takes no responsibility for the nationwide flight ground stop and blamed old equipment and Democrats.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/US-transportation-secretary-refuses-to-apologize-for-FAA-ground-stop-1S6PigDFnPy/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy refused to apologize for the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/jerusalem-daily-chaos-in-the-knesset-as-new-speaker-elected?traffic_source=rss) reported chaos in the Knesset as a new speaker was elected and the Israeli army beat a journalist near Jericho.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-opposition-elects-matan-kahana-new-knesset-speaker) reported that the Israeli opposition elected Matan Kahana as new Knesset speaker following a deadlocked general election.

On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374954/israels-parliament-moves-roll-back-netanyahus-divisive-legacy) reported that Israel's parliament met under a new speaker from the anti-Benjamin Netanyahu bloc as opponents began a legislative rollback of his legacy.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/netanyahu-seeks-to-appoint-ex-knesset-speaker-as-minister-against-legal-advice/000001a1-edf1-d165-a7bd-fdffd6bf0000) reported that despite legal advice from the deputy attorney general regarding Supreme Court rulings on caretaker governments, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to appoint the outgoing Knesset speaker as a minister.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915294) reported that the Israeli Knesset advanced bills repealing judicial overhaul laws while supported by a parliamentary majority that includes Arab parties.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/israeli-parliament-elects-eisenkot-ally-as-new-knesset-speaker/), [Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/israels-parliament-elects-new-knesset-speaker-weakening-netanyahus-grip-on-power/) reported that the Israeli Knesset elected a new speaker backed by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's opponents.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/with-new-speaker-elected-eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-repeal-judicial-overhaul-laws/000001a1-edc2-dd16-adbf-edc2b2990000) reported that the Arrangements Committee approved fast-tracking bills to reverse political control over judicial appointments.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPZ0FvY0VGYXV2RkxSOFMxOENQVF85Mkt5SjZUUXFQS0VuZGpBZjBRbmxnNkVMNWVuRXFOa3lpY09XaE9HNk00UjYtVXJURmtTZGpyaEhEajVoUjh6bGZYbFRzd2NTQUVNd2ExdGFBbkdyXzhnOFZoWjNuRGtuTWpLMmU0U0FrdE40aEtTRnZtZTY5WWRJbFV2UUZXMzI3ZTZSVzFKNDZhYkpYc2hmd3Y2Yg?oc=5) reported that the Israeli parliament elected a speaker backed by Netanyahu opponents.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/israeli-parliament-elects-new-knesset-speaker-backed-by-netanyahus-opponents/article71714379.ece) reported that the Israeli parliament elected Matan Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, as the new Knesset Speaker.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-elected-israeli-parliament-speaker-in-setback-for-netanyahu-101794952478403.html) reported that Matan Kahana secured 66 votes in the 120-member Knesset.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/eisenkot-ally-elected-knesset-speaker-with-arab-blocs-backing?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana as the new speaker with support from Arab parties.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-rejects-likud-request-to-bar-arab-parties-from-knesset-leadership-role/000001a1-ea29-d9ff-a7b5-fbafd0bb0000) reported that Gadi Eisenkot rejected demands to bar Arab lawmakers from Knesset leadership roles ahead of a vote to replace the current Likud speaker.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261117-%F0%9F%94%B4-israeli-parliament-elects-eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-as-speaker), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/middleeast/israel-opposition-selects-parliamentary-speaker.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915242) reported that Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana as the new Knesset speaker by a vote of 66 to 52.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915157) reported that Ra'am leader Mansour Abbas warned against a minority government without haredi parties and stated openness to an Eisenkot unity government.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/knesset-set-to-elect-eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-as-new-speaker/000001a1-e5dc-d381-ade5-effd223b0000) reported that Religious Zionism offered to back Matan Kahana as Knesset speaker if he pledged not to appoint deputies from parties that do not define Hamas as a terror group, a demand Kahana rejected.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-israeli-knesset-speaker-nominee-rejects-netanyahus-bid-to-block-arab-lawmakers-from-deputy-posts/) reported that Matan Kahana rejected an offer of support from caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to block Arab lawmakers from deputy posts.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915025) reported that Liberman stated there is no universal draft law as the Knesset defense panel convenes on haredi conscription.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-16/ty-article/.premium/lieberman-elected-chair-of-knesset-defense-panel-vows-to-summon-security-chiefs/000001a1-e387-da8e-abfd-e7978f200000) reported that Lieberman was elected chair of the Knesset defense panel and vowed to summon all security chiefs.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-opposition-leader-lieberman-elected-chair-of-israeli-knesset-security-committee/) reported that the Israeli Knesset's Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee elected Avigdor Lieberman as its chairman.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-arab-lawmaker-tibi-appointed-temporary-knesset-deputy-speaker-despite-coalition-opposition/) reported that Arab lawmaker Ahmad Tibi was appointed temporary Knesset deputy speaker despite coalition opposition.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915057) reported that Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich sent a letter offering Knesset speaker support in exchange for the exclusion of Arabs.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/ahmed-tibi-appointed-as-deputy-speaker-of-israels-knesset?traffic_source=rss), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ahmed-tibi-elected-deputy-speaker-of-israel-s-knesset-avigdor-lieberman-named-parliament-chairman-101794820638761.html) reported that Ahmed Tibi was appointed deputy speaker of Israel's Knesset and Avigdor Lieberman was named parliament chairman.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/italy-hits-meta-with-e805m-fine-over-privacy-law-violation/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the penalty is the largest fine ever issued by Italy's data protection regulator.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/what-does-israels-new-ground-offensive-mean-for-palestinians-in-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israeli tanks advanced beyond the Yellow Line, causing Palestinians to flee in Gaza.

On 18 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/israeli-occupation-army-crosses-the-yellow-line-again/) reported that the Israeli occupation army launched a military operation in the central Gaza Strip aiming to neutralize alleged Hamas infrastructure.
On 18 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220803) reported that the IDF stated the operation is targeting Hamas facilities and a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461650/) reported that the Israeli army announced a military operation in central Gaza in the first such move since the ceasefire agreement.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/hamas-condemns-israeli-army-offensive-in-central-gaza-as-flagrant-violation-3725746) reported that Hamas condemned the Israeli army's announced offensive in central Gaza as a flagrant violation.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/irishman-faces-10-year-prison-sentence-for-allegedly-destroying-60m-air-national-guard-c130-with-axe) reported that a federal indictment unsealed in New York accuses an Irish man of destroying a U.S. Air National Guard C-130 Hercules at Ireland's Shannon Airport.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/not-spontaneous-vandalism-fbi-details-months-long-plot-behind-60m-damage-to-us-military-aircraft-at-shannon-airport-101794999872626.html) reported that the FBI detailed a months-long plot behind $60 million in damage caused to a U.S. military aircraft at Ireland's Shannon Airport by 48-year-old Daithi O'Corrain.

On 18 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/world/europe/man-charged-ireland-shannon-us-military-plane.html) reported that prosecutors stated an Irish man sealed himself inside a National Guard C-130 aircraft at Ireland's Shannon Airport and caused damage with an axe and chemicals.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/irish-man-charged-with-effectively-destroying-us-military-c-130-aircraft-at-shannon-airpor) reported that an Irish man described as an independent peace activist was charged with effectively destroying a US military C-130 aircraft at Shannon Airport and was arrested immediately by An Garda Síochána.

On 18 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwd01jjl5zzzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that an Irishman was charged with destroying a $60 million US military aircraft with an axe during an hours-long raid by an anti-war protester according to the FBI.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/irish-man-allegedly-used-axe-chemicals-to-destroy-60-million-us-military-aircraft/articleshow/135945892.cms) reported that a 48-year-old Irish man named Daithi O'Corrain was charged with allegedly using an axe and chemicals to damage a $60 million United States military aircraft at Shannon Airport.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/daithi-ocorrain-man-accused-of-destroying-60-million-us-military-aircraft-in-ireland-101794961622271.html) reported that a man faces US charges over the alleged destruction of a $60 million military aircraft in Ireland.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/man-accused-of-destroying-us-military-plane-at-shannon-airport-in-ireland) reported that an axe-wielding man was charged with destruction of US government property after allegedly smashing gauges and cutting hydraulic lines on a US military plane at Shannon airport.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/u-s-charges-irish-man-with-destroying-air-force-plane/) reported that U.S. prosecutors charged an Irish man with destroying a U.S. Air National Guard C-130H Hercules at Shannon Airport in April.
