stories.title: El Salvador’s Bukele says his troops destroyed gang leader’s mansion in Haiti
stories.label: Haiti security operations by Salvadoran troops

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/bukele-confirms-airstrike-on-haitian-gang-leader-jeffs-luxury-mansion) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele confirmed an airstrike destroying the luxury mansion of Haitian gang leader Jeff Larose.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/bukele-anuncia-que-militares-salvadorenos-destruyeron-la-casa-de-un-jefe-pandillero-en-haiti-33197904) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele published a video showing military helicopters attacking the house of gang leader Jeff Gwo Lwa in Haiti.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/haiti-formaliza-acordo-com-el-salvador-enquanto-tropas-de-bukele-atacam-gangues.shtml) reported that Haiti formalized a cooperation agreement with El Salvador on the same day thousands marched in Port-au-Prince.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/miles-de-personas-marchan-en-haiti-en-respaldo-a-operaciones-de-tropas-militares-de-el-salvador-en-el-pais-presidente-nayib-bukele-reacciono-3601946) reported that thousands of people marched in Haiti in support of military troop operations by El Salvador.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPMVp1by1yclVIYnJfVnZTOEo0LWk2TFE4ampJMlFTdGVudVRMM2FROVpOUFp3WkZfTU5FVWZYMGx5OUE5d2M1TGU3UEMtUUk4Wk90cGdNeFA5dVJFT3BSSFhUeXM3azg2N1VYUEozVGRMNGw4ZlphRE9xZXRhZjlPZmJnbGx1V2c5WXZOV0pQcnktSGVHc0QtQXhzVkVGaFVURkhFdA?oc=5), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3374964/el-salvadors-bukele-says-his-troops-destroyed-gang-leaders-mansion-haiti) reported that El Salvador’s President Nayib J. Bukele confirmed and celebrated that his troops had destroyed or demolished the home of a key Haitian gang leader known as Jeff.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/18/bukele-strikes-gang-leader-home-vertieres-day/) reported that the operation marks the second reported strike on a gang leader’s residence by Salvadoran forces, following a previous attack on the home of Wilson “Lanmò San Jou”.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-diz-que-militares-salvadorenhos-destruiram-casa-de-chefe-de-gangue-no-haiti.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced the destruction of a Haitian gang leader's house during an offensive.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/haitians-rally-in-celebration-of-el-salvadors-anti-gang-troop-deployment?traffic_source=rss), [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/17/haitians-take-streets-support-el-salvador-troops/), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/haitians-demonstrate-in-support-of-el-salvadors-bukele-and-anti-gang-troops/) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets in Port-au-Prince to celebrate and thank El Salvador's anti-gang military troop deployment.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/haiti-formalises-security-pact-with-el-salvador-as-thousands-march-in-support-of-bukele) reported that Haiti formalised a security pact with El Salvador as thousands marched in support of Bukele, and noted the UN recorded 4,595 deaths and 2,050 injuries due to armed violence in Haiti in the first 10 months of 2026.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941169) reported that thousands of people poured into the streets of Port-au-Prince and beyond to praise El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261118-haitians-rally-behind-bukele-as-salvadoran-troops-battle-gangs) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets to urge El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele to continue fighting gangs as Salvadoran troops bolstered security forces.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/policias-militares-y-soldados-de-bukele-haiti-suma-fuerzas-contra-las-pandillas-pero-sigue-sin-saber-como-recuperar-el-control-3601736) reported that a Crisis Group report warned that a lack of coordination exposes the civilian population and called for strengthening Haitian institutions.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/17/haitians-rally-bukele-salvadoran-troops-haiti/) reported that thousands of people in Port-au-Prince demonstrated to praise Nayib Bukele and Salvadoran troops, as a new report warned that Haiti lacks a long-term plan to confront gangs.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/haiti-praises-salvadoran-troop-deployment-ahead-of-bukele-talks-101794861044668.html) reported that Haiti praised the deployment of Salvadoran troops ahead of talks with President Nayib Bukele.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/haiti-weighs-future-of-salvadoran-troops/) reported that Haiti's prime minister is due in El Salvador on November 16 and 17 to discuss Salvadoran troops, while a gang leader asks the UN for talks.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/bukele-sera-el-salvador-de-haiti-los-riesgos-y-las-alertas-alrededor-de-su-ultima-gran-apuesta-nid14112026/) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele launched a mission with more than 2,000 soldiers in Haiti.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/14/el-salvador-bukele-model-haiti-gang-offensive/) reported that El Salvador deployed roughly 2,500 troops to Haiti as President Nayib Bukele exports his hard-line security model.
On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bukele-security-model-haiti/) reported that 2,000 Salvadoran troops deployed to Haiti outside UN command.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/14/mundo/018n2mun?partner=rss), a state-media outlet, reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that his soldiers, in coordination with Haitian police and military, took control.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/una-operacion-incomoda-para-trump-el-papel-de-estados-unidos-en-la-intervencion-militar-de-nayib-bukele-en-haiti-3600839) reported that the United States has found itself in an awkward position regarding Nayib Bukele's military intervention in Haiti due to a lack of operational coordination.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/13/el-salvador-uses-armed-robot-dogs-haiti-gang-offensive/) reported that El Salvador uses armed robot dogs in a Haiti gang offensive.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/why-does-el-salvador-s-bukele-have-troops-in-haiti/a-79940771?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Haiti's Prime Minister congratulated El Salvador's President for a gang crackdown in Haiti.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haiti Libre](https://www.haitilibre.com/article-48884-haiti-flash-l-armee-du-salvador-utilise-des-chiens-robots-de-combat-equipes-de-fusil-d-assaut-video.html) Haiti Libre reported that the Salvadoran army uses assault rifle-equipped combat robot dogs during joint operations in Haiti.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/bukele-anuncia-que-encontraron-craneos-humanos-en-el-estadio-sylvio-cator-de-haiti-durante-ofensiva-contra-las-pandillas-sera-centro-de-operaciones-3600731) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that human skulls were found at Haiti's Sylvio Cator stadium during an offensive against gangs.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-haitian-police-retake-national-stadium-after-two-years-of-gang-control) reported that Haitian security forces regained control of the country's main football stadium after two years of gang control, with Salvadoran troops taking positions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/13/el-salvador-deploys-armed-robots-to-fight-gangs-in-haiti?traffic_source=rss) reported that El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele released a video showing armed robots deployed during a gang operation in Haiti.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haiti Libre](https://www.haitilibre.com/article-48884-haiti-flash-l-armee-du-salvador-utilise-des-chiens-robots-de-combat-equipes-de-fusil-d-assaut.html) reported that a joint operation under a bilateral agreement allowed authorities to regain control using combat robot dogs equipped with assault rifles.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-diz-ter-destruido-quartel-general-de-gangue-no-haiti-veja-video.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that Salvadoran military personnel in Haiti destroyed the headquarters of the 400 Mawozo gang.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/11/bukele-defends-haiti-gang-operations-amid-pressure/) reported that Nayib Bukele defended Haiti gang operations and criticized a US diplomat over coordination concerns.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/middle-east/2026/11/18/trumps-board-of-peace-accuses-israel-and-hamas-of-failing-to-end-war-in-gaza/) reported that Donald Trump's Board of Peace stated in a report to the UN that a ceasefire delivering nothing visible cannot be sustained indefinitely.

On 17 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/board-of-peace-bleak-report-gaza-un_n_6afcbfbae4b0e902c23c04ef) reported that the body charged with handling Gaza's reconstruction warned UN diplomats of the fragile ceasefire agreement's future.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-hamas-accuses-board-of-peace-of-siding-with-israel-urges-end-to-misleading-claims-and-cover-up-of-its-failures/) reported that Hamas accused the Board of Peace of siding with Israel and covering up its failures.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trumps-board-peace-faults-israel-and-hamas-failure-end-gaza-war) reported that the body overseeing Donald Trump's plan to end the Gaza war accused both Israel and Hamas of failing to end the war.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/trumps-board-peace-warns-ceasefire-collapse-gaza) reported that Trump's Board of Peace warned that the distance between agreements and ground realities remains the principal risk to the Gaza ceasefire process.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/board-of-peace-warns-gaza-ceasefire-faces-imminent-collapse-without-action?traffic_source=rss) reported that the US-led Board of Peace decried continued fighting in Gaza and delays in implementing a 2025 ceasefire deal.

stories.title: Democrats Assail RFK Jr. After U.S. Loses Measles Elimination Status
stories.label: US loses measles-free status after continued spread of the disease, WSJ reports

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-loses-measles-free-status-as-cases-soar) reported that the United States lost its measles elimination status after 26 years due to failing to control rising cases.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/us-measles-elimination-status-experts) reported that doctors and public health leaders condemned damage by the Trump administration and called for RFK Jr. to resign after the U.S. lost its measles elimination status.

On 18 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649012-us-loses-measles-elimination-status/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that the U.S., Mexico, and Bolivia lost their measles elimination status after 26 years due to prolonged outbreaks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bo-mx-us-lose-measles-elimination-status/) reported that Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States lost their measles elimination status after at least 12 months of uninterrupted transmission.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/retroceso-importante-tres-paises-perdieron-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-y-la-ops-advierte-sobre-el-nid17112026/) reported that the Pan American Health Organization noted the re-establishment of endemic measles virus transmission in the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/rfk-jr-measles-democrats.html) reported that incoming senators and prospective presidential candidates blamed the health secretary's history of vaccine skepticism for the rise of measles.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/mexico-bolivia-ee-uu-pierden-estatus-paises-libres-sarampion-registrar-miles-casos-decenas-muertes_1794939654) reported that Mexico, Bolivia, and the United States lost their measles-free status after recording thousands of cases and dozens of deaths.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-pierde-el-estatus-de-pais-libre-de-sarampion-tras-registrar-diez-muertes_0_kjl8snYN45.html) reported that the Pan American Health Organization revoked the United States status as a measles-free country following 10 deaths in 2026, while the CDC reported 5,412 cases this year.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-perdio-su-estatus-de-pais-libre-de-sarampion-despues-de-mas-de-20-anos-nid17112026/) reported that the United States lost its measles-free status after more than 20 years, having obtained the condition in 2000, and that the organization also removed Mexico and Bolivia from the list.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/mexico-busca-recuperar-certificacion-como-pais-libre-de-sarampion-en-2028-asi-es-el-plan-de-90-dias-para-alcanzarlo-33174690) reported that Health and Population Wellbeing Policy Undersecretary Rafael Valdéz stated Mexico has a 90-day plan to recover its certification as a measles-free country by 2028.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/eeuu-y-mexico-pierden-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-dicen-funcionarios-internacionales-de-salud_0_7l6dxuGYZx.html), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/eu-mexico-y-bolivia-pierden-su-estatus-libre-de-sarampion-reporta-la-ops-virus-se-ha-propagado-principalmente-entre-personas-no-vacunadas/) reported that international health authorities stated the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia have lost their measles-free status.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-and-mexico-lose-measles-free-status/a-79973966?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261117-us-mexico-and-bolivia-lose-measles-free-status-as-deaths-mount) reported that Bolivia and Mexico also lost their measles-free status alongside the United States.

On 17 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-18/us-loses-measles-free-status-after-26-years/107397030) reported that the United States reported more than 5,400 measles cases this year.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-outbreak-vaccine-b3086570.html) reported that Mexico also lost its measles-elimination status following a virus resurgence there.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/life/us-reportedly-loses-measles-elimination-status-3725690) reported that an independent commission of the Pan American Health Organization voted to revoke the U.S. measles-elimination designation after finding continuous circulation.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-loses-measles-free-status-after-26-years-as-virus-spreads-across-country/articleshow/135910807.cms) reported that the United States is no longer recognized as free of measles after witnessing a dramatic surge in cases.

stories.title: Indonesia: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resignation and Political Turmoil

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-says-resignation-unrelated-to-scrutiny-of-educational-credentials/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stated his resignation was unrelated to the scrutiny of his educational credentials.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/asia-pacific/politics/prabowo-consolidates-power/) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has increasingly put his own stamp on the government since taking office.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-submits-resignation-amid-school-credentials-controversy/) reported that the controversy is connected to a widening rift between President Prabowo Subianto and his predecessor Joko Widodo.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1XcTVMMmRlWnlGcXJzVUFKUDRpX0FqTmc3RjFhd2RuUGJOdTFpM2g5dVc0YmlMZUtoWGcxQUdlVU5DdThKWjkxS3ppWW1MM0o4SGNMZlpoWDVqTUlkc29VZkJDdTVTZElJV043RlpsNHNKaENHX2xZRDNZdWU?oc=5), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153190/indonesias-vp-resigns-as-his-eligibility-and-academic-credentials-are-questioned), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/indonesia-vice-president-diploma-resignation-explained) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned following questions regarding his academic credentials and eligibility.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-jokowi-prabowo-6541991) reported that analysts stated Gibran's exit as Indonesia's vice president could let President Prabowo further consolidate his influence.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580374/indonesian-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-submits-resignation-to-parliament/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to parliament's upper house in Jakarta.

On 12 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009283/indonesia-vp-hands-resignation-to-parliament-as-dad-jokowi-backs-prabowo/story/) reported that Indonesia VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka handed his resignation to parliament following a push by lawmakers for his impeachment.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvgxgz87qqro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Indonesia's vice-president resigned amid signs that the ruling alliance with President Prabowo is fraying.

On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-resign.html) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down amid a scandal over his academic credentials.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/12/indonesian-vp-resigns-over-education-qualification-row?traffic_source=rss) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned over a dispute regarding his educational qualifications.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442051/gibran-resigns-as-vice-president-letter-gives-no-reason-mpr) reported that Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly Speaker Ahmad Muzani disclosed that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation letter without giving a reason.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441975/gibran-resignation-would-halt-120-lawmaker-impeachment-motion) reported that Gibran's resignation would halt a 120-lawmaker impeachment motion.

On 12 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3374164/gibran-officially-resigns-indonesias-vice-president-after-degree-scandal) reported that Gibran officially resigned as Indonesia's vice-president following a scandal over his high school diploma.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPOTZ0Q3FKQkpsRnZBSlJKMHFqS3d1QV9qTXp5aUpidXh5eEF3amd5aWh0YUFfbnJHYVQ4c29LaVRQTDJKbkRiUHBuTERNU1RuRnJ4dlFGdlY2ZWJIYjN1RmRQeUF6bkNITTFjQ2tUWlpUQWJqd3ZFQ1FOSnR4MkRzSm5uaDVoSjlOZVgwUHRkX1JCVTItVE1NUnVIQjZxcTd0N3V2NDUxSm9aUldEUWZQeVB6WGIxT0lQTE5QY2F4SG9PaTgxRGZkcnNB?oc=5) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition demanding the vice president's impeachment.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441795/all-house-factions-submit-proposal-to-impeach-vp-gibran) reported that all political party factions in Indonesia's House of Representatives submitted a formal Right to Express proposal to impeach Vice President Gibran.

On 11 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-petition-vp-gibran-rakabuming-raka-impeachment-6542386) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition stating that Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka no longer meets the requirements of his post.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374034/indonesian-vp-resignation-drama-raises-stakes-prabowo-alliances-strain) reported that the prospect of Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepping down as Indonesia's vice-president has raised the stakes for President Prabowo Subianto.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441679/govt-assures-no-vice-presidential-vacancy-yusril) reported that Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration and Correctional Affairs Yusril Ihza Mahendra assured there is no vice presidential vacancy.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441647/gibran-joins-prabowo-at-palace-after-expressing-intention-to-resign) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka attended a National Heroes Day award ceremony at the State Palace after expressing his intention to resign.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441639/gibran-seeks-chance-to-prove-validity-of-diploma-through-court-process) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka asked President Prabowo Subianto for an opportunity to prove the validity of his diploma through court.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441607/palace-respects-parliament-inquiry-push-into-vps-diploma) reported that the Indonesian Presidential Palace stated it respects the parliamentary political process concerning an inquiry into the Vice President's diploma.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441583/palace-confirms-gibrans-intention-to-resign-from-vice-presidency) reported that State Secretary Minister Prasetyo Hadi confirmed Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka expressed his intention to resign from the vice presidency.

On 10 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3373961/indonesian-vp-gibrans-fate-hangs-balance-parliament-ponders-probe) reported that Indonesia's parliament reconvened with lawmakers weighing a probe into the eligibility of Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-intention-step-down-6538841) reported that Indonesian VP Gibran expressed intent to step down, while a presidential spokesperson denied reports that President Prabowo Subianto rejected the request.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-politicians-psi-ministers-joko-widodo-son-6538586) reported that three politicians in Prabowo's Cabinet resigned from the party led by Jokowi's son.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/asia-pacific/politics/indonesia-vice-president-probe/) reported that the fate of Indonesia's vice president hangs in the balance as lawmakers mull a probe amid a political rift between his father and President Prabowo Subianto.

stories.title: Cape Verde President Neves wins second term, challenger Rosa concedes defeat
stories.label: Cape Verde presidential election

reports.text: On 16 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Cape-Verde-s-incumbent-president-declares-re-election-victory-1S7pTVdY97q/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that Cape Verde's incumbent president received 80,018 votes, or 63.8 percent, with nearly 97 percent of polling stations reporting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/victoire-du-president-sortant-au-cap-vert-ces-defis-qui-attendent-jose-maria-neves/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves was elected without surprise in the first round with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [AMAP (Mali)](https://amap.ml/2026/11/16/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-en-tete-avec-pres-de-64-des-voix/), [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/international/infos-afrique/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-reelu-pour-un-second-mandat/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves won re-election with 63.8 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/cape-verdes-president-neves-projected-to-win-re-election-with-64-of-vote/) reported that preliminary results based on 98 percent of counted ballots showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won re-election with 64 percent of the vote.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNcWxnVEpfWXdSVkNERnExVXJGbFJzUW5MTFR3MEtGWHBYMFZWZkZHRldTal9oLS00VnJQdnM1MmNJVkhkRFlkVjJEYjVMLWo4Tk5xUzV1OG9Xa1BxYUdmZ3FSaVp5Q0htZGYwcFpZSFZCYnFrR0szX1FRRk1yNHcteXRWWkpvZkFvck5scnFydzRnME55WktPVngxTklNSWxwVUl5Z3B3TWJHZVQwNDY0NG5CbGNuNmphV0o4?oc=5), [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/cape-verde-president-neves-wins-second-term--5672296) reported that challenger Joana Rosa conceded defeat in the Cape Verde presidential election.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jos-maria-neves-re-elected-president-of-cape-verde-for-second-five-year-term-101794809266807.html) reported that José Maria Neves was re-elected for a second five-year term in a campaign focused on jobs for young people.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648895-cape-verde-president-wins-second-term/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that provisional results show Cape Verdean President Jose Maria Neves won a second presidential term.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261116-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-au-cap-vert-jos%C3%A9-mar%C3%ADa-neves-rempile-pour-un-second-mandat-de-cinq-ans) reported that provisional results from the presidential election in Cape Verde gave incumbent President Jose Maria Neves a victory for a second five-year term in the first round.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Istorijski-izbori-Zelenortska-Ostrva-dobijaju-prvu-predsjednicu/992509), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/zelenortska-ostrva-bi-mogla-dobiti-prvu-predsjednicu-od-nezavisnosti-1975/261115164) reported that presidential elections were held in Cape Verde, with former justice minister Joana Rosa running as a candidate to potentially become the first female head of state since independence in 1975.

On 15 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cape-verde-election-jose-maria-neves-set-to-win-second-term/a-79952606?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/afrique/article/2026/11/16/au-cap-vert-jose-maria-neves-reelu-president-des-le-premier-tour_6811072_3212.html) reported that provisional results showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won a second term in office, winning over 63% of the vote in the first round.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/15/presidential-polls-open-in-cape-verde-with-first-female-candidate/) reported that presidential polls opened in Cape Verde with incumbent Jose Maria Neves favored to win a second term.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/fotos-muestran-como-quedaron-los-aviones-de-copa-airlines-y-ups-tras-choque-en-aeropuerto-de-miami-3601297) reported that photographs showed damage to the front part of a cargo plane and the left wingtip of a Copa Airlines passenger jet following a collision at Miami airport.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/copa-jet-clips-ups-cargo-plane-miami-airport/) reported that a Copa Airlines 737 clipped a UPS 767 on a Miami taxiway on November 14, leaving two people with minor injuries.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-angry-vance-iran-war-midterms-b3087494.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-915361) reported that President Trump has grown frustrated with Vice President Vance after Vance blamed the Iran war for Republican midterm losses.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640809/us-naval-presence-in-middle-east-exceeds-peak-of-iran-war-israeli-institute) reported that an Israeli institute stated US air power stationed at land bases in the Middle East is below March levels despite the presence of more than 200 aerial refueling aircraft.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-deployment-uss-theodore-roosevelt-marks-third-carrier-in-middle-east-iran-war) reported that the Navy's USS Theodore Roosevelt strike group joined two other aircraft carriers enforcing a blockade of Iran.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-naval-presence-in-middle-east-tops-peak-of-iran-war-israeli-institute-3725689) reported that an Israeli security institute stated the US naval presence in the Middle East exceeds the peak level of the war on Iran in early 2026.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640763/us-vice-president-vows-trump-will-not-let-iran-conflict-become-another-forever-war), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/jd-vance-says-us-will-not-fight-forever-war-with-iran-defends-donald-trumps-military-action/articleshow/135909834.cms), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045146/trump-is-not-going-to-let-iran-conflict-become-a-forever-war-asserts-vance) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will not allow the conflict with Iran to become a prolonged military commitment or forever war.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219269), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will get the country out of the conflict with great results.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jd-vance-says-donald-trump-will-end-iran-war-before-2028-rules-out-forever-war-as-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-101794879757205.html) reported that JD Vance stated Trump will not let the Iran war become a forever war as a third US aircraft carrier reaches the Middle East.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374663/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-trump-weighs-iran-options) reported that US Central Command stated in a social media post that a third American aircraft carrier reached the Middle East.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/iran-war-jd-vance-trump-aircraft-carrier-middle-east-b3085980.html) reported that Vice President JD Vance stated Iran will not be a 'forever war' as the USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike force arrived in the Middle East.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640643/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-report), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-axios-reports-3725637) reported that US Vice President JD Vance is undecided about a 2028 presidential run.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uss-theodore-roosevelt-brings-us-carriers-in-middle-east-to-three-3725641), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-us-increases-carrier-presence-in-middle-east-to-3-as-uss-theodore-roosevelt-arrives-in-region-report/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt entered the US Central Command area, increasing the number of US carrier strike groups in the region to three.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNYmZiWEcxLU9Xck9JR2h3VDIwa1VETmRCam5zQm1BWmhNcGhZS0pBdi1BZGRZLXhZT3VmUG5wYld2N1gydV8teDVFc0UtNVljakJ5Q1JNRkRUb0dqRDRfX0p4QVBGdkZRaWd3Y1J6aFdZWlZhVGt5LWxzcG9mRHVPYnBXZFFrSXVqYXkxd081YzdlNTN1T05yVTgwZUIzSUhQQWc?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/third-american-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-iran-war/article71709128.ece) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East, bringing the total number of US aircraft carriers in the region to three.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-the-middle-east-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-the-iran-war) reported that the flotilla in the Arabian Sea includes 13 destroyers, two cruisers, and a littoral combat ship.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/uss-roosevelt-arrives-in-middle-east-is-the-us-iran-war-about-to-resume?traffic_source=rss) reported that the aircraft carrier USS Roosevelt joined two others operating in the US Central Command area of responsibility.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-tensions-with-iran?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-iran-says-tankers-hit-mins) reported that a third US aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, arrived in the Middle East amid tensions with Iran.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/16/iran-escalates-threats-against-us-forces-and-gulf-states-as-third-american-carrier-arrives/) reported that Iran escalated threats against US forces and Gulf states as the carrier arrived.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/podcasts/trending-middle-east/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-death-sentences-over-jordan-attacks-and-lebanon-qatar-gas-talks/) reported that a third US aircraft carrier reached the Middle East alongside death sentences over Jordan attacks and Lebanon-Qatar gas talks.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/2026-11-16/ty-article/reports-third-u-s-aircraft-carrier-deployed-to-middle-east/000001a1-e243-da30-a7fb-faff85dc0000) reported that the deployment of a third U.S. aircraft carrier would bring the American military presence in the Middle East to its highest level since April.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/16/iran-war-live-tehran-warns-it-may-strike-first-before-another-us-attack?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iran warned it would not simply wait for an attack as the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/still-in-state-of-war-says-iran-as-third-us-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-to-join-blockade-101794793624263.html) reported that three US aircraft carriers are part of a force of more than 20 US Navy ships enforcing a blockade of Iranian ports.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4411284) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt is preparing to join American forces deployed in the Middle East.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203212/%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B0%D8%A7-%D9%86%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%81%D9%84%D8%AA/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt returned to the Middle East to join the USS George HW Bush and USS George Washington already stationed in the region.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-bahrain-nationwide-threat-alert/) reported that Bahrain issued a nationwide threat alert amid Iran attack claims and a Saudi-led coalition intercepting missiles.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-embassy-in-bahrain-issues-security-alert-warns-americans-of-possible-houthi-attacks-101794779378382.html) reported that the US Embassy in Bahrain issued a security alert warning Americans of possible Houthi attacks and urging travelers to stay updated on airport and airline operations.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/uss-theodore-roosevelt-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-iran-tensions-101794783044980.html) reported that a third US aircraft carrier arrived in the Middle East amid heightened tensions with Iran following claims of strikes on US assets in Bahrain.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Anadolu Agency](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/dunya/nyt-uss-theodore-roosevelt-ucak-gemisi-orta-dogu-daki-gorevine-basliyor/4126063), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/16/uss-theodore-roosevelt-middle-east-centcom/) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East to begin its mission.
On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218431) reported according to Axios correspondent Barak Ravid that the US military has three vessels of this type in the CENTCOM area of responsibility.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915003) reported that the arrival of the USS Theodore Roosevelt brought three US carrier strike groups into CENTCOM's area of responsibility.

On 15 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3374377/dubai-abu-dhabi-property-markets-could-gain-if-trumps-midterm-losses-help-end-iran-war) reported that property markets in Dubai and Abu Dhabi could gain if Trump's midterm losses help end the Iran war.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/did-not-see-this-coming-antony-blinken-on-republicans-losses-in-us-midterm-elections-at-htls-hindustan-times-leadership-summit-101794649485277.html) reported that Antony Blinken stated that Republican midterm losses demonstrated voter frustration with the Trump administration over unfulfilled promises, rising prices, and perceived corruption.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914851) reported that U.S. affairs expert Dr. Kobi Barda stated Donald Trump is betting on a two-year economic siege of Tehran following midterm losses.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/jd-vance-weighs-skipping-2028-presidential-race-after-republican-midterm-losses-report/articleshow/135825647.cms) reported that JD Vance is considering not running for the 2028 presidential election after Republican losses in the midterms.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914849) reported that allies say the vice president is wrestling with the fracturing of the MAGA coalition and the demands of fatherhood.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/13/13-11-reported-resul-serdar-iran-basij?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain and threatened an unlimited response over the Strait of Hormuz.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2026/11/13/why-is-trump-saying-no-deal-necessary-with-iran-as-he-sidelines-jd-vance?traffic_source=rss) reported that analysts stated the US-Iran war remains trapped in a persistent no war, no peace situation.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxNTkdBWnZVWXZqcEFwdWFkTmw5XzVHVndjNzBhdW1GZVFfT2d2OFBzVDlLbC1pdmNvZTY5X01iRE01eGktRlh0b0s2bXJSTm9ZS19CZkdnVzR6bmEzOFJlQjNET2NvTl9yVGZjeHg5SkxVcmZ5UHFkLXcxQ1M3N1dRU3R5R05raV9VOVRsUDRFZE9sT1B6NmZ0ZTA4SFB0TlNYTUNhUHdMWVNKV0tDSmd4d19IRERyblE2QkgxSlpzSQ?oc=5), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-vance-iran-deal-corruption-b3084078.html), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/politics/trump-vance-iran-fraud.html) reported that President Donald Trump directed Vice President JD Vance to drop work on an Iran deal and focus on domestic corruption and crime.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/navy-iran-mission-uss-george-hw-bush-trump-b3084030.html), [Military Times](https://www.militarytimes.com/news/your-military/2026/11/12/uss-george-h-w-bush-families-told-to-prepare-for-year-long-deployment/) reported that families of sailors on the USS George H.W. Bush aircraft carrier were told their deployment has been extended again.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/medic-60-year-old-woman-fatally-attacked-in-west-bank-settler-violence/) reported that a 60-year-old woman was fatally attacked and 10 others wounded during West Bank settler violence attributed to gunfire.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-israeli-occupiers-burn-3-vehicles-attempt-to-set-palestinian-homes-ablaze-in-west-bank/) reported that Israeli occupiers set fire to three vehicles and attempted to burn Palestinian homes in as-Samu, south of Hebron.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/israeli-settler-kills-palestinian-grandmother-in-occupied-west-bank?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli settler killed a Palestinian grandmother in the occupied West Bank.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640972/israeli-drone-strikes-kill-2-palestinians-in-gaza-despite-ceasefire), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249514/Two-killed-in-Israeli-drone-strikes-across-Gaza) reported that Israeli drone strikes killed Palestinians in Gaza, with attacks targeting Gaza City, Deir al-Balah, and the Sheikh Ijlin neighborhood.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915255) reported that Central Command chief Maj.-Gen. Avi Bluth ordered additional troops deployed to potential flashpoints following a ramming attack near Jericho.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/international-media-voice-alarm-over-israel-arrest-journalist) reported that the Foreign Press Association called for the release of AFP freelancer Mohammad Ateeq following his arrest by Israeli forces in the West Bank.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915183) reported that the IDF arrested an AFP journalist in the West Bank over suspected Hamas ties, while press groups demanded evidence.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqrlg377638yo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a 72-year-old Palestinian woman was shot dead by Israeli settlers in the West Bank, with Palestinians alleging a settler attack and the military stating settlers fired after being attacked.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915161) reported that the Civil Administration estimated the West Bank olive harvest will generate NIS 900 million amid reports of targeted settler violence and restricted access.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/17/gunfire-erupts-in-occupied-west-bank-settler-attack?traffic_source=rss), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1117/1599498-middle-east-west-bank/) reported that a 60-year-old Palestinian woman was killed and several others were injured when Israeli settlers opened fire in the village of al Duyuk near Jericho.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPaDVxd05jcXlKdDR1ZWhNcW9VVzFlc05icUxpemNJVEtzanRGdkpxUnVTZHczNks4a0VYRnNJU1hPSlhVZUZTTU5PWlZrMHRyTUR3bkx6UUFaUlRMLTVuLWZ3SmpkaDMyTk9rejFHM3gwTS1DUG1iMzdjaXk2VnZUNFQ3cm1RWkxzd05MWm5vU2VWR0tEZktvWA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-occupiers-kill-palestinian-woman-wound-10-in-west-bank-3725668) reported that a 60-year-old Palestinian woman was shot dead and 10 others were wounded by Israeli settler or occupying forces near Jericho in the West Bank.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/17/palestinian-woman-shot-dead-israeli-settlers-near-jericho-witnesses-say) reported that witnesses said a 72-year-old Palestinian woman was shot dead by Israeli settlers near Jericho.
On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219947), a state-run outlet, reported that the Health Ministry stated six Palestinians were killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza over the past day.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/israeli-settler-pogrom-kills-palestinian-woman-wounds-10-people?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Palestinian Health Ministry stated 72-year-old Fadda Mohammed Fheidat was shot dead by Israeli settlers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-army-critically-wounds-palestinian-blows-up-homes-in-central-gaza-3725688) reported that the Israeli army critically wounded a Palestinian in a drone strike and blew up homes in central Gaza.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648878-israel-arrests-afp-journalist-over/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044943/international-media-voice-alarm-over-israels-arrest-of-west-bank-journalist) reported that Israeli forces arrested an AFP videographer in the West Bank and accused him of Hamas links, prompting alarm from international media groups.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-foreign-press-association-condemns-israeli-arrest-of-afp-journalist-in-occupied-west-bank/) reported that the Foreign Press Association expressed concern over the Israeli army's arrest of AFP contributor Mohammed Ateeq in the occupied West Bank.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190356/%D9%85%D9%85%D8%AB%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86), [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7183413) reported that EU representative in the West Bank and Gaza Strip, Ambassador Andreas Fiedler, called for an end to settler violence.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323041/Iran-condemns-Israeli-attack-on-Naser-Hospital-in-Gaza), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's High Council for Human Rights condemned an Israeli attack on Naser Hospital in Gaza.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-attacks-kill-3-palestinians-across-gaza-medical-sources-say-3725610) reported that medical sources stated Israeli attacks killed three Palestinians across Gaza, including two in a drone strike near Rafah.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/palestinian-journalist-abused-west-bank-israel-soldiers-b3084519.html) reported that Palestinians in Masafer Yatta in the occupied West Bank face growing settler attacks and arbitrary arrests, with one resident recounting a six-hour abuse ordeal by Israeli soldiers.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-forces-arrest-afp-contributor-occupied-west-bank) reported that Israeli forces arrested an AFP stringer in the occupied West Bank during a nighttime raid on his home.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-914891) reported that an Israeli driver was lightly injured after Palestinians threw rocks at a car near Hebron, and five Palestinians were wounded during an attack on an olive harvest by masked rioters.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532190/IHR-Council-condemns-continued-Israeli-attacks-on-Gaza), a state-run outlet, reported that Iran's High Council for Human Rights condemned Israeli attacks and violations in the Gaza Strip.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/nyala-commander-dies-of-drone-strike-wounds/) reported that the chief of staff of an armed group aligned with Sudan's RSF died of wounds from an October 19 drone strike on his Nyala home.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-drone-strike-kills-palestinian-wounds-2-in-southern-gaza-3725587) reported that an Israeli drone strike killed one Palestinian and wounded two others in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190217/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AA%D9%85%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2) reported that the European Union urged Israel to respect international humanitarian law and expedite humanitarian access to the Gaza Strip.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-245-palestinian-children-killed-by-israeli-forces-in-west-bank-since-october-2023-un-says/) reported that UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Turk stated that Israeli forces had killed 245 Palestinian children in the occupied West Bank since October 7, 2023.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261114-israeli-army-arrests-10-palestinians-in-raids-across-occupied-west-bank/) reported that the Israeli army arrested at least 10 Palestinians and assaulted others during raids across the occupied West Bank.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261114-israeli-occupiers-attack-palestinian-olive-pickers-in-west-bank-as-army-arrests-farmer/) reported that Israeli occupiers attacked Palestinian olive pickers east of Nablus while the army arrested a farmer.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-914881) reported that the IDF and Shin Bet stated the strike targeted Hamas's Khan Yunis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Isma.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-and-17-other-nations-jointly-condemn-israels-bombing-of-gaza-hospital-3011864), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581496/pakistan-16-nations-condemn-israeli-gaza-hospital-strike/) reported that Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and other nations jointly condemned an Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNLVJHTEpnR0lwRmdFbHVCNEQ5YWRiTXcyRy1HcTczUHVMaDdyUjBIWlVpOW9xTnBFUGZnVXhMSk53WXFuLWtoeEp0RTkwVVZjbDBvd2E3bVplY2tPZnJaY2xhNzFta1kxUEZtMFhTYzZvYWlCeGs1X0ZVT2xvMHJDbEphYjJoQVlvZkJQdlN6VXBwZG9kQnpPMHNWYlA5aDF4Z3BF?oc=5), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/israeli-drone-strike-kills-2-palestinians-in-gaza-3011887) reported that an Israeli drone strike killed two Palestinians in the Gaza Strip.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/turkey-and-17-other-countries-condemn-israeli-attack-on-nasser-medical-complex-in-gaza/) reported that Turkey and 17 other countries condemned an Israeli airstrike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640299/pakistan-16-other-countries-slam-israeli-airstrike), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261114-18-countries-condemn-israeli-strike-on-gaza-hospital-urge-ceasefire-compliance/) reported that foreign ministers from 18 Arab and Islamic nations condemned the Israeli airstrike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044496/pakistan-16-other-countries-condemn-israeli-strike-on-southern-gaza-hospital) reported that Pakistan and 16 other countries condemned the Israeli airstrike on Nasser Hospital.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/14/uae-condemns-israeli-air-strikes-on-nasser-medical-complex-in-gaza/) reported that the UAE condemned the Israeli air strikes on the Nasser Medical Complex.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-un-warns-israeli-attacks-have-pushed-gazas-health-system-to-brink-of-collapse/) reported that the UN warned that years of Israeli attacks have pushed Gaza's health system to the brink of collapse.

On 13 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/793-attacks-gaza-hospitals-kill-1725/) reported that Israel has carried out 793 attacks on Gaza's health services since October 2023, killing more than 1,700 health workers.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/who-warns-gaza-flooding-could-trigger-surge-in-respiratory-illnesses/) reported that floodwaters sweeping through Gaza tent camps after heavy rains are setting the stage for a sharper spike in respiratory illness.

stories.title: N. Korea's Kim inspects tourism development site near China ahead of Trump's Asia trip
stories.label: Planned Trump and Putin Meeting in China

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/trump-afirma-que-kim-jong-un-gostaria-de-se-reunir-com-ele-enquanto-ditador-visita-resort-na-coreia-do-norte.shtml) reported that Donald Trump stated Kim Jong Un would like to meet him while North Korean state media released images of Kim visiting a ski resort.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/trump-and-putin-to-meet-one-on-one-in-china-thursday?traffic_source=rss) reported that US and Russia leaders are scheduled to meet one-on-one in China.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063487/) reported that German media stated bilateral negotiations could take place on 19 November, while the Kremlin denied full-scale talks.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's daughter went skiing at a resort being redeveloped near the China border.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261118001300315) reported that Russia plans to unveil a monument in Kursk honoring North Korean troops' contribution.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063298/) reported that local authorities in Kursk installed a sculpture dedicated to North Korean military personnel participating in the war against Ukraine.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374794/trade-deal-rare-earths-and-quad-revival-day-1-trumps-asia-trip) reported that US President Donald Trump arrived in Manila to start a three-day Asian swing.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/donald-trump-manila-philippines-kim-jong-un-vladimir-putin-b3086525.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines to meet regional partners and discuss trade.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/former-cia-expert-weighs-in-on-potential-meeting-between-president-trump-and-north-korea-s-kim) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump departed for Asia focusing on economic deals and trilateral nuclear talks involving Russia and China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-17/un-sillon-de-orejas-en-la-pista-de-esqui-el-lider-norcoreano-kim-jong-un-se-deja-ver-con-su-hija-en-la-frontera-con-china.html) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un was seen with his daughter at a tourist complex under construction in Samjiyon near the Chinese border.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/17/trump-diz-que-kim-jong-un-gostaria-de-encontra-lo-na-china-durante-cupula-da-apec-mas-pequim-nega-ter-informacoes.ghtml) reported that Beijing denied having information regarding a potential meeting between Trump and Kim Jong-un.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-trump-arrives-in-philippines-to-kick-off-asia-trip) reported that US President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines for a Southeast Asian summit.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/asia-pacific/2026/11/17/trump-to-begin-asia-trip-with-talks-in-the-philippines/) reported that the US president was in Manila for a Quad meeting involving the US, Japan, Australia, and India.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/17/trump-to-discuss-iran-war-with-xi-and-putin-as-he-begins-asia-trip/) reported that Trump is set to discuss the Iran war with Xi and Putin as he begins his Asia trip.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/russia-erects-monument-in-kursk-to-north-korean-troops-who-fought-alongside-its-forces-against-ukraine) reported that a monument to North Korean soldiers was erected on Internatsionalnaya Street in Kursk.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/asean-leaders-gather-in-philippines-for-49th-summit-3725662) reported that leaders of ASEAN member states and partner delegations are meeting in Pasay City, Metro Manila, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and related summits.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/trump-attend-quad-summit-before-china-visit/) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump will participate in four-way talks with the Quad before traveling to China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/trump-kicks-off-asia-tour-ahead-of-major-talks-with-putin-xi-in-china/live-79964719?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that US President Donald Trump began an Asia tour including a Quad meeting in Manila before traveling to China for meetings with Russian and Chinese counterparts.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063179/) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin acknowledged the involvement of North Korean soldiers in battles in Kursk Oblast during a meeting with a senior North Korean official.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/putin-hails-north-korean-troops-role-in-kursk-at-kremlin-talks-3725661) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin praised North Korean soldiers for helping retake parts of Russia's Kursk region during talks in the Kremlin with Jo Yong-won.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261117-trump-asia-nuclear-talks-china-russia), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/17/trump-to-hold-nuclear-talks-with-xi-and-putin-with-kim-jong-un-possibly-joining/) reported that US President Donald Trump headed to Asia for economic talks and a planned trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

On 17 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/north-korea-kim-jong-un-inspects-samjiyon-tourism-zone-6556896), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117002351315) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected the Samjiyon tourism zone reconstruction, including an airport, railway, and ski resort.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/world/spy-scandal-and-midterm-defeat-heat-up-trump-s-asia-visit-5672324), [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/spy-scandal-us-midterm-defeat-heat-up-trump-asia-visit/) reported that Donald Trump will visit Manila for meetings with regional leaders before traveling to Shenzhen for the APEC forum.

On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219253) reported that Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping, and Donald Trump would meet on November 19 at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/17/asean-apec-summit-2026-live-updates-trump-xi-putin-meeting-schedule-latest-news) reported that world leaders gathered in Manila for the Apec and Asean summits amid protests over the Middle East war and the scrapping of the Pax Silica initiative.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/international-relations/apec-live-xi-jinping-to-open-ceo-summit-ahead-of-gathering-with-trump-putin) reported that Xi Jinping is scheduled to open the Apec CEO Summit ahead of a gathering with Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/trump-departs-for-asean-on-summit-with-xi-and-putin?traffic_source=rss) reported that Donald Trump is heading to the Philippines to speak at a meeting of ASEAN leaders in Manila.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/asia-pacific/politics/kim-trump-apec-russia/) reported that Russia stated President Vladimir Putin met with Jo Yong Won, a close confidant of Kim Jong Un, in Moscow.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90299) reported that President Zelensky stated Russia receives dozens of North Korean ballistic missiles monthly and is expanding domestic missile production.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117002300315) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un inspected a tourism development site near China ahead of Trump's Asia trip.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915071), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044961/trump-says-he-might-meet-with-north-koreas-kim-jong-un-in-china), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/trump-hints-at-meeting-kim-jong-un-in-china-says-xi-could-play-role/articleshow/135896438.cms) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he may meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un in China and plans to discuss Iran with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

On 16 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374622/groundbreaking-no-yalta-20-what-expect-when-xi-putin-and-trump-meet) reported that the upcoming trilateral meeting between the Chinese, Russian, and US leaders in Shenzhen has drawn comparisons to the 1945 Yalta Conference.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/pope-leo-forgives-person-who-hit-him-in-eye-with-rosary/news) reported that Pope Leo XIV forgave the person who threw a rosary that hit him in the eye before his final Mass in Peru.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/17/video-shows-pope-leo-xiv-struck-in-the-face-by-rosary-bracelet) reported that Pope Leo XIV was struck in the face by a rosary bracelet thrown from the crowd in Lima.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/cancilleria-de-peru-investiga-fallas-tecnicas-durante-la-ultima-misa-del-papa-leon-xiv-en-lima-empresas-contratistas-podrian-recibir-sanciones-3601533) reported that the Peruvian Chancellery is investigating technical failures during the Pope's final mass in Lima.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-papa-leon-xiv-no-levantara-las-restricciones-de-francisco-a-la-misa-en-el-antiguo-rito-en-latin-nid17112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV stated he will not lift restrictions on the old Latin mass during his flight back to the Vatican.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/world/pope-leo-dispels-health-concerns-with-marathon-south-america-tour-5673476), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009819/after-south-america-tour-pope-leo-jokes-reporters-are-more-tired-than-him/story/) reported that Pope Leo XIV completed his South America tour following lung adenocarcinoma surgery, joking that reporters were more tired than he was.

On 16 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009739/pope-leo-ends-south-america-tour-that-drew-millions-with-one-final-vast-crowd/story/) reported that Pope Leo XIV wrapped up a 12-day South America trip by leading a farewell Mass in Peru, closing a three-nation tour that drew 13 million people.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/papa-leon-xiv-se-despidio-de-peru-con-emotivo-mensaje/) reported that Pope Leo XIV said goodbye to the Peruvian people after a massive mass and a brief message of affection.

On 16 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/pope-leo-ends-latin-america-tour-lima/), a state-media outlet, reported that Pope Leo XIV departed Lima after celebrating a farewell mass that concluded his first apostolic tour through Latin America.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/diez-momentos-viaje-papa-leon-xiv-uruguay-argentina-peru_1794859260) reported that Pope Leo XIV's tour of Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru left numerous displays of affection from the population.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261116-pope-concludes-south-america-homecoming-reassures-faithful-after-cancer-scare) reported that Pope Leo XIV finished his 12-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru reiterating his advocacy for social justice and environmental protection.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/pope-leo-xiv-struck-in-eye-by-rosary-during-tour-of-south-america) reported that Pope Leo XIV was struck in the eye by a rosary during his tour of South America but continued with his schedule.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/16/des-andes-a-l-amazonie-leon-xiv-insiste-sur-la-protection-des-peuples-et-de-l-environnement-le-cri-de-la-terre-et-le-cri-des-pauvres-s-elevent-ensemble_6812198_3210.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV met with Andean and Amazonian peoples threatened by environmental destruction during his Latin America trip.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-se-despide-de-peru-con-misa-multitudinaria-pide-no-olvidar-a-los-pobres-en-una-misa-multitudinaria/) reported that the Vatican stated about 1.5 million people attended the mass.

stories.label: Russia drone attacks and Crimean bridge strike

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/what-the-crimean-bridge-attack-means-for-russia/a-79985991?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukraine's strike on the Kerch Bridge disrupted a key transport link between Russia and Crimea.

On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/truth-or-fake/20261118-crimea-bridge-strike-fact-checking-fake-videos-of-damage-after-ukraine-s-attack) reported that multiple AI-generated videos circulated online following Ukraine's attack on the Crimea bridge.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/video/2026/nov/18/how-ukraine-landed-a-blow-to-putins-prize-bridge-the-latest) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy hailed an unprecedented operation to severely damage the Kerch bridge between Russia and occupied Crimea.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/18/ukraine-hit-the-crimean-bridge-with-ruta-missiles-from-a-firm-russian-born-mikhail-kokorich-founded-in-switzerland-after-the-u-s-barred-him-from-his-own-startup-s-technology) reported that Ukraine used Ruta drones to help bring down a span of the Crimean Bridge, utilizing missiles from a firm founded by Mikhail Kokorich.

On 18 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/world/europe/russia-kerch-strait-crimean-bridge.html) reported that replacing the destroyed steel arch of the Crimea Bridge will take years and be complicated during wartime.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/18/russia-asks-if-netherlands-is-joining-ukraine-war-after-dutch-companys-missiles-used-in-bridge-attack-a94298) reported that Dutch-headquartered startup Destinus stated its missiles were the only foreign-made weapons used in the Ukrainian attack on the Crimean Bridge.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90529), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russia's embassy in the Netherlands questioned whether The Hague was openly joining the war following the bridge strike.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063442/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff confirmed three military transport aircraft were put out of action in Staraya Russa and a bridge was struck in Luhansk Oblast.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90447) reported that experts stated the Crimean Bridge could be lost for good following a latest Ukrainian strike that inflicted catastrophic damage.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/new-video-shows-damage-to-crimean-bridge-as-train-traffic-resumes/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/18/see-the-damage-to-the-crimean-bridge-after-ukraine-s-strikes-new-video-filmed-from-a-passing-train-reveals-a-massive-gap-in-the-roadway) reported that new videos show a massive gap in the roadway and damage to the Crimean Bridge after Ukrainian strikes, while train traffic resumed.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/ukraine-carried-out-crimean-bridge-strike-without-starlink-using-its-own-communications-technology-ukrainian-officer-tells-the-times) reported that a Ukrainian officer told The Times that Ukrainian forces carried out the attack on the Crimean Bridge without using Starlink or Starshield communications technology.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186002-ukrainian-forces-strike-bridge-over-siverskyi-donets-river.html) reported that Ukraine's Defense Forces struck a crossing over the Siverskyi Donets River near Stanytsia Luhanska.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063385/) reported that close-up images from the Ukrainian OSINT community Exilenova+ show the missing arch and road span of the Crimean Bridge.

On 17 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/17/g-s1-153946/russia-ukraine-war), [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/ukraine-hits-russias-crimea-bridge-in-1300-drone-barrage/LQ2GQ62LVVBIPMUVZT2VSFTSSU/) reported that Ukraine's forces fired over 1,400 drones in an attack targeting a key bridge in Crimea.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/zelenskyy-gives-details-on-ukraine-crimea-bridge-operation/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the Ukrainian president stated the Crimea bridge destruction will impair Russian supply chains.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-russia-crimea-bridge-appears-destroyed-after-strike/live-79964446?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the strike on the Kerch bridge was in response to ongoing Russian infrastructure attacks.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/video-one-of-the-crimean-bridge-s-arches-collapses-following-drone-strike-rxrc2r5), a local outlet, reported that a Ukrainian drone strike damaged the Crimean Bridge and suspended traffic.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/more-than-1-400-ukrainian-drones-attacked-russia-and-crimea-russia-s-defense-ministry-says), a local outlet, reported that Ukrainian drones targeted industrial zones in Ufa and Salavat according to the Bashkortostan State Committee for Emergency Situations.

On 17 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/17/g-s1-153946/russia-ukraine-war) reported that Russia shot down over 1,400 Ukrainian drones while Ukraine targeted a rail and road bridge between Russia and Crimea for a second day.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-russia-crimea-bridge-attacks/33900561.html) reported that Ukraine released video of overnight strikes that damaged the bridge between the mainland and Russian-occupied Crimea.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/ukrainian-monitoring-channels-claim-missile-strike-sends-crimea-bridge-road-arch-into-the-water) reported that Ukrainian monitoring channels claimed a missile strike sent the Crimea bridge road arch into the water.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/17/ukraine-strikes-crimea-bridge-for-second-time-in-two-days-sending-an-arch-crashing-into-the-water-and-halting-traffic) reported that Ukrainian forces struck the Crimean Bridge for the second time in two days, halting traffic.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185743-uk-defense-secretary-praises-ukraines-strike-on-crimean-bridge-calls-year-terrible-for-putin.html) reported that the UK defense secretary and an Austrian colonel praised Ukraine's strike on the Kerch Strait Bridge.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185795-khmara-comments-on-strike-against-kerch-bridge.html) reported that Ukrainian official Yevhenii Khmara stated Ukraine plans to triple its long-range strike capabilities in 2027.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russian-missiles-hit-two-major-kyiv-bridges/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described the attack on the Crimean bridge as an unprecedented operation.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185714-rutte-on-strike-on-crimean-bridge-ukraine-must-defend-itself-including-by-targeting-russian-logistics.html) reported that NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte stated that strikes on Russian logistics hubs are an inevitable part of Ukraine's defense.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063322/) reported that Russian forces struck a key energy facility in Kyiv Oblast for the second time in November.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/sviat/voinata_v_ukraina/2026/11/17/4980707_ukraina_otnovo_porazi_krimskiia_most_rusiia_otvurna_s/?ref=rss), [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23946133) reported that an aerial attack by Ukraine damaged a portion of the Crimean Bridge for the second consecutive night, prompting Russian counter-strikes.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063303/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90387) reported that NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte defended Ukraine's right to strike logistical hubs like the Crimean Bridge.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90374), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-milbloggers-are-furious-about-the-crimean-bridge-attack/) reported that part of the Crimean Bridge collapsed into the Kerch Strait following a Ukrainian strike.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261117-ukraine-critically-damages-bridge-linking-occupied-crimea-with-russia) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukrainian drones and missiles struck a vital bridge linking Russia to the occupied Crimean Peninsula.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90383) reported that US and NATO intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance aircraft patrolled near Crimea hours before the Kerch Bridge was targeted.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/after-ukraine-s-latest-attack-moscow-calls-damage-to-the-crimean-bridge-insignificant-but-osint-analysts-say-its-main-road-span-is-visibly-deformed) reported that Russian Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin stated vehicle traffic has partially resumed on the Crimean Bridge after being halted following a Ukrainian attack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063246/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin has been briefed and vowed to rebuild the Crimean Bridge after a Ukrainian multi-weapon strike.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPTl9Eb1E5UVQ3M3dxTUZvVFZiRndFUElsU3RMZ2ZGR0poZlV6X3JHdklhNUswWEE4RGZkbXZkWmpwS3I3ZTgyY1Vrc2tXOXZnYl9kSlJsT1BuR3pWZmkyYlRENWgyWHVSU0Y5dkhVdlFrNXMxMnNJTTVMRTF6aUJpQkdXUnV1NnE5aW43QVFlYmFfdjlxTVBUY0Rfam1tSFBRMl8weFVMSWw0RFBTekdncV8weE5CcXlwcHhMWDh3QQ?oc=5) reported that Russia stated Ukraine struck its bridge to Crimea for the second consecutive day in what was described as the largest drone attack of the war.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-ukraine-russia-hit-key-bridges-ahead-of-putin-xi-trump-summit) reported that Ukraine struck Russia's Crimean bridge for the second night in a row, shutting it down, while Russia struck two major bridges in Kyiv.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/putins-bridge-to-crimea-falls-into-the-kerch-strait/) reported that the arch over the shipping channel on the road section of the Crimean Bridge collapsed into the Kerch Strait.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/ukrainian-drone-attack-kills-two-in-crimea-as-kyiv-targets-kerch-bridge?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Ukrainian drone attack killed two people in Crimea.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063218/) reported that Ukrainian forces used an FP-5 Flamingo cruise missile, alongside Palianytsia and Ruta drones and Neptune missiles, during the strike on the Crimean Bridge.
On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90332) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated the strike on the Crimean Bridge was the culmination of a seven-stage operation.
