stories.title: Ukraine Strikes Afipsky, Ilsky Refineries Again as Russian Fuel Crisis Deepens
stories.label: Russian strikes on Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/four-killed-as-russian-strikes-hit-ukraines-odesa?traffic_source=rss) reported that at least four people were killed and thirteen injured after Russian strikes hit Ukraine's port city of Odesa.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186044-general-staff-confirms-strikes-on-ilsky-and-afipsky-oil-refineries.html) reported that Ukraine's Defense Forces attacked and hit the Ilsky and Afipsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar Territory.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90455) reported that Ukraine struck the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar Territory for the second time this month.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/ukrainian-drones-strike-two-oil-refineries-in-southern-russia), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185869-drones-attack-afipsky-and-ilsky-oil-refineries-in-russia-media-reports.html), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583328/ukrainian-drone-strikes-spark-fires-at-two-russian-oil-refineries/) reported that Ukrainian drones struck the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries in Russia's Krasnodar region, sparking fires and injuring four people in the Seversky district.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/18/ukrainian-drones-target-krasnodar-region-refineries-a94294) reported that Russia's Defense Ministry said it intercepted 183 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions overnight.

On 18 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-kyiv-targets-krasnodar-refineries-after-felling-kerch-bridge/live-79976877?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukrainian strikes targeted two industrial facilities overnight in Krasnodar following action against the Kerch bridge.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/why-ukraine-keeps-targeting-the-kerch-bridge/article71714957.ece) reported that Ukraine has targeted the Kerch Bridge multiple times, most recently on November 17, 2026.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90463), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063406/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-strikes-central-odesa-kills-3-injures-7/) reported that a Russian drone strike on a residential building in central Odesa killed three people and injured seven others.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185794-part-of-kyivs-livoberezhnyi-district-to-temporarily-lose-heating.html) reported that buildings in Kyiv's Livoberezhnyi residential district will temporarily lose heating due to repair work.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-crimea-bridge-trump-putin-zelensky-b3086877.html), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/2-russian-oil-refineries-reportedly-targeted-in-overnight-drone-attack-on-krasnodar-krai/) reported that two Russian oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai were targeted in overnight drone attacks.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063375/) reported that explosions and air defense responses occurred near the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063333/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185762-russian-strike-on-central-vinnytsia-injures-four.html) reported that four people were injured in a Russian attack on central Vinnytsia on Tuesday evening.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185409-317-buildings-in-kyivs-darnytskyi-district-left-without-heating-after-russian-attack.html) reported that 317 residential buildings in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district were left without heating after a Russian attack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90385) reported that Kyiv switched consumers in the Darnytskyi, Obolonskyi, and Podilskyi districts to backup heating after strikes damaged heating mains.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063233/) reported that seven people were injured in Russian strikes on a confectionery factory and a residential area in Dnipro.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063226/) reported that a combined Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia's industrial and energy infrastructure left two people dead and 18 injured.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185451-russian-attack-on-kyiv-kills-two-injures-one.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90324), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063228/) reported that a Russian attack on Kyiv's Obolonskyi district killed two people and injured another, damaging residential and non-residential buildings.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185465-russian-drone-strikes-parking-lot-in-vinnytsia-killing-one-woman-and-injuring-another.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063235/) reported that a Russian drone strike on a car park in Vinnytsia killed one woman and injured another.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063182/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185381-car-driver-killed-in-drone-attack-on-zaporizhzhia.html) reported that a driver was killed when an FPV drone hit a car in Zaporizhzhia during a Russian evening attack.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185324-russian-forces-attack-zaporizhzhia-woman-injured.html) reported that a woman was injured in a Russian attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/conflict-in-yemen-could-stretch-for-months-us-withdraws-an-aircraft-carrier-and-other-mideast-news-101795039320695.html) reported that the conflict in Yemen could stretch for months as the US withdrew an aircraft carrier.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/houthis-advance-on-aden-as-saudi-coalition-targets-military-sites?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Saudi-led coalition conducted precision strikes on 60 Houthi military sites as fierce battles took place in Taiz and Houthis advanced toward Aden.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/saudi-arabia-preparing-for-war-against-houthis-to-stretch-into-next-year-report-101795007702949.html), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/amid-setbacks-saudi-arabia-braces-yemen-war-stretch-2027-report) reported that Saudi Arabia is bracing for the Yemen war to stretch into next year amid Houthi advances.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/saudi-arabia-appoints-gen-ruwaili-oversee-yemen-war-after-setbacks-what-know) reported that Saudi Arabia appointed Gen. Fayyad Ruwaili to oversee the Yemen war following battlefield struggles by Saudi-backed forces.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOR2l1bWc4eTF3NXJ2NktEbGZGWnRzeUJyYzBaQmxBdnpnblVHeEVzaDVZR01ndG1UQVAzTkdtVGxaYlRZcEJ6S3BHRTJuVkRXVjFkZkpOb3lYcGlsc25UVW41QjA1QmgxY1hBaUp0ZWYxQjFZYXhyWklaZFdLMEVEcnFoOWRSR1poMEh4ZWN0ZXlETnlJWU5JdXUycEMtdkszeXAxZEtPa2gwS3MwcDQ0eDRFNUQ?oc=5) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen bolstered their defenses near Aden to deter Houthi forces.

On 16 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Houthi-Advance-Puts-Saudi-Crude-Exports-at-Risk.html) reported that Houthi fighters advanced to within 100 kilometers of Aden after government forces withdrew from positions.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/houthis-advance-toward-aden-us-iran-deadlock-continues) reported that Houthi forces are advancing toward Aden while the US-Iran deadlock continues.

Gen. Fahd bin Hamad as Joint Forces Commander overseeing operations in Yemen.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jeffrey-epstein-s-brother-releases-disturbing-autopsy-photos-demands-true-homicide-probe-amid-new-forensic-claims-101795007522147.html) reported that Jeffrey Epstein's brother Mark demanded an independent homicide investigation after forensic expert Dr Freeman questioned the official suicide ruling.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/forensic-experts-claim-epstein-was-strangled-to-death?traffic_source=rss) reported that a team of forensic scientists is challenging the ruling that Jeffrey Epstein died by suicide.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/epstein-was-murdered-claims-forensic-expert-who-has-seen-full-autopsy-records/articleshow/135937216.cms) reported that forensic medicine and epidemiology expert Dr Michael Freeman claimed Jeffrey Epstein was murdered after being given exclusive access to the examiners' report by Epstein's brother Mark.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648949-epstein-suicide-assassination-us/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that a forensic expert stated Jeffrey Epstein did not commit suicide and was likely murdered.

On 17 Nov 2026, [De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/forensisch-expert-blaast-complottheorie-rond-dood-jeffrey-epstein-nieuw-leven-in-bewijs-lijkt-op-wurging-van-achteren/164656814.html) reported that a prominent forensic expert stated evidence resembles strangulation from behind in the death of Jeffrey Epstein.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640769/forensic-expert-says-epsteins-death-more-likely-homicide-than-suicide), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/forensic-expert-claims-jeffrey-epstein-was-murdered-not-suicidal/) reported that forensic expert Dr. Michael Freeman stated that Jeffrey Epstein's death was more likely a homicide than suicide.

On 16 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5n4exg1kkmyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Professor Michael Freeman told BBC Newsnight that he believes Jeffrey Epstein's injuries are consistent with a homicide.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/epstein-death-prison-forensic-expert-b3086005.html) reported that Professor Michael Freeman stated he believes Epstein was strangled after spending a year examining evidence.

On 16 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/us/jeffrey-epstein-autopsy-michael-freeman.html) reported that forensic scientist Michael Freeman obtained access to Jeffrey Epstein's autopsy file and stated photos show homicide.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/forensic-expert-challenges-epsteins-2019-suicide-ruling-says-autopsy-injuries-point-to-possible-homicide-101794863234394.html) reported that the medical examiner's office stands by its suicide finding despite the forensic expert's assertions.

stories.title: Missing cat found alive four days after deadly Brooklyn building collapse

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/four-days-after-a-deadly-brooklyn-building-collapse-forced-her-family-to-evacuate-13-year-old-zariah-coleman-got-her-missing-cat-isaac-back-after-rescuers-heard-a-faint-meow-coming-from-a-kitchen-cabinet/articleshow/135952613.cms) reported that a missing cat named Isaac was found alive four days after a building collapse and reunited with 13-year-old Zariah Coleman.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/brooklyn-building-collapse-lawsuit) reported that Dengane Omari Jack filed a lawsuit against his landlord and multiple construction companies following a fatal building collapse in Brooklyn.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/isaac-cat-found-brooklyn-building-collapse-b3085862.html) reported that workers found a missing cat named Isaac alive four days after the deadly Brooklyn building collapse.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/industry/1741531-nigerian-named-worst-landlords-list-building-collapsed-us/) reported that Nigerian landlord Olufemi Falade appeared on New York City's worst landlords list six times before his Brooklyn apartment building collapsed, killing eight people.

On 16 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cm3wgeqnppljo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/brooklyn-building-collapse-cat-reunited-b3085420.html) reported that a pet cat named Isaac was reunited with its 13-year-old owner Zariah Coleman one week after the deadly Brooklyn building collapse.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOMjI1ZmhJQVcyOGtfNHFaWDBBTVJkWGF4NFZxaGprVmNieXFfOEFQSXV1RVZQRzF3c0xabzhsVTlEQ2dGU3k4blUxeW5jY0RVbU1RSDNWU3BSc1ViaFBoa3B4ajBkVnB4aXVqVGMyTjM5TmNoX29fMjg0Y3ZiNnlqWmdERS13aGZ6a3NDR0hDdGw4VFhXeW1pY2FvNXJpYkNFN3I3N2ZpdXI0QQ?oc=5) reported that Isaac, a cat missing since the Brooklyn building collapse, was reunited with its young owner.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/isaac-the-cat-feared-lost-in-deadly-brooklyn-building-collapse-that-killed-8-found-alive-after-childs-emotional-plea-to-be-reunited-with-family-101794793752482.html) reported that the cat belonged to 13-year-old Zariah Coleman, who lives next to the collapsed building in Flatbush.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nigerian-property-owner-in-us-named-among-worst-landlords-after-building-collapse-kills-eight/) reported that Nigerian property owner Olufemi Falade was named among the worst landlords after his building collapsed onto an adjacent construction site in Brooklyn, New York, killing eight people.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/video-shows-moment-of-brooklyn-building-collapse-from-inside?traffic_source=rss) reported that newly released nanny cam footage shows the moment an apartment building collapsed in Brooklyn while children played inside.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/13/brooklyn-building-collapse-raising-questions-city-oversight-safety/) reported that the Brooklyn building collapse raised questions about city oversight and safety precautions at nearby construction sites.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/why-did-a-brooklyn-building-collapse-suddenly-killing-eight-experts-point-to-excavation-work-at-neighbouring-construction-site/articleshow/135833971.cms) reported that experts pointed to excavation work at a neighbouring construction site as the reason for the Brooklyn building collapse.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/un-video-mostro-desde-el-interior-de-un-apartamento-el-momento-exacto-en-el-que-un-edificio-de-tres-pisos-se-derrumbo-en-brooklyn-nueva-york-3600879) reported that a video from inside an apartment showed the exact moment a three-story building collapsed in Brooklyn, New York.

On 13 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/brooklyn-building-collapse-deaths.html) reported that the New York Fire Department stated the search for victims on Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn was over after eight people died in a building collapse.

On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm4gn5qddqqxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that at least eight residents, including two children, died in the rubble of a building collapse in Flatbush, New York.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/brooklyn-building-collapse-victim-identified-death-toll-b3084106.html), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261112-eight-killed-including-two-children-in-new-york-building-collapse), [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2217289) reported that the death toll from the building collapse in Brooklyn rose to eight.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQOTF0bXlzSWlmLWlkQWl1aE1xZzFRNjVtTXJtOFV4bUtGd2JQeGx0bjJ1bjRCQ2pUVFN2ejd2ZU5NZE5MVTdSNGpZbjU4RVV4MDVsQnRtLUZHV09LS0NYeWY1OGVaVkdWYk10Vy00UzdJY1lpSUYza2dWVGY3aC1vS3dCbDE2OVlHNHB5VVJYSDBSZi05eVNLcXRsMDZDWkJFZmYtMGxsN2hjQQ?oc=5) reported that the death toll rose to six in the Brooklyn building collapse as rescuers dig through rubble.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/north-america/new-york-apartment-block-collapses-killing-at-least-two-people-20261112-p61doa.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the death toll rose to five after the New York apartment block collapse.

On 12 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/brooklyn-building-collapse-new-york/) reported that a three-story building collapsed in Brooklyn's Flatbush neighborhood, killing two people and injuring 10.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-two-dead-several-injured-after-new-york-building-collapses) reported that two people were killed and at least 17 others injured, including children, after a three-story building collapsed near a construction site in New York.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/brooklyn-building-collapse-pregnant-woman-b3083626.html) reported that a pregnant woman was rescued from rubble after a Brooklyn building collapse killed two.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/new-york-brooklyn-building-collapsed-today-flatbush-b3083586.html) reported that a New York City building collapse killed two people and injured 17.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/building-collapse-in-brooklyn-kills-two-injures-more-than-a-dozen?traffic_source=rss) reported that a building collapse in Brooklyn killed two and injured more than a dozen.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/new-york-building-collapse-leaves-one-dead-and-ten-people-injured-20261112-p61dme.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that at least one person is dead and ten others are injured after a building in New York collapsed.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639894/2-killed-several-injured-in-building-collapse-in-brooklyn-new-york) reported officials stated two people were deceased, four were critical, and twelve were stable following a building collapse in Brooklyn, New York.

reports.text: On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915234) reported that British counterterrorism police arrested a US Army officer near Gloucester under investigation over espionage allegations.
On 18 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90415) reported that British authorities transferred a US Army officer suspected of spying for Russia to American military custody.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/uk-hands-nato-assigned-us-soldier-accused-of-russia-spying-to-us-military?traffic_source=rss) reported that UK authorities transferred the investigation in line with existing international protocols.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/scott-bessent-confirms-relocating-from-washington-home-to-military-base-amid-iranian-threats-101794581505450.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914821) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed relocating from his Washington home to a military base following Iranian threats.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/us-terror-case-raf-fairford-arrests) reported that a suspect held in a New York jail has been linked to a handler behind Iran-linked operations in Britain in connection with the RAF Fairford arrests.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/12/3-iranian-backed-men-indicted-in-attempted-plot-on-raf-fairford/) reported that three men, with one working from jail, allegedly conspired to commit around 20 terrorist attacks across the US and Europe, including a plot on RAF Fairford.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914783) reported that a 41-year-old US Army officer stationed at NATO headquarters in the UK was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579836/us-authorities-charge-three-men-over-suspected-terror-plot-targeting-raf-fairford/) reported that United States authorities unsealed an eight-count indictment charging three men for involvement in foreign terror plots targeting RAF Fairford.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/coded-messages-from-jail-cell-how-alleged-iranian-operative-mohammad-dawood-al-saadi-coordinated-foiled-raf-fairford-terror-plot-uk-us-iran-war-101794386640896.html) reported that American and British authorities suspected an Iranian link to the foiled terror plot, while Tehran denied any involvement.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461464/) reported that Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Quds Force commander Brigadier General Esmail Qaani arrived in Baghdad at the head of an Iranian delegation.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/bennett-meets-netanyahu-eisenkot-unaware-coalition-talks/) reported that B'Yachad chief Naftali Bennett held a long Knesset meeting with Benjamin Netanyahu on November 18 while Gadi Eisenkot's spokesperson stated he was unaware of it.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-opposition-rattled-bennett-holds-talks-netanyahu) reported that members of Israel's opposition bloc insisted they remain unified after a meeting between Naftali Bennett and Benjamin Netanyahu.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/bennett-meets-netanyahu-ahead-of-talks-with-eisenkot-bloc-leaders/000001a1-ee32-d24f-a1e5-efbfec8b0000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915298) reported that Naftali Bennett and Benjamin Netanyahu held a secret meeting without informing Gadi Eisenkot and Yair Lapid in advance, which delayed planned opposition bloc talks.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-915097) reported that an Eisenkot-led bloc is weighing a unity government and coalition talks with haredi parties following the October election, while Golan and Liberman warned against a Netanyahu-led unity government.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-15/ty-article/.premium/whats-behind-netanyahus-frantic-push-for-a-unity-government/000001a1-e027-d59b-a1f3-f8b72d260000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is urging Gadi Eisenkot to share power after losing his majority.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/can-netanyahu-and-eisenkot-form-a-unity-government-in-israel?traffic_source=rss) reported that Yashar and Likud are scheduled to hold talks on Sunday.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/netanyahu-again-urges-rival-to-join-him-in-forming-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu urged rival Gadi Eisenkot to join him in forming a unity government.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-rejects-netanyahus-unity-government-call-as-media-stunt-3725584) reported that Gadi Eisenkot described the call as a media stunt and noted that negotiating teams from his Yashar party and Likud are due to meet.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-israel-vows-gaza-offensive-policy-despite-caretaker-status?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel has pledged to continue its offensive policy on Gaza.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914874) reported that Netanyahu invoked the Hatikvah walkout and warned of Iran's nuclear threat.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-12/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-controls-the-knesset-netanyahu-is-still-pm-what-each-bloc-is-planning/000001a1-ce67-dfd7-a7a3-ce7757c70000) reported on what Eisenkot's bloc and Netanyahu's bloc are planning to do regarding the Knesset and government formation.

stories.title: Rwanda: Rwanda, Five EU Countries Announce Migration Partnership
stories.label: EU Rwanda migrant return hub

reports.text: On 17 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261117-five-eu-member-states-open-talks-with-rwanda-on-deportation-centre) reported that Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Greece are jointly spearheading a project to open talks with Rwanda on a deportation centre.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/436787/rwanda-migrant-deportation-centre-what-we-know-about-europes-five-nation-plan/) reported that the plan involves an open welcome centre, residence permits, and a path into Rwandan society, though NGOs expressed fears.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/migration-partnership-with-rwanda-sparks-eu-backlash-over-human-rights-record) reported that Rwanda's interior minister rejected criticism regarding the country's human rights record as it prepares to host the first EU return hubs outside the bloc.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seekers-migrants-eu-uk-b3086442.html) reported that Rwanda's interior minister positioned the East African nation as a welcoming country for refugees and migrants.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-5-european-countries-aim-to-send-rejected-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda), [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648950-eu-states-seek-deport-asylum-seekers-rwanda/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that five European countries announced plans to establish a return hub in Rwanda starting in 2027 to send rejected asylum seekers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-news-plans-for-rwanda-migrant-hub-come-under-fire/live-79965639?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/why-are-five-eu-countries-reviving-plans-to-deport-migrants-to-rwanda?traffic_source=rss) reported that human rights groups slammed plans by Germany and four other EU states to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda as a return hub.

On 17 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170105.html), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eu-countries-present-rwanda-agreement-to-create-migrant-return-center-hub/) reported that Rwanda and five European Union member states announced a partnership to establish a migrant return hub in Rwanda.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/european-nations-rwanda-hub-migrants/) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands planned a Rwanda migrant hub despite human rights protests and a UNHCR warning.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-eu-states-open-talks-on-rwanda-deportation-scheme/a-79959158?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Germany joined four other EU states to open talks on establishing a migrant deportation hub in Rwanda following the approval of EU regulations easing deportations.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/rwanda-to-host-hub-for-rejected-eu-migrants) reported that five European countries are negotiating a deal to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda to host a hub.

On 16 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/rwanda-to-create-return-center-for-asylum-seekers/), a state-media outlet, reported that Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker announced the plan aims to avoid human trafficking networks and reduce deaths on migration routes.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOZFh2TV8xR3JSejFkM0c0RjBIVmVsWXhkZUtTWHlsLTY4WEI0Q0hVZDJFQURQaWdpM3JtRFdocXFpcW85RTJGeVgzaGhyODNTTUxIcHc5YUl4SWVQU0dwb0d3XzRzZFB0QjBrY2VGQWFSUVRWLTZNeUZZd1dSdnNJTG1zRzI2VXN3TGFTM092MEhRMjRkblBmeXZJSVhacS1aQXg5cG5tOEw2T2MxTjNkdjVOSUtLR1dELUtSdlYwWQ?oc=5) reported that Austria stated five EU countries are starting talks with Rwanda on a deportation hub.
On 16 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90286) reported that Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen defended the plan.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cinq-pays-de-l-union-europeenne-devoilent-leur-projet-de-centre-pour-migrants-au-rwanda-20261116) reported that the project aims to facilitate the return of individuals whose asylum applications were rejected or who lack the right to stay in the European Union.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1116/1599373-eu-migrant-hub-deal/), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/5-eu-nations-present-plan-for-1st-migrant-return-hub-in-rwanda) reported that five EU nations presented a plan alongside Rwandan officials to establish the first migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-unveil-rwanda-deportation-plan-in-migration-crackdown), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/5-countries-announce-plan-to-deport-failed-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands aim to begin deporting rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda in 2027.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/1741658-5-eu-countries-plan-open-migrant-deportation-centre-rwanda-2027/) reported that rights groups raised concerns over detention and DR Congo.

stories.title: Faster fossil fuels phase-out, $120bn aid in COP31 draft
stories.label: COP31 climate talks in Turkey

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/opec-speaks-fossil-fuels-cop31-climate-talks) reported that OPEC Secretary General Haitham Al Ghais stated at the COP31 climate talks that efforts to boost electrification will depend on fossil fuels.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/cop31-is-once-again-shying-away-from-a-fossil-fuel-exit-but-one-european-country-is-taking) reported that four additional European countries joined Finland, France, Germany, and the Netherlands in publishing national roadmaps for the transition away from fossil fuels.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/european-union-rejects-first-draft-of-cop31-agreement/), a state-run outlet, reported that the European Union rejected the first draft of the final agreement at the COP31 summit, stating Brussels will oppose points that divert attention from the main focus.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926012-cop31-to-propose-120-billion-adaptation-finance-target-fossil-fuel-phase-out.html) reported that a draft decision released by the COP31 Presidency proposes a $120 billion adaptation finance target and a fossil fuel phase-out, alongside measures on renewable energy, workers' rights, and loss and damage.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/tensions-rise-over-draft-climate-deal-at-cop31?traffic_source=rss) reported that tensions rose over the draft climate deal at COP31 as the publication of the IPCC's seventh assessment report became a sticking point.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/turkiye/cop31-draws-record-crowds-as-summit-enters-final-days/news) reported that the UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya attracted over 102,000 registered participants to its Blue Zone as it entered its final days.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/faster-fossil-fuels-phase-out-120bn-aid-in-cop31-draft-101794884329232.html) reported that the COP31 draft included a faster fossil fuels phase-out and $120 billion in aid.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/16/cop31-draft-text-draw-out-parties-find-agreement-president-talks-says) reported that the president of the COP31 talks stated that the draft text of a possible final outcome was an attempt to draw out parties to find agreement.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change/cop31-energy-fossil-fuels-text-deal-turkey-b3085834.html) reported that the first week of the UN climate conference in Antalya faced logistical problems and transport chaos.

On 16 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/cop31-first-week-records-26bn-green-investment-deals-10bn-climate-finance-pledges/) reported that the first week of COP31 ended with commitments exceeding $26 billion in green investment deals and $10 billion in climate finance pledges.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/cop31-draft-urges-tripling-adaptation-finance-to-120b-by-2035-3725650), [Punch](https://punchng.com/cop31-draft-targets-120bn-annual-adaptation-finance-by-2035/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the COP31 draft text proposed raising annual climate adaptation finance for developing countries to at least $120 billion by 2035 and urged an immediate transition away from fossil fuels.

On 16 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/cop31-launches-ai-pledge-green-industrialisation-drive-to-advance-climate-action/) reported that the COP31 Presidency launched an artificial intelligence pledge and green industrialization drive.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-draft-deal-calls-for-immediate-shift-away-from-fossil-fuels/a-79960705?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/draft-cop31-text-suggests-immediate-fossil-fuel-transition/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that a draft deal at the COP31 UN climate talks calls for an immediate shift away from fossil fuels.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-draft-deal-calls-for-immediate-shift-away-from-fossil-fuels/a-79960705?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the preliminary agreement includes at least $120 billion to help countries adapt.

On 13 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1113/1599060-climate-cop-fossil-fuels/) reported that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for an immediate and drastic reduction in greenhouse gas emissions as divisions over fossil fuels dominated COP31.

On 13 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/climate/cop31-turkey-ipcc-climate-report.html), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261113-eu-vows-to-defend-climate-science-as-cop31-talks-expose-global-divisions) reported that fossil fuel-dependent countries attempted to delay scientific climate assessments at the COP31 summit in Turkey, prompting the European Union to pledge to defend climate science.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/erdogan-pushes-climate-pledges-into-action-as-cop31-talks-advance/news) reported that Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan called for turning global climate commitments into concrete results as the COP31 Leaders' Summit concluded in Antalya.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044380/cop31-must-deliver-climate-justice-not-empty-pledges-says-sherry) reported that Senator Sherry Rehman called for COP31 in Antalya to deliver a credible, accessible, and equitable climate financing framework.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/un-climate-chief-urges-speed-cop31-confronts-fossil-fuel-divide) reported that the UN's top climate official urged negotiators at the COP31 conference in Turkey to speed up efforts as talks confront a fossil fuel divide.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/un-climate-chief-urges-speed-cop31-confronts-fossil-fuel-divide) reported that UN climate talks at COP31 face pressure to reach a deal on fossil fuels, electrification, and global warming.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/cop31-talks-face-early-friction-over-future-fossil-fuels), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/fossil-fuels-take-center-stage-at-cop31-as-leaders-urge-emissions-cuts/) reported that COP31 climate talks in Antalya faced friction over fossil fuels as UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged drastic emissions cuts.

stories.label: US National Security Agency network outage

reports.text: On 17 Nov 2026, [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648975-nsa-apple-services-outage/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that the NSA experienced a temporary degradation of internal systems during routine maintenance.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/pala-tajna-mreza-nsa-net-preko-koje-americki-obavjestajci-razmjenjuju-povjerljive-informacije/261117240), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1088763/pala-tajna-mreza-nsa-net-americki-obavjestajci-ostali-bez-sistema-za-razmjenu-povjerljivih-informacija) reported that the internal communication network used by the United States National Security Agency (NSA Net) suffered an outage.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNMktLaW5kdHVTN3VMZTk4bGp1WWZZZGVJLXFWa2QxOExBN25NdXNYd0F6RW1wZER4QTFDZHlZaWNpbURDdVk1UFBoT3N2ME5UcnIybFRyb0dsemJJbzNHQlJnd0lTSEs3LVJibVRCQjk1c2xNNFpHSTlia0VhRUNCbktOaWtOQlNhNzBvZURB?oc=5) reported that a defense official stated the classified communications network at the National Security Agency went down.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/17/nsa-national-security-classified-communications-network-down) reported that the NSA issued a code yellow after NSANet failed.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Defense One](https://www.defenseone.com/threats/2026/11/classified-nsa-communications-network-down-people-familiar-say/417278/) reported that sources stated there are no immediate signs that the outage on NSANet is related to a cyberattack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/cae-la-red-interna-de-comunicaciones-de-la-agencia-de-seguridad-de-eu-segun-cnn-33176495), [El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-17/nueva-caida-en-las-infraestructuras-de-ee-uu-ahora-la-red-de-comunicacion-interna-de-los-servicios-secretos.html) reported that CNN sources stated the internal communication network of the U.S. National Security Agency suffered an outage.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/cae-la-red-interna-de-comunicaciones-de-la-agencia-de-seguridad-de-eu-segun-cnn-33176495) reported that sources indicated no evidence of a cyberattack against the NSA Net network so far.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/nsa-down-network-outage-nsanet.html) reported that a classified National Security Agency network went down, causing work disruptions, with no current signs that the outage is the result of a cyberattack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/se-reporta-caida-de-la-red-de-comunicaciones-de-seguridad-de-estados-unidos-en-la-manana-de-este-martes-17-de-noviembre-esto-se-sabe-3601665), [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/agencia-de-seguridad-nacional-de-ee-uu-sufre-caida-en-su-red-interna) reported that the US National Security Agency experienced an outage on its highly classified internal communications network.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915216) reported that the network, NSA Net, enables employees to securely share classified information within the organization.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-man-accused-of-plotting-hindu-temple-shooting-in-illinois-faces-additional-terrorism-and-weapons-charges/articleshow/135970853.cms) reported that 19-year-old Alexandros Paporakis of Palatine faces terrorism and armed violence charges for allegedly planning a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Illinois.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/illinois-ethanol-plant-bomb-threat-charges) reported that 41-year-old Andrew M. Kozak pleaded not guilty in federal court to two charges connected to an explosive device found at an Illinois ethanol plant.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/peoria-illinois-bomb-threat-indictment.html) reported that a federal grand jury in Peoria charged a man, who may have worked at the BioUrja plant, with threatening to detonate an explosive device.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/andrew-kozak-alleged-peoria-illinois-bomb-plot-suspect-worked-at-biourja-renewables-ethanol-plant-he-tried-to-blow-up-report-101794899306014.html) reported that federal investigators alleged 41-year-old trainee Andrew Kodak planted an explosive device at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/unexploded-bomb-found-in-idaho-city-prompts-neighbourhood-evacuation-as-authorities-launch-probe-101794890698541.html) reported that Kootenai County officials said residents near Belmont and Appaloosa were evacuated after a suspected unexploded bomb was discovered in Idaho.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/illinois-bomb-ethanol-plant-suspect) reported that a suspect is in custody and the FBI is leading the investigation into an explosive device found at an Illinois ethanol plant.

On 16 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/us/peoria-bomb-threat-arrest.html) reported that authorities found and deactivated a bomb at an ethanol plant, leading to evacuations in significant portions of Peoria and East Peoria.

On 16 Nov 2026, [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Illinois-Ethanol-Plant-Bomb-Is-the-Latest-Threat-to-US-Energy-Sites.html) reported that authorities arrested a suspect in the investigation into the explosive device found at the Illinois ethanol plant.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/law-enforcement-searches-illinois-plant-after-credible-threat-of-explosive-device-101794688615104.html) reported that law enforcement searched an Illinois plant following a credible threat of an explosive device.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/police-lift-evacuation-after-bomb-found-near-ethanol-plant-in-central-illinois-101794688737536.html) reported that police lifted evacuations after a bomb was found near an ethanol plant in central Illinois.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/residents-evacuated-after-bomb-found-at-illinois-ethanol-plant-fbi-joins-probe/articleshow/135837352.cms), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/peoria-bomb-threat-police-continue-search-for-more-explosives-at-biourja-plant-as-evacuation-order-remains-101794674711354.html) reported that police and the FBI are continuing their search for explosives at the BioUrja plant in Illinois where a bomb was found, while residents remain evacuated.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/14/peoria-illinois-evacuation-bomb) reported that Peoria officials stated a bomb was found at BioUrja Renewables and later defused, and the FBI said it is investigating.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxPSWRUeUVCV0dNLU1YTGo0NVF1QUVEZ0ZvRXhhcy1YX0wwTHpBUk4xTlpOaThuT3dURFY3MktkQ1oxajFpS3hlTHkwLTJubnlwd1JQSUIxUUdyTkM2Ymh3QWt1enJmb2FraVJXS3BOYmtNTExoT0lCR2N4QnpXRGVrYTIxdlhhNG1PUHJ6cDJVUQ?oc=5) reported that residents were evacuated after a bomb was found at an industrial plant in Illinois.

On 14 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/bomb-ethanol-plant-peoria-illinois.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/east-peoria-orders-one-mile-evacuation-after-bomb-threat-at-biourja-renewables-plant-in-illinois-101794626785566.html) reported that a bomb threat and suspicious package were found at the BioUrja Renewables ethanol plant in East Peoria, Illinois, prompting authorities to order a one-mile radius evacuation.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/students-enter-parliament-following-serbias-historic-election-outcome/) reported that lawmakers returned to the Serbian parliament following the election outcome.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/17/joy-hope-anger-serbia-student-movement-political-novices-enter-parliament) reported that supporters celebrated the arrival of Student List candidates in the national assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/serbias-students-enter-parliament-after-historic-election/4PLSFMZFBRHTNIXL2LNJNPOTWA/) reported that the Students' List won 140 of 250 seats, enough to govern alone.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1117/1599549-serbia-election/), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/serbia-student-list-candidates-enter-parliament-historic-election.1137253) reported that representatives of Serbia's student-backed movement attended the inaugural session of the National Assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/serbia-swears-in-new-parliament-after-students-led-ballot-revolution) reported that the session swore in the new parliament following an election victory that ended the 14-year rule of Aleksandar Vucic.

On 17 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/students-list-candidates-take-seats-as-serbian-parliament-opens/a-79969166?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Student List candidates took their oaths in the inaugural session and have 90 days to form a government.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/serbia-parliament-student-list-opposition-vucic/33899684.html) reported that Serbia's parliament met for the first time since the Student List opposition movement won a landslide election victory.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/serbias-new-parliament-meets-for-first-time-since-student-led-movement-won-election) reported that the landslide result followed protests sparked by the 2024 collapse of a railway station canopy in Novi Sad that killed 16 people.

stories.title: Lauren Boebert Loses Re-election Bid in Colorado House Race to Eileen Laubacher
stories.label: Meet Eileen Laubacher, the Navy Veteran Who Beat Lauren Boebert

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6j9mlldgpgjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Lauren Boebert will not serve a fourth term in Congress after losing her Colorado seat.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/lauren-boebert-midterms-concession-video-b3084998.html) reported that Lauren Boebert faced criticism over Christian messaging in a concession video following her defeat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-why-constitutional-amendment-is-just-the-first-step-omole/) reported that a constitutional amendment allowing states to establish their own police services is considered the first step in decentralising policing in Nigeria.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/state-police-senate-clears-final-hurdle-sends-constitutional-amendment/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-bill-forwarded-by-senate-to-tinubu-for-assent/) reported that the Senate cleared the final hurdle and directed the Clerk to transmit the constitutional amendment bill seeking to establish state police for presidential assent.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-seeks-decriminalisation-of-attempted-suicide-proposes-support-for-victims/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-to-decriminalise-attempted-suicide/) reported that President Bola Tinubu transmitted the National Mental Health (Amendment) Bill, 2026, to the House of Representatives seeking to decriminalise attempted suicide.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-receives-state-police-bill-to-consult-agf-before-assent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu will consult the Attorney-General before giving assent to the state police bill.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/just-in-senate-directs-clerk-to-forward-state-police-bill-for-tinubus-assent/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/breaking-senate-directs-clerk-to-forward-state-police-bill-to-tinubu-for-assent/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/state-police-senate-completes-amendment-process-seeks-tinubus-assent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Senate directed its Clerk to forward the Constitution Amendment Bill to establish a State Police Service to President Bola Tinubu for assent.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/state-police-barau-praises-tinubu-as-senate-sends-bill-for-assent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin praised President Bola Tinubu as the Senate moved to transmit the bill.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Chronicle (Ghana)](https://thechronicle.com.gh/state-police-bill-clears-hurdle-as-tinubu-pushes-intelligence-led-security/) reported that Nigeria's proposed state police bill received unanimous backing from all 36 State Houses of Assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/mental-health-tinubu-sends-bill-to-senate-seeking-decriminalisation-of-attempted-suicide/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/suicide-attempts-tinubu-sends-decriminalisation-bill-to-senate/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-sends-bill-to-senate-to-decriminalise-attempted-suicide/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu sent the National Mental Health Amendment Bill 2026 to the Senate to decriminalise attempted suicide.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-introduces-nin-linked-verification-system-for-domestic-air-passengers/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/industry/1741858-fg-announces-airport-rules-airlines-december-deadline-meet-requirements/) reported that the Nigerian Federal Government introduced a biometric passenger verification system linked to the National Identification Number for domestic air travel.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/industry/1741858-fg-announces-airport-rules-airlines-december-deadline-meet-requirements/) reported that airlines were given until December 31, 2026, to adopt the V-Pass system to curb identity fraud.

On 16 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611160089.html), [Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-state-police-bill-may-reach-tinubu-friday-ig-redeploys-15-officers-other-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that 32 state assemblies approved the State Police Bill, which is expected to reach President Tinubu this week.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/state-police-senate-sets-nov-17-deadline-for-four-states/) reported that the Nigerian Senate gave four remaining State Houses of Assembly until Tuesday to submit their reports on the proposed creation of state police.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/senate-to-transmit-state-police-bill-to-tinubu-this-week-bamidele/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/state-police-nass-to-transmit-bill-to-tinubu-this-week-senator-bamidele/) reported that Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele stated the National Assembly will transmit the State Police Bill to President Bola Tinubu this week.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-atiku-promises-to-end-insecurity-if-elected/) reported that presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar promised to end insecurity and revive the economy by providing affordable fuel and electricity and cutting taxes.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/senate-leader-to-nigerians-judge-national-assembly-by-impact-of-laws-not-number-of-bills-passed/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/925402-state-police-four-states-yet-to-transmit-resolutions-to-nass-senate-leader.html) reported that Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele stated that four states have yet to transmit resolutions on state police to the National Assembly, but their failure will not prevent further legislative processes.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/state-police-senate-sets-november-17-deadline-for-four-states/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741488-sstate-police-senate-sets-deadline-states/) reported that the Nigerian Senate set a November 17 deadline for four remaining state assemblies to submit reports on the proposed creation of state police.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-ill-restore-fuel-subsidy-tackle-insecurity-if-elected-atiku-vows/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-atiku-promises-to-restore-fuel-electricity-subsidies-if-elected/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar promised to restore fuel and electricity subsidies if elected president in the 2027 general elections.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741290-tinubus-convoy-presidency-reacts-alleged-attack-friday-prayers-abuja/) reported that the Nigerian presidency disputed a video shared by Dino Melaye alleging an attack on President Bola Tinubu's convoy in Abuja and released separate footage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-aide-dismisses-claims-of-convoy-stoning/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubus-aide-dismisses-reports-of-attack-on-presidential-convoy-in-abuja/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that O’tega Ogra, Senior Special Assistant to President Bola Tinubu, disputed and dismissed claims and misleading videos suggesting the president's convoy was attacked by youths in Abuja.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-fani-kayode-south-africa-clash-tinubu-aide-denies-convoy-attack-other-top-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported on top stories including a denial of an attack on Tinubu's convoy.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-tinubu-orders-security-agencies-to-crush-political-thuggery/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Tinubu authorized security agencies to crush political thuggery and warned politicians against violence.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-tinubu-orders-crackdown-on-thuggery-violence/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925036-2027-tinubu-orders-security-agencies-to-crack-down-on-political-thuggery.html) reported that Nigerian President Bola Tinubu ordered security agencies to crack down on political thuggery and violence ahead of the 2027 general elections.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/better-days-ahead-edu-assures-grassroots-women-in-kebbi-urges-massive-votes-for-tinubu-apc/) reported that Betta Edu, leader of the APC Presidential Campaign Council Women Mobilisation Directorate, urged grassroots women in Kebbi to vote for the APC and Tinubu.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/2027-kebbi-state-have-spoken-loud-and-clear-for-president-as-group-lauds-massive-peaceful-turnout/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742116-apc-kebbi-rally-pro-tinubu-group-describes-turnout-sign-2027-victory/) reported that the Atiku Bagudu Grassroots Network for Tinubu hailed the peaceful and massive turnout at the APC presidential campaign rally in Kebbi State.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/idris-hails-tinubu-supporters-after-apc-rally-in-kebbi/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Kebbi Governor Nasir Idris thanked Tinubu, Shettima, and supporters after the APC presidential rally in Birnin Kebbi.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/anti-tinubu-protest-were-not-involved-in-your-predicament-adc-spokesman-fires-back-at-apc/) reported that African Democratic Congress National Publicity Secretary Bolaji Abdullahi dissociated the party from alleged sponsorship of protests against President Tinubu.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/926112-adc-challenges-apc-to-provide-evidence-of-alleged-sponsorship-of-campaign-violence.html), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/bamaiyi-adc-denies-sponsoring-protests-against-tinubu/) reported that the African Democratic Congress denied allegations by the All Progressives Congress that it sponsored campaign violence or protests against President Tinubu.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/2027-coalition-gives-adc-ndc-other-presidential-candidates-48-hours-to-rein-in-supporters-over-political-violence/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-coalition-gives-candidates-48-hours-to-curb-political-violence/) reported that the Coalition Against Electoral Violence in Nigeria gave presidential candidates 48 hours to rein in supporters and curb political violence.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-rejects-claim-it-sponsored-attack-on-tinubus-convoy/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the African Democratic Congress denied involvement in the alleged stoning of President Bola Tinubu’s convoy in Abuja.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/rousing-welcome-as-namadi-flags-off-campaign/) reported that Jigawa State Governor Umar Namadi launched his re-election campaign and President Bola Tinubu's campaign in Hadejia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741922-just-tinubu-announces-major-approval-apc-campaign-rally-details-emerge/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved the establishment of an inland dry port in Kebbi State.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/apc-pcc-alleges-ndc-adc-as-masterminds-of-fct-attack-on-tinubus-convoy/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council fingered the Nigeria Democratic Congress and the African Democratic Congress as masterminds of an attack on Tinubu's convoy in the FCT.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/senator-kawu-nigerians-unhappy-about-economic-hardship-apc-must-do-the-needful/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/925835-apc-faces-challenges-winning-northern-votes-due-to-hardship-kano-senator.html) reported that Senator Suleiman Kawu Sumaila acknowledged growing dissatisfaction and economic hardship among Nigerians, stating the APC is struggling to secure northern votes.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-apc-rallies-deepening-nigerians-anger-kawu-warns-party-leaders/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/sumaila-apc-leaders-displaying-opulence-at-their-rallies-amid-suffering-by-nigerians/) reported that Senator Suleiman Kawu Sumaila warned All Progressives Congress leaders against organizing elaborate celebrations and displaying opulence at rallies amid public suffering.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/apc-pcc-accuses-adc-ndc-of-endangering-lives-of-innocent-young-nigerians/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/17/2027-adc-ndc-sponsoring-violence-at-campaign-rallies-apc/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council accused the African Democratic Congress and Nigeria Democratic Congress of endangering lives.

On 17 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/adc-to-apc-stop-blaming-opposition-for-nigerians-anger-over-hardship/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council accused the All Progressives Congress of attempting to blame the opposition for public anger over hardship.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741900-adc-reacts-apcs-allegation-sponsoring-attacks-tinubus-campaign/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubus-hardship-fuelling-public-anger-not-adc-plot-opposition-tells-apc/) reported that the African Democratic Congress challenged the All Progressives Congress to provide evidence that it funded youths to disrupt Tinubu's campaign events.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adc-ndc-sponsoring-hoodlums-to-attack-tinubu-apc-campaign-council-alleges/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council accused the African Democratic Congress and the Nigeria Democratic Congress of sponsoring hoodlums to attack Tinubu.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/namadi-flags-off-apc-campaign-in-jigawa-north-east-seeks-re-election-for-tinubu-abdulhamid/) reported that Jigawa State Governor Malam Umar Namadi flagged off the All Progressives Congress 2027 general election campaign in the Jigawa North-East Senatorial District.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/ssouth-east/925501-2027-dickson-seeks-all-party-summit-over-attacks-on-ndc-candidates-supporters.html) reported that Seriake Dickson called for an all-party summit following an attack on the campaign convoy of NDC vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso in Kano State.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubu-unveils-five-year-war-strategy-against-terrorists-bandits-kidnappers/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council disclosed a five-year war strategy against terrorists, bandits, and kidnappers.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-applauds-nigerias-re-election-into-itu-council/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/16/tinubu-hails-nigerias-re-election-into-itu-council/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu applauded Nigeria's re-election to the Council of the International Telecommunication Union for another four-year term.
On 16 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611160323.html) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved the recruitment of 28,000 additional soldiers and 50,000 police officers.

On 16 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cxj05r2r17e5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that announcements regarding Nigeria's security came as the nation battles security problems lasting about 17 years.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/how-tinubu-will-end-insecurity-ready/) reported that the federal administration's approach to addressing insecurity combines sustained military operations and non-kinetic interventions.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/925410-tinubu-prepares-five-year-plan-to-end-boko-haram-insurgency-tackle-insecurity.html) reported that President Tinubu prepared a five-year plan to end the Boko Haram insurgency and tackle insecurity.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-dickson-decries-political-violence-thuggery-against-ndc-candidates/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress national leader Seriake Dickson decried political violence and thuggery against candidates.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/dickson-seeks-all-party-summit-over-rising-political-violence/) reported that Seriake Dickson called on the Inter-Party Advisory Council to intervene regarding rising political violence.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/15/2027-yilwatda-charges-n-central-apc-leaders-to-unite-stakeholders-for-tinubu/) reported that APC National Chairman Prof. Nentawe Goshwe Yilwatda urged North-Central APC leaders to unite stakeholders.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/insecurity-apc-pcc-unveils-tinubus-five-year-strategic-plan/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-unveils-five-year-defence-plan-to-tackle-insecurity-targets-28000-more-soldiers-apc-pcc/) reported that the APC Presidential Campaign Council unveiled President Bola Tinubu's Five-Year Strategic Defence Operations Plan, targeting 28,000 more soldiers and noting 15,000 terrorists and bandits killed in three years.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubus-five-year-defence-plan-ready-to-tackle-insecurity-apc-campaign-council/) reported that the APC Presidential Campaign Council announced that President Bola Tinubu's Five-Year Strategic Defence Operations Plan is ready to address insecurity.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-bayelsa-east-unites-for-tinubu-as-apc-stakeholders-strengthen-mobilisation/) reported that Niger Delta Development Commission Managing Director Samuel Ogbuku declared Bayelsa East's collective commitment to President Tinubu.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/benue-apc-crisis-caused-by-my-refusal-to-share-state-funds-alia/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Benue Governor Hyacinth Alia stated the APC crisis in the state resulted from his refusal to share state funds with party chieftains.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/akwa-ibom-2027-ex-minister-hails-enos-manifesto-development-blueprint/) reported that former Minister of Niger Delta Affairs Obong Umanah Okon Umanah praised Governor Umo Eno's Akwa Ibom development blueprint.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fct-stakeholders-condemn-attack-on-tinubus-convoy-vow-support-for-2027-re-election/) reported that the FCT Stakeholders Assembly condemned the attack on President Bola Tinubu's convoy at the Shehu Shagari Mosque in Abuja.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-aregbesola-met-three-times-despite-rift-apc-chieftain-prof-adeyeye/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that APC chieftain Professor Sola Adeyeye revealed that President Bola Tinubu and Rauf Aregbesola met three times despite their publicized political rift.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-apc-showcases-united-front-begins-fresh-mobilisation-for-tinubu-in-osun/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Osun State held a street rally in Osogbo to demonstrate its organizational strength.

On 14 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/deputy-speaker-kalu-charges-abia-apc-presidential-campaign-council-to-deliver-votes-for-tinubu-shettima/) reported that Deputy Speaker Kalu charged the Abia APC Presidential Campaign Council to deliver votes for Tinubu and Shettima.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-gombe-apc-targets-one-million-votes-for-tinubu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Gombe State APC pledged to deliver at least one million votes for President Bola Tinubu in 2027.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-osun-apc-leaders-rally-support-for-tinubus-re-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Osun APC leaders rallied support for President Bola Tinubu's re-election in 2027 and set a target of two million votes in the state.

On 14 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/benue-apc-rejects-akume-led-alliance-alleges-plot-against-alias-re-election/) reported that the Benue State chapter of the APC rejected the Strategic Alliance for Tinubu/Shettima Re-election 2027.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-eno-unveils-manifesto-targets-two-million-votes-for-tinubu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Akwa Ibom Governor Umo Eno unveiled his manifesto, pledging to deliver at least two million votes for President Bola Tinubu.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/apc-kwara-south-senatorial-candidate-adewoye-seeks-policies-to-protect-indigenous-investors/) reported that All Progressives Congress Kwara South senatorial candidate Prince Olalekan Adewoye called for policies to protect indigenous investors.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kwara-south-apcs-adewoye-advocates-improved-security-framework/) reported that APC candidate Prince Lekan Adewoye advocated an improved security framework for Kwara South.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/benue-north-east-court-declares-suswam-as-apc-valid-senatorial-candidate/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-court-affirms-suswams-victory-in-benue-apc-primary/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/benue-court-affirms-gabriel-suswam-as-winner-of-apc-senatorial-primary/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja declared former Governor of Benue Gabriel Suswam as the valid candidate of the All Progressives Congress for the senatorial primary.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/supreme-court-reserves-judgment-in-zamfara-north-apc-senatorial-dispute/) reported that the Supreme Court reserved judgment in the legal dispute concerning the All Progressives Congress primary election for Zamfara North.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741673-2027-election-court-takes-action-suit-challenging-cross-river-apc-candidate/) reported that a legal battle over the APC candidate in Cross River State took a new turn ahead of the 2027 election.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/emir-of-kano-congratulates-jaji-on-zamfara-apc-primary-victory/) reported that the Emir of Kano, Muhammadu Sanusi II, congratulated Aminu Sani Jaji on his victory in the Zamfara APC primary.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741398-just-sanusi-reacts-winner-emerges-apc-rerun-primary/) reported that the Tijjaniyya of Nigeria commented on the outcome of the APC's rerun National Assembly primary election.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/jaji-wins-zamfara-apc-rerun-primary-with-26646-votes/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741218-apc-announces-winner-zamfara-house-reps-rerun-primary/) reported that Aminu Sani Jaji won the All Progressives Congress court-ordered rerun primary in Zamfara State.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/criver-central-stakeholders-hail-affirmation-of-ewa-as-apc-primary-winner/) reported that APC stakeholders in Cross River State urged party members to unite behind Oden Ewa following affirmation of his primary win.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/13/court-affirms-oden-ewas-apc-senatorial-primary-victory/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja affirmed Oden Ewa as the APC candidate for the Cross River Central Senatorial District.
