reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sandzacka-demokratska-partija-podrzala-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine/d8q6zev) reported that the Sandžačka demokratska partija announced that its deputy Dženan Palamar will support the candidate Studentski for the president of the Assembly in tomorrow's vote.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/zavrsen-i-drugi-dan-zasjedanja-skupstine-srbije-vucic-moze-pricati-jos-10-dana/) reported that the second day of the National Assembly session concluded without electing a parliamentary president and will continue on Thursday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/potpuni-haos-na-kraju-dana-u-skupstini-srbije-vucic-pobjesnio-uslikaj-ih-sve-zapisi-ih-sve/261118290) reported that the session ended in uproar with Aleksandar Vučić demanding individuals be recorded and photographed.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucica-provocirao-novinar-pitanjem-o-bratu-andreju-dobio-zestok-odgovor-video/85h9d7t), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/tenzije-u-holu-skupstine-srbije-vucic-izgubio-nerve-nesreco-sram-te-bilo/) reported that tensions occurred in the lobby of the National Assembly involving Aleksandar Vučić and a journalist.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/vucic-rekao-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-ja-nisam-od-tih-imate-tu-kolega-drugih-koliko-hocete/261118157), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088957/video-vucic-tvrdi-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-nemam-nista-protiv-tih-ljudi-ali-nisam-od-njih) reported that Aleksandar Vučić told Studentska lista deputy Zlatko Kokanović during a session of the National Assembly not to send him kisses, alleging sexual harassment.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-o-sednici-skupstine-svojoj-imovini-i-vucicu/9tdz2vx) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, a candidate for president of the National Assembly from the Student List, announced plans to submit a property report following a parliamentary session where Aleksandar Vučić spoke for five hours.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kamberi-sda-ce-glasati-za-aleksandra-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/0lg50wn) reported that MP Shaip Kamberi stated the SDA will vote for Aleksandar Čupić as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oglasili-se-studenti-o-govoru-jugoslava-gasica-u-skupstini-srbije/wj1j0ls) reported that students from the Faculty of Media and Communications reacted on social media to criticism directed at Student List MP Jugoslav Gašić.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-nastavila-sjednicu-Minut-cutanja-za-pilota-Vucic-ponovo-govori/993001), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-bakic-sef-poslanicke-grupe-studentske-liste-bira-se-predsednik/dv39qz9) reported that the National Assembly of Serbia held a minute of silence for Serbian Air Force pilot Goran Bulajić during its constitutive session.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sara-valentik-studentska-lista-ocekujem-efikasniju-skupstinu-nakon-izbora-predsednika/4r7ggv4) reported that Student List youngest MP Sara Valentik stated she expects a more efficient National Assembly of Serbia following the election of a new parliament president.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Ko-je-Jovo-Bakic-novi-sef-poslanicke-grupe-Studentske-liste/992989) reported that Jovo Bakić, a 56-year-old sociology professor at the Faculty of Philosophy in Belgrade, became the head of the Student List parliamentary group in the new National Assembly of Serbia.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nastavak-konstitutivne-sednice-novog-saziva-skupstine-srbije/dv39qz9) reported that members of the 15th parliamentary session of the National Assembly of Serbia continued their constitutive session with discussions on candidates for assembly president.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/jovo-bakic-otkrio-ko-je-kandidat-studentske-liste-za-potpredsednika-skupstine-srbije/lhpd4cq) reported that Jovo Bakić, head of the Student List parliamentary group, held a press conference to reveal the candidate for vice president of the National Assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/lija-srdanovic-nakon-sednice-sutra-dobijamo-predsednika-skupstine/wd4r421) reported that Ilija Srdanović, the first on the Student List - Students Win list, stated after the National Assembly session that they will get a parliamentary president the next day and criticized Aleksandar Vučić.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/ana-brnabic-o-studentskoj-listi-posle-konstitutivne-sednice-skupstine-srbije-video/zf5qshz) reported that member of parliament Ana Brnabić spoke out after the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia regarding the Student List candidate for the presidency of the assembly.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/igor-dodik-o-programu-studentske-liste-republika-srpska-i-srbija-su-jedno-zajedno-smo-jaci/261116356) reported that SNSD general secretary Igor Dodik stated on X that Republika Srpska and Serbia are one and stronger together in reaction to the Studentska lista program.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/ovo-je-govor-jugoslava-gasica-aleksandar-cupic-predlozen-za-predsednika-skupstine/g9e9h7z) reported that Student List member of parliament Jugoslav Gašić nominated Aleksandar Čupić for the presidency of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/polemika-u-skupstini-o-izvinjenju-lidiji-vukicevic/0dp5872) reported that National Assembly presiding officer Stojan Radenović and parliamentary group leader Aleksandar Vučić called on Student List deputies to oppose all violence during a parliamentary debate.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/od-profesora-do-kandidata-za-celo-parlamenta-ko-je-aleksandar-cupic/) reported profiles of figures discussed for the presidency of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Vucic-vise-od-sat-i-po-govorio-u-Skupstini-Bakic-mu-uzvratio/992887), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-bakic-reagovao-na-obracanje-vucica/jzw7gwg) reported that the National Assembly of Serbia was constituted and commenced discussions on parliamentary leadership.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/kcerka-legendarnog-fudbalera-dragana-dzajica-polozila-zakletvu-u-skupstini-srbije-ispred-sns-a/261117197), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088724/kcerka-fudbalera-dragana-dzajica-ponovo-u-skupstini-srbije-polozila-poslanicku-zakletvu-kao-predstavnica-sns-a) reported that Sanja Džajić took the oath of office as a Member of Parliament in the new convocation of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-bira-predsjednika-U-trci-dva-kandidata/992845) reported that two proposals were submitted for the president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/konstituisanjem-skupstine-poceo-da-tece-rok-od-90-dana-za-izbor-nove-vlade-srbije/4f2sb64) reported that the 90-day legal deadline to form a new government in Serbia began with the constitution of the new National Assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-se-obraca-u-skupstini-srbije-jovo-bakic-negoduje/j4mp6l7) reported that Aleksandar Vučić addressed the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/aleksandar-cupic-predlozen-za-novog-predsjednika-skupstine-srbije-preuzet-ce-i-ulogu-vd-predsjednika-drzave/261117138) reported that the Studentska lista nominated Aleksandar Čupić for president of the National Assembly of Serbia, and he stated he was ready to take on the role of acting head of state.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/saznajemo-jovo-bakic-sef-poslanicke-grupe-studentske-liste/0tn5tb9) reported that Jovo Bakić was chosen as the head of the Studentska lista parliamentary group.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088667/stojan-radenovic-je-kandidat-sns-a-za-predsjednika-skupstine-srbije) reported that Stojan Radenović is the SNS candidate for president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088574/pocela-konstituirajuca-sjednica-skupstine-srbije-studentska-lista-sa-140-mandata-preuzima-vecinu), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-prenos-uzivo-studentska-lista-i-sns-prvi-put-oci-u-oci/jzw7gwg) reported that the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia began with Studentska lista taking 140 mandates to form a majority, and deputies taking the oath.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/u-srbiji-se-danas-bira-novi-predsjednik-skupstine-on-ce-postati-i-vd-predsjednika-drzave-dva-imena-u-igri/261117004) reported that the first session of the 15th National Assembly of Serbia begins with confirming the mandates of deputies and electing the president and vice-presidents of the assembly.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/pristalice-studentskog-pokreta-okupile-se-u-pionirskom-parku-pred-sednicu-skupstine/16y8h3e) reported that supporters of the student movement gathered in Pionirski park to follow Studentska lista candidates before they went to the National Assembly for the constitutive session.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088545/uz-ovacije-i-posebnu-pjesmu-poslanici-studentske-liste-iz-pionirskog-parka-ulaze-skupstinu) reported that Studentska lista deputies entered the National Assembly from Pionirski park after mandate confirmation and taking the oath.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Vucic-Niko-me-nije-zvao-sam-sam-sprecio-gradjanski-rat-VIDEO/992700) reported that Aleksandar Vučić rejected claims that he was under European Union pressure and stated he prevented civil war on his own.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-otkrio-da-li-ga-je-neko-zvao-u-izbornoj-noci/cx05g9p) reported that SNS leader Aleksandar Vučić denied allegations that any diplomat called him on election night to prevent violence.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/privreda/kako-funkcionisu-razvojne-banke-i-sta-predlaze-studentska-lista-za-srbiju/vr5n9ec) reported that Studentska lista has proposed creating a development bank for Serbia through the transformation of the Development Fund and the Agency for Export Insurance and Financing.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/studentska-lista-najavila-reviziju-ugovora-o-nabavci-oruzja-za-vojsku-srbije-i-vece-plate/261116178) reported that Studentska lista representative Luka Ponorac stated all active procurement contracts for the Serbian Armed Forces will be reviewed.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/dva-imena-sa-studentske-liste-u-trci-za-novog-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/pbkg9lk) reported that two names from Studentska lista are mentioned as potential candidates for the president of the parliament ahead of the constitutive session of the National Assembly.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sutra-konstitutivna-sednica-skupstine-srbije-ovo-je-dnevni-red/5ls62nq) reported that the constitutive session of the new convocation of the National Assembly of Serbia will be held tomorrow to confirm mandates and elect parliamentary leadership.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oliver-toskovic-sa-studentske-liste-otkrio-da-imaju-ime-predsednika-skupstine/keqptp7) reported that Oliver Tošković stated personnel solutions exist and the assembly expects to receive a speaker.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/privreda/studentska-lista-subvencije-na-vreme-zabrana-otkupa-ispod-cene-proizvodnje/k43t201) reported that the Students' List program proposed changing agricultural financing methods, stricter rules for buyers and warehouse operators, and protecting producers.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sta-je-plan-studentske-liste-za-odnos-sa-srbima-u-regionu/jthbrfd) reported that the Students' List program for Serbs in the region outlines preserving the constitutional status and powers of Republika Srpska.

stories.title: ADC campaign accuses INEC of bias, demands postponement of mock election test
stories.label: Nigerian opposition political alliance talks

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-pcc-asks-inec-to-postpone-mock-accreditation-faults-irev-plan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-faults-inec-over-short-notice-for-mock-accreditation-exercise/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/adc-pcc-demands-postponement-of-inecs-november-28-mock-accreditation-exercise-alleges-bias/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council asked the Independent National Electoral Commission to postpone its mock accreditation exercise, citing short notice and alleging bias.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742114-2027-election-inec-takes-decision-retaining-atiku-final-list-adc-crisis/) reported that INEC provisionally retained Atiku Abubakar on the final presidential candidate list amid the ADC leadership crisis.

On 16 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c6gre02g5g0vo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that African Democratic Congress vice-presidential candidate Rotimi Amaechi alleged a plan by the EFCC to arrest him before the 2027 election.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-crisis-gombe-seeks-truce-with-atiku-mark/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a factional ADC leader, Nafiu Gombe, called for reconciliation with Atiku Abubakar and David Mark after a court nullified their leadership structure.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741389-just-amaechi-mentions-states-atiku-tinubu-win-2027/) reported that ADC vice presidential candidate Rotimi Amaechi rolled out the number of states Atiku Abubakar will defeat President Bola Tinubu in during the 2027 general elections.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130469.html) reported that Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde stated he believes his presidential ambition may have upset President Bola Tinubu.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925101-2027-atiku-obi-making-victory-easy-for-tinubu-sule-lamido.html) reported that former Jigawa governor Sule Lamido stated that Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi are making victory easy for the ruling party by maintaining a divided opposition.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130488.html) reported that the Enugu government spoke regarding allegations that Governor Peter Mbah directed the chairperson of the Enugu State Tourism Board to deny Peter Obi and the NDC the use of a campaign venue.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/politics-shouldnt-make-us-enemies-tinubu-tells-atiku-obi-others/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu condemned the violent attacks trailing political campaigns across the country.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-obi-atiku-handing-victory-to-apc-lamido/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that former Jigawa governor Sule Lamido stated that the failure of Peter Obi and Atiku Abubakar to unite is handing an easy victory to the APC ahead of 2027.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/opposition-actively-discussing-alliance-for-2027-polls-makinde/) reported that Allied Peoples Movement presidential candidate Seyi Makinde disclosed that active discussions on a possible alliance ahead of the 2027 polls are underway.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ill-back-atiku-or-obi-to-defeat-tinubu-makinde/) reported that Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde declared his readiness to work with Atiku Abubakar or Peter Obi to defeat President Bola Tinubu in 2027.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186174-witkoff-kushner-to-attend-coalition-of-the-willing-summit-in-berlin.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90536) reported that US President Donald Trump's special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will attend the Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/pdp-delegation-visits-injured-apc-leaders-at-gombe-hospital/) reported that a Gombe State Peoples Democratic Party delegation visited injured APC leaders at a Gombe hospital.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-approves-establishment-of-inland-dry-port-in-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved the establishment of an inland dry port in Kebbi State following a request by Governor Nasir Idris.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/tinubu-courts-kebbi-support-for-2nd-term-approves-inland-dry-port/) reported that President Bola Tinubu wooed Kebbi voters with development pledges, including approval for an inland dry port.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/1-killed-6-injured-in-road-crash-involving-gombe-apc-leaders/) reported that one person was killed and six others injured in a road accident involving Gombe State APC leaders.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/kebbi-apc-rally-tinubu-approves-dry-inland-port-for-kebbi-seeks-support-for-apc-in-2027/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-approves-kebbi-inland-dry-port-promises-completion-of-landmark-projects-improved-security/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/at-apc-presidential-rally-in-birnin-kebbi-tinubu-approves-inland-dry-port-for-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved the operationalisation of the Tsamiya Inland Dry Port in Kebbi State.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/two-die-gombe-apc-chairman-campaign-dg-injured-in-crash/) reported that Gombe State Chairman of the All Progressives Congress Mohammed Dantata Ndus and the director-general of the party's 2027 governorship campaign were injured in a vehicle crash while two people died.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-apc-supporters-throng-kebbi-stadium-for-tinubus-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu's presidential rally in Kebbi State attracted a massive crowd of APC supporters and party loyalists.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/yilwatda-charges-north-central-apc-leaders-to-unite-for-tinubu/) reported that All Progressives Congress National Chairman Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda charged North-Central leaders, governors, and candidates to unite for Tinubu.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/925054-zamfara-stands-still-as-gov-lawal-hosts-first-lady-remi-tinubu-for-mega-rally.html) reported that Zamfara State Governor Dauda Lawal hosted First Lady Oluremi Tinubu for a mega rally.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ondo-apc-declares-unity-vows-to-deliver-tinubu-candidates-in-2027/) reported that the Ondo State chapter of the All Progressives Congress declared its readiness for the 2027 general elections.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130113.html) AllAfrica reported that Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu and his predecessor Akinwunmi Ambode sought voters' support for President Bola Tinubu.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-ondo-apc-to-sustain-grassroots-mobilisation-after-tinubus-rally-campaign-dg-olabimtan/) reported that Ondo State APC Campaign Director-General Victor Olabimtan stated that the party will sustain grassroots mobilization following President Bola Tinubu's rally.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/924776-2027-tompolo-leads-grassroots-mobilisation-for-tinubu-in-jigawa-zamfara-unveils-56-vehicles.html), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130111.html) reported that Tompolo led grassroots mobilisation for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu in Jigawa and Zamfara by unveiling 56 vehicles.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-yayi-realised-his-looming-defeat-the-day-adebutu-returned-to-the-ballot-pdp-natl-sec/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-yayi-jittery-over-adebutus-return-to-ballot-pdp-natl-sec/) reported that PDP National Secretary Samuel Anyanwu claimed that Ogun APC members joined the PDP and stated opponents are jittery over Adebutu's return.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ogun-2027-pdp-presents-governorship-flag-to-adebutu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP National Secretary Samuel Anyanwu presented the party's governorship flag to Ladi Adebutu at Ake Palace.

On 18 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/abia-pdp-guber-candidate-anosike-promises-to-tackle-water-borne-diseases/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party governorship candidate in Abia State, Dr. Kelechi Anosike, promised to build 552 solar-powered boreholes to tackle water-borne diseases.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-ekiti-deputy-gov-mobilises-traditional-rulers-politicians-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that Ekiti State Deputy Governor Monisade Afuye rallied traditional rulers across the state to support President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s re-election.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ekiti-deputy-gov-mobilises-monarchs-pdp-members-for-tinubus-re-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ekiti State Deputy Governor Monisade Afuye intensified mobilization efforts seeking support from traditional rulers and PDP members for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-pdp-may-not-win-single-ward-ogun-apc/) reported that the Ogun State chapter of the All Progressives Congress dismissed claims by the Peoples Democratic Party that it would win every ward.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-2027-pdp-apc-clash-over-adebutus-chances/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party and the All Progressives Congress in Ogun State exchanged words over the 2027 gubernatorial chances.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/ekiti-pdp-seeks-probe-of-attack-on-ex-dep-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party in Ekiti State called on police and security agencies to investigate an alleged attack on its 2026 deputy governorship candidate.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jigawa-needs-a-listening-leader-says-pdp-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP governorship candidate in Jigawa, Mustapha Sule Lamido, stated the state needs a listening leader rather than a furious one ahead of the 2027 elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adebutu-ogun-apc-guber-aspirant-hails-court-judgment/) reported that Ogun State All Progressives Congress governorship aspirant Abayomi Hunye congratulated the Peoples Democratic Party's governorship candidate following a court judgment.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/gov-oyebanji-rallies-apc-candidates-promises-campaign-support-assures-members-of-political-inclusion/) reported that Ekiti State Governor Biodun Oyebanji reaffirmed his commitment to strengthening the APC and promised full logistical support for upcoming elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adebutu-hunye-hails-court-judgment-says-its-victory-for-democracy/) reported that Hunye described a court judgment regarding Adebutu as a victory for democracy and justice for Ogun State.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/pdp-celebrates-as-adebutu-floors-inec/) reported that a court ordered the Independent National Electoral Commission to publish Oladipupo Adebutu as the Peoples Democratic Party governorship candidate.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-katsina-pdp-gov-candidate-promises-free-medical-treatment-for-residents/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP governorship candidate in Katsina, Yakubu Lado Danmarke, promised to introduce free healthcare services for residents if elected in 2027.

On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130470.html) reported that following a boost to Ladi Adebutu's candidacy, the Peoples Democratic Party vowed to reclaim Ogun State in the 2027 gubernatorial election.

On 14 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutu-as-pdp-candidate-says-commission-lacks-powers-to-disqualify-him/) reported that Justice Peter Lifu of the Federal High Court ordered INEC to publish Adebutu as the PDP candidate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/inec-to-obey-court-on-atikus-adc-candidacy-amupitan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-inec-will-obey-court-ruling-on-atikus-candidacy-amupitan/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan stated the commission will abide by the final court decision on Atiku Abubakar's presidential candidacy under the ADC.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name-says-commission-lacks-powers-to-unilaterally-remove-candidates/) The Sun reported that the Federal High Court ruled that INEC has no power to unilaterally disqualify a candidate and ordered it to publish Adebutu's name.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-2027-pdp-celebrates-adebutu-ruling-vows-to-reclaim-state/) reported that the PDP in Ogun State celebrated the Adebutu ruling and vowed to reclaim the state.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/driver-absconds-with-employers-n45m-suv-caught-within-hours-in-ogun/) reported that a driver who allegedly absconded with his employer's Lexus 460 SUV in Ogun was caught within hours.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/court-orders-inec-to-reinstate-adebutu-as-ogun-pdp-guber-candidate-within-24-hours/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja ordered INEC to publish Oladipupo Adebutu's name as the PDP governorship candidate within 24 hours.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name/) reported that the Federal High Court ruled that INEC had no power to unilaterally disqualify a candidate from contesting.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/money-cant-buy-peoples-conscience-says-sowunmi-kolapo/) reported that Ogun State PDP deputy governorship candidate Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo stated money cannot buy people's conscience.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adebutu-knows-fate-today-as-court-gives-judgment-on-his-exclusion-from-inec-list/) reported that the Federal High Court fixed Friday to deliver judgment in the suit filed by the PDP.

On 13 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/imo-east-senatorial-candidacy-court-orders-ndc-to-submit-uche-nwoles-name-to-inec/) reported that Justice Mohammed Umar of the Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the Nigeria Democratic Congress to submit Uche Nwole's name to INEC for the Imo East senatorial candidacy.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-money-cant-buy-ogun-voters-says-pdp-deputy-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP deputy governorship candidate Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo stated money politics will not suppress voter will in the 2027 election.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/just-in-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name-as-ogun-pdp-gov-candidate/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-court-orders-inec-to-reinstate-adebutu-as-ogun-pdp-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered INEC to reinstate Ladi Adebutu as the PDP governorship candidate for Ogun State within 24 hours.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/captura-trillizos-colombianos-ee-uu-ice-advierte-tener-solicitud-pendiente-no-da-estatus-legal-FD43738904) reported that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement issued a warning after detaining 19-year-old Colombian triplets, stating that a pending application grants no legal status.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/esta-es-la-enfermedad-que-padece-la-mama-de-los-trillizos-colombianos-detenidos-por-ice-en-ee-uu-fue-sometida-a-una-cirugia-y-esta-en-recuperacion-3602082) reported that family testimony indicated the 19-year-old individuals arrived in the United States to provide financial support for their recovering mother.

On 18 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/que-hay-detras-de-la-inquietante-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-nid18112026/) reported that a succession of technology disruptions in airlines, banks, and intelligence networks exposed digital vulnerabilities in the United States.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/marco-rubio-hablo-sobre-las-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-y-descarto-interferencia-extranjera-no-estamos-bajo-un-ataque-cibernetico-3601898) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that technology outages affecting Microsoft, Chase, airlines, and the NSA were unrelated and not caused by a foreign cyberattack.

On 18 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/la-caida-de-la-red-secreta-de-la-nsa-se-suma-a-una-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-coincidencia-o-amenaza-cibernetica-3601808) reported that disruptions in bank and technology platform services coincided with cyberattacks affecting approximately 200 websites.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-hit-sudden-system-outage/) reported that United Airlines suffered a widespread system outage that left planes unable to take off.
On 16 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2219263) reported that a major outage hit United Airlines affecting a system related to flight departures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/drama-na-americkim-aerodromima-pao-sistem-united-airlinesa/npgmhe1) reported that United Airlines confirmed a system failure occurred on Monday afternoon.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/jpmorgan-chase-atribuye-los-fallos-a-un-error-de-software-y-descarta-un-ciberataque-33166828) reported that JPMorgan Chase attributed banking service outages affecting thousands of customers to a software error and ruled out a cyberattack.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/united-airlines-reporta-interrupcion-generalizada-sus-sistemas_202611176afb8b9903bbf30bb04e2f1a.html) reported that United Airlines experienced a widespread system disruption in the United States attributed to instability in communications and radar systems.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/united-airlines-restablece-sistema-tras-falla-tecnologica-interrupcion-provoco-retrasos-en-vuelos/) reported that on November 13 the FAA ordered flights to remain on the ground because a new router failed and saturated the system.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-system-outage) reported that United Airlines acknowledged a technology issue that delayed flight departures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/united-airlines-hit-by-widespread-system-outage-days-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupted-us-air-travel-101794867751137.html) reported that the carrier clarified the issue was not affecting flights already in the air or services operated by United Express.

On 16 Nov 2026, [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/united-airlines-reports-widespread-outage-just-days-after-nationwide-ground-stop/CHU2RQYJERCJNHQAEB4INTZEGY/) reported that old network equipment was overloaded, disrupting 17 of 22 major control centres.

On 16 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/united-airlines-resolves-tech-outage-that-delayed-flights/a-79964387?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that United Airlines said a system outage that delayed departures has been resolved.

On 17 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219271), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that there was no indication that the United Airlines electronic system outage was a cybersecurity-related issue.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/article-915107) reported that there was no indication that United's outage was connected to the Federal Aviation Administration shutdown.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/united-airlines-relata-falha-generalizada-dias-depois-da-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.ghtml) reported that United Airlines reported a widespread system outage days after nationwide flight cancellations due to technical problems.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-recupera-la-normalidad-aerea-tras-miles-de-cancelaciones-y-una-falla-en-el-sistema-de-nid16112026/) reported that more than 18,000 flights were canceled and 28,000 suffered delays over three days due to an FAA router issue before normal operations resumed.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/estados-unidos-united-airlines-reporta-falla-generalizada-sistemas_0_H77eHnDPQG.html) reported that United Airlines reported a generalized failure in its systems days after the national flight suspension.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/sitios-de-bancos-en-eeuu-presentan-fallos-pero-no-hay-ciberataque-segun-jpmorgan-chase_0_gtsuRx0yIe.html) reported that JPMorgan Chase stated there was no ciberattack despite users reporting banking app failures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/bancos-de-eu-reportan-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso/) reported that Zelle also registered interruptions in its transfer services alongside bank platform issues.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/se-desploman-las-acciones-de-grandes-bancos-en-wall-street-tras-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-en-estados-unidos-3601471) reported that shares of JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Capital One registered losses on Wall Street following digital platform failures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/chase-bank-of-america-us-bank-and-wells-fargo-among-banks-down-today-users-report-mobile-banking-outages-101794855031957.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/caida-de-bancos-en-estados-unidos-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo-presentan-fallas-en-sus-servicios-digitales-3601448), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso-a-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo_0_giCFGzhtEk.html) reported that users of Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and US Bank experienced digital service outages and difficulties accessing online accounts.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/aeroportos-dos-eua-comecam-a-voltar-a-normalidade-apos-caos-aereo-mas-ainda-ha-atrasos.shtml) reported that the US aviation sector began returning to normality following three days of cancellations and delays caused by a system outage.

On 15 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/voos-nos-eua-devem-ser-normalizados-ate-o-fim-de-domingo-promete-faa-passageiros-ainda-devem-enfrentar-transtornos.ghtml) reported that the FAA administrator promised US flights would be normalized by Sunday evening.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/14/caos-nos-eua-mais-de-12-mil-voos-foram-cancelados-entre-sexta-feira-e-sabado.ghtml) reported that official FlightAware data showed more than 12,000 flights were cancelled between Friday and Saturday in the United States.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/troca-de-cabos-causou-suspensao-que-cancelou-mais-de-16-mil-voos-nos-eua.shtml) reported that a cable swap caused a suspension that cancelled more than 16,000 flights in the United States.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7322457-anac-sete-voos-previstos-para-os-eua-foram-cancelados-e-14-atrasaram.html) reported that the head of the US Federal Aviation Administration forecasted between 4,000 and 5,000 flight cancellations on Saturday.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-strategist-denies-4-5m-payment-for-tinubu-interview/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that American political strategist Diana London denied receiving 4.5 million dollars from the Nigerian government or anyone else in the country.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/american-strategist-deletes-posts-on-tinubu-nigeria-us-security-ties/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/american-strategist-deletes-posts-on-tinubu-nigeria-us-security-partnership/) reported that American political strategist Diana London deleted her social media posts regarding her engagement with the Nigerian government and security ties.

stories.label: APC campaign council political violence condemnation

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-apc-inaugurates-anambra-campaign-council-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that the Anambra State chapter of the All Progressives Congress inaugurated its campaign council for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's reelection bid.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741002-apc-support-group-targets-15-million-votes-tinubu-kano-2027/) reported that an APC support group inaugurated coordinators across Kano's 44 local government areas targeting votes for Tinubu and other candidates.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndc-campaign-council-fires-back-says-apc-spreading-agbero-politics-nationwide/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council accused the APC of exporting 'agbero' politics nationwide.

On 18 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/december-15-for-hearing-in-kano-governors-divorce-suit/) reported that an Upper Area Court in Abuja fixed December 15 for a hearing in the divorce suit filed against Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf by his estranged wife.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741994-breaking-court-takes-action-gov-yusuf-kwankwasos-daughter/) reported that the Upper Area Court in Abuja issued a statement regarding the divorce saga of Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf and his wife Zainab.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741945-atiku-campaign-aide-reacts-kano-governor-divorce-controversy/) reported that an Atiku campaign aide criticised Kano Governor Abba Yusuf over his public divorce announcement and dismissed claims linking Kwankwaso to the marriage crisis.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/court-adjourns-kano-governors-divorce-case-to-december-15/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Upper Area Court in Gudu District, Abuja, adjourned the divorce case involving Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf and his second wife till December 15.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c6zxvd27e9lvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-gov-confirms-divorce-from-kwankwasos-niece-hints-at-remarrying/) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf confirmed his divorce from Zainab Musa Kwankwaso and thanked citizens for advice regarding marriage.

On 17 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/governor-yusuf-divorces-wife-kwankwasos-daughter-declares-he-is-open-to-marriage/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/925753-kano-governor-confirms-dissolution-of-20-year-marriage-with-kwankwasos-niece.html) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf confirmed the dissolution of his 20-year marriage to Zainab Kwankwaso.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-ypp-presidential-candidate-condemns-attacks-on-obi-kwankwaso/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Young Progressives Party presidential candidate Peter Agada condemned attacks on the presidential campaign convoys of the Nigeria Democratic Congress.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kano-govt-kwankwasiyya-movement-clash-over-attack-on-kwankwasos-convoy/) reported that the Kano government and the Kwankwasiyyah Movement were locked in a verbal war over an alleged attack on Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso's convoy.

On 17 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/on-presidential-directive-police-release-78-suspects-who-attacked-tinubus-convoy/) reported that the Federal Capital Territory Police Command confirmed a presidential directive to release 78 suspects who attacked Tinubu’s convoy.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/presidencys-denial-crumbles-as-police-confirm-attack-on-tinubus-convoy-arrest-78/) reported that the Federal Capital Territory Police Command commenced the release of 78 suspects arrested over an attack on President Bola Tinubu's motorcade.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-pardons-78-convoy-attack-suspects-police-arrest-8-over-kwankwaso-assault/) reported that President Bola Tinubu granted presidential clemency to 78 suspects arrested over an attack on his motorcade in Abuja while police arrested eight over an assault on Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ndc-condemns-attack-on-kwankwaso-demands-arrest-of-perpetrators/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/ndc-decries-attack-on-kwankwaso-demands-arrest-of-perpetrators-sponsors/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress condemned the attack on its vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso and demanded the arrest of perpetrators and sponsors.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/ssouth-east/925535-peter-obi-demands-prosecution-of-thugs-who-attacked-kwankwaso.html), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/obi-demands-arrest-of-attackers-of-kwankwasos-convoy-in-kano/) reported that Peter Obi called for an immediate investigation and the arrest of thugs who attacked Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso's convoy in Kano State.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741514-breaking-thugs-attack-kwankwasos-convoy-smash-vehicles/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kwankwasos-convoy-attacked-by-suspected-political-thugs-in-kano/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/thugs-attack-kwankwaso-gwarzo-campaign-convoy-in-kano-smash-vehicles/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/kwankwasos-convoy-attacked-in-kano-obi/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that suspected thugs attacked Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso's campaign convoy in Bichi, injuring team members and smashing vehicles.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/kano-commissioner-dismisses-attack-on-kwankwasos-convoy/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Kano State Commissioner for Information dismissed reports of the attack as fictitious.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/democracy-is-not-warfare-peter-obi-condemns-kwankwaso-convoy-attack/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kwankwasos-convoy-attack-peter-obi-calls-for-probe-arrest-of-perpetrators/) reported that Peter Obi condemned the attack and called for an investigation and arrest of the perpetrators.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741412-kano-state-governors-wife-divorce-saga-sparks-arrests/) reported that arrests followed the divorce saga involving Kano Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf's wife, Zainab.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/kano-govs-wife-divorce-saga-sparks-arrests/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the divorce crisis between Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf and his wife Zainab led to the arrest of three security personnel.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kwankwasos-daughter-seeks-divorce-from-kano-gov-offers-to-refund-dowry/) reported that Zainab Kwankwaso sought a divorce from the Kano governor, citing a lack of emotional connection and offering to refund the dowry.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741381-kano-kwankwasos-daughter-seeks-divorce-gov-yusuf-reason/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925169-kwankwasos-niece-files-to-divorce-kano-governor-report.html) reported that Kano Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf was summoned to appear before an Abuja court after a divorce filing by his wife.

stories.title: Who Is Rotimi Okpaise? Meet interim leader of Fountain of Life Church
stories.label: Fountain of Life Church leadership dispute

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741982-pastor-rotimi-okpaise-facts-fountain-lifes-interim-leader/) reported that Pastor Rotimi Okpaise was appointed as interim leader of the Fountain of Life Church following the alleged removal of Jimmy Odukoya.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/meet-kunle-areogun-taiwo-odukoyas-preferred-successor/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-who-is-kunle-areogun-late-pastor-odukoyas-preferred-successor/) reported that Pastor Kunle Areogun has emerged at the center of The Fountain of Life Church leadership crisis as the late Pastor Taiwo Odukoya's preferred successor.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/jimmy-odukoya-inside-the-fountain-of-life-leadership-crisis/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that two groups within The Fountain of Life Church are making competing claims over the leadership of the Lagos-based ministry following an announcement.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-board-accuses-jimmy-odukoya-of-hijacking-churchs-social-media-accounts/) reported that the Board of Trustees of the Fountain of Life Church accused Pastor Jimmy Odukoya of hijacking the church's social media accounts.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-church-appoints-rotimi-okpaise-as-interim-leader/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741904-alleged-jimmy-odukoya-removal-fountain-life-trustees-interim-leader/) reported that the Board of Trustees of The Fountain of Life Church appointed Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim leader.

On 17 Nov 2026, [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/fountain-of-life-church-in-fresh-dispute-over-jimmy-odukoyas-removal/) reported that a statement was posted on the Fountain of Life Church's platform hours after the announcement regarding Pastor Jimmy Odukoya's removal as Senior Pastor.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/jimmy-odukoya-removed-as-senior-pastor-of-fountain-of-life-church/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/just-in-fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741750-breaking-fountain-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-senior-pastor/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/fountain-of-life-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-fountain-of-life-church-removes-jimmy-odukoya-as-senior-pastor/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Board of Trustees of the Fountain of Life Church in Lagos removed Pastor Jimmy Odukoya as its senior pastor, citing the late founder Taiwo Odukoya's recorded instructions and succession arrangements.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cmqlq5xn3yl5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Punch](https://punchng.com/jimmy-odukoyas-removal-invalid-says-fountain-of-life-church/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-rejects-jimmy-odukoyas-removal/) reported that the Fountain of Life Church rejected reports alleging that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya had been removed as its senior pastor, describing the decision as invalid.

stories.title: Imran Khan seeks urgent medical care fearing he 'may not return alive'
stories.label: Imran Khan sisters released from jail

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640983/ihc-orders-medical-care-for-bushra-bibi-in-jail-amid-eyesight-concerns), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045411/ps190m-corruption-case-ihc-directs-proper-medical-care-hygienic-living-conditions-for-bushra-bibi) reported that the Islamabad High Court directed prison authorities to ensure proper medical care and hygienic living conditions for Bushra Bibi.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045191/8-pakistan-bar-council-members-call-on-judiciary-to-take-note-of-imrans-plea-for-medical-treatment) reported that eight members of the Pakistan Bar Council called upon the judiciary to ensure implementation of the Supreme Court's order regarding Imran Khan's medical treatment.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxNUm9CVHJndDZlZ0dWQk9mbGJyNmNRcmpsVHRmM3IwYkxtUjl0UFlkUXhyVHNMTjhMSGNnQ0Z1NEd5UmlselRYUUxvQ2ctTV81SEhEMEtWcFU4eDh2NDZxNDZDZXJxOEJKbW5CZnZPME1vUlRKakhiNXNsZ05JV09Ial9ybEl6VDUxOHNHNFVld1JEaGZoWEdVcVY5NkxRQ19yQ1JCMXJ6MXpHcUVYdFdRU1VmT3MxNTZBbEtscW5zVnJVLVQz?oc=5) reported that Azma Bokhari called Imran Khan's medical concerns propaganda.

stories.title: Brazil fiscal adjustment bill approval

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/noticia/2026/11/18/pena-maior-para-quem-matar-dirigindo-sob-efeito-de-alcool-e-aprovada-no-senado-e-projeto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill increasing penalties for homicide and serious bodily injury caused by drunk drivers, sending the project to the Chamber.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/chefe-da-articulacao-politica-diz-que-governo-acertou-com-motta-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-na-camara-ate-terca-feira.ghtml) reported that Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães stated he agreed with Chamber President Hugo Motta to vote on the fiscal package in the Chamber by Tuesday.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-teto-para-compensacao-previdenciaria-a-estados-e-municipios-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate maintained the provision in the fiscal adjustment project limiting social security compensation transfers to states and municipalities to 3 billion reals per year between 2027 and 2030.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-restricao-ao-uso-de-creditos-tributarios-por-empresas-em-projeto-do-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Senate kept the section of the fiscal adjustment package authorizing the government to restrict companies from using tax credits for settlements.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mudancas-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Senate resumed discussion of the government's fiscal adjustment project after it was postponed due to a lack of agreement.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/lauro-jardim/post/2026/11/julgamento-dos-beneficios-fiscais-da-atem-volta-a-estaca-zero-no-stf-e-pressao-cresce.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court Minister Luiz Fux requested a review of the direct unconstitutionality action regarding tax benefits for the Manaus Free Trade Zone benefiting Atem.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/ala-bolsonarista-do-pl-ve-gesto-eleitoreiro-de-motta-e-alcolumbre-ao-pedir-a-moraes-julgamento-sobre-lei-que-beneficia-bolsonaro.ghtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323484-motta-e-alcolumbre-pedem-a-moraes-julgamento-da-lei-da-dosimetria.html) reported that Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre asked Supreme Federal Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to judge the sentencing reduction law for January 8 prisoners this year.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/governo-conta-votos-e-aposta-em-articulacao-de-alcolumbre-para-concluir-votacao-de-ajuste-fiscal-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva government is working to secure votes to conclude the fiscal adjustment package vote in the Senate with the backing of Davi Alcolumbre.

On 18 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/sem-acordo-entenda-o-que-travou-a-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Senate postponed concluding the vote on President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's fiscal measures package due to a lack of agreement with the opposition and guaranteed votes.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/alcolumbre-diz-que-tem-votos-para-concluir-votacao-do-ajuste-fiscal-nesta-quarta-feira.ghtml) reported that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated there are enough votes to conclude the fiscal adjustment package vote.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/17/janones-rebate-criticas-apos-defender-governo-se-alguns-se-acham-mais-inteligentes-que-lula-parabens-nao-e-meu-caso.ghtml) reported that federal deputy André Janones rebuffed criticism after defending the government.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lula-deve-divulgar-video-defendendo-pacote-fiscal-apos-criticas-da-esquerda.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is set to release a video defending the fiscal adjustment package proposed by his government.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323396-congresso-pede-que-stf-julgue-lei-que-beneficia-condenados-pelo-8-1.html) reported that the presidents of the Chamber and the Senate met with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to request judgment on a law benefiting those convicted for the January 8 events.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/17/ministros-do-stf-avaliam-que-moraes-deve-liberar-julgamento-de-acao-que-pode-reduzir-pena-de-bolsonaro-apos-reuniao-com-motta-e-alcolumbre.ghtml) reported that expectations in the Supreme Federal Court are that Minister Alexandre de Moraes will soon release for trial actions questioning the constitutionality regarding Bolsonaro's sentence following a meeting with Motta and Alcolumbre.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lula-se-reune-com-ministro-do-trabalho-para-acertar-detalhes-de-decreto-sobre-fim-da-escala-6x1.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Minister of Labor and Employment Luiz Marinho at the Alvorada Palace in Brasília to settle details on a decree regarding the end of the 6x1 work scale.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323312-dino-decide-que-escala-5x2-sera-julgada-de-forma-definitiva-pelo-stf.html) reported that Justice Dino decided that the 5x2 scale will be judged definitively by the Supreme Federal Court after the court's virtual plenary initiated evaluation to endorse the minister's injunction.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/dino-estabelece-prazos-em-acao-sobre-escala-6x1-e-julgamento-no-plenario-do-stfpode-ocorrer-em-duas-semanas.ghtml) reported that Justice Flávio Dino opened new deadlines for Congress, the Prosecutor General's Office, and the Attorney General's Office in a lawsuit regarding the 6x1 work scale.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/lider-do-governo-no-congresso-apresenta-projeto-para-taxar-big-techs-meio-a-ajuste-fiscal.ghtml) reported that government leader in Congress Senator Randolfe Rodrigues presented a bill to tax big tech companies.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/o-deputado-que-mais-se-destacou-nas-redes-com-criticas-ao-ajuste-fiscal-de-lula-segundo-relatorio-para-ebc.ghtml) reported that elected deputy Jones Manoel gained prominence on social media by criticizing the Lula government's fiscal adjustment package.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/governo-tira-urgencia-de-projeto-que-criminaliza-exploracao-das-bets-para-viabilizar-votacao-de-pacote-fiscal-na-camara.ghtml) reported that the government removed urgency from a bill criminalising sports betting exploitation to facilitate the voting of the fiscal package.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/pacote-fiscal-motta.ghtml) reported that Chamber of President Hugo Motta stated the fiscal package will be voted on Tuesday if the Senate concludes its analysis.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/pt-define-que-votara-a-favor-do-pacote-fiscal-do-governo-lula-na-camara-apos-criticas-e-cobranca-do-planalto.ghtml) reported that the Workers' Party caucus in the Chamber defined that it will vote in favor of the government's fiscal adjustment project.

On 17 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/ministro-do-planejamento-deve-se-reunir-hoje-com-deputados-do-pt-para-tentar-reduzir-criticas-ao-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that Planning Minister Bruno Moretti was scheduled to meet with Workers' Party federal deputies to try to reduce criticisms of the fiscal package.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/16/pt-da-camara-deve-apoiar-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-apesar-de-criticas-a-ajuste.ghtml) reported that the Workers' Party caucus in the Chamber of Deputies is expected to largely support President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's fiscal adjustment package despite criticisms.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10938696), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261116002952315) reported that South Korea's Supreme Court announced it will rule on former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo's insurrection case on Thursday, a day before his detention period expires.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/16/fim-da-escala-6x1-governo-deve-publicar-nesta-semana-decreto-com-regulamentacao.ghtml) reported that the government plans to publish a decree this week regulating the end of the 6x1 work scale following Justice Flávio Dino's provisional decision.

On 16 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/16/senado-deve-concluir-nesta-semana-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-que-seguira-para-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Senate is expected to conclude voting on the government's fiscal package this week before sending it to the Chamber of Deputies.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/14/fim-da-escala-6x1-fux-pede-para-julgara-no-plenario-fisico-decisao-de-dino-que-manteve-nova-jornada-a-partir-de-dezembro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court Justice Luiz Fux interrupted the judgment on Justice Flávio Dino's decision maintaining the 6x1 work scale, sending it to the physical plenary.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/14/fim-da-escala-6x1-dino-diz-que-negociacao-coletiva-e-melhor-caminho-para-transicao-da-nova-jornada.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court Justice Flávio Dino stated collective bargaining is the best path for transitioning to the new work schedule.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/14/stf-caminha-para-manter-fim-da-escala-6x1-em-16-de-dezembro-veja-como-ficam-folgas-e-salario-por-hora.ghtml) reported that the plenary of the Supreme Federal Court is moving to uphold the end of the 6x1 work scale on December 16.

On 14 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/14/ajuste-fiscal-de-lula-equilibra-contas-publicas-ou-so-adia-um-problema-maior-economistas-respondem.ghtml) reported that economists stated the fiscal adjustment measures sent by President Lula's government to Congress move in the correct direction but do not eliminate the need for a new package.

On 13 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7322164-camara-pede-que-stf-rejeite-parte-da-decisao-de-dino-sobre-a-6x1.html) reported that the Chamber of Deputies requested the Supreme Federal Court to reject part of Justice Flávio Dino's decision regarding the 6x1 work scale rules, along with actions filed by the National Confederation of Commerce and CNI.

On 13 Nov 2026, [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7321969-por-45-a-31-senado-aprova-texto-base-do-plp-de-ajuste-fiscal.html) reported that the Senate approved the base text of the fiscal adjustment complementary bill by 45 to 31.

On 13 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/13/com-ajuste-fiscal-aprovado-no-senado-empresas-vao-pagar-mais-imposto-especialistas-respondem.ghtml) reported that the approved fiscal adjustment bill is projected to have a positive effect of R$ 45 billion to R$ 56 billion on public accounts.

stories.title: Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy and industrial facilities

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186120-russia-strikes-energy-infrastructure-in-southern-odesa-region-causing-power-outages.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063508/) reported that Russian forces struck energy infrastructure in southern Odesa Region, causing power outages across two districts.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185876-more-than-80-settlements-without-electricity-in-rivne-region-following-russian-attack.html) reported that more than 80 settlements in Ukraine's Rivne region were left without electricity following a Russian attack.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185878-russian-forces-attack-industrial-infrastructure-in-zhytomyr-region.html) reported that Russian forces launched an overnight strike on industrial infrastructure in the Zhytomyr community.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063399/) reported that Russian attacks on November 17-18 caused power cuts in Rivne Oblast and a fire at an industrial facility in Zhytomyr Oblast.

On 18 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4185915-russian-attacks-cause-new-power-outages-in-eight-ukrainian-regions.html) reported that Russian attacks caused new power outages in eight Ukrainian regions as of Wednesday.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185482-russian-strike-cuts-power-to-more-than-300-settlements-in-rivne-region.html) reported that a Russian strike cut power to more than 300 settlements in the Rivne region.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063253/) reported that Russian attacks on November 17 caused power outages across nine Ukrainian oblasts with emergency cuts imposed in three others.

stories.title: Malaysia: Najib Razak House Arrest and Ministerial Resignation

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3374928/malaysias-pardons-board-minutes-expose-legal-rift-over-najibs-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's attorney general objected to former prime minister Najib Razak's house arrest on the grounds that it had no legal basis, though the king approved the arrangement.

On 18 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/najib-razak-house-arrest-declassified-minutes-attorney-general-hannah-yeoh-6561556) reported that Pardons Board minutes showed Malaysia's AG warned that Najib's house arrest could affect political stability and the country's image, and that Federal Territories Minister Hannah Yeoh also opposed the move.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/article/3374689/foreigners-lose-homes-thailand-malaysias-melaka-elections-7-asia-highlights) reported on seven selected stories from coverage of Asia over the past week, including foreigners losing homes in Thailand and Malaysia's Melaka elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-poll-results-analysis-malaysia-general-election-challenges-6552746) reported that a BN-PN alliance achieved a landslide victory in Melaka.

On 14 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-election-2026-bn-landslide-anwar-ph-pn-6551571) reported that the Barisan Nasional and Perikatan Nasional alliance won 24 seats in the Melaka polls.

On 15 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374453/malaysias-melaka-poll-shows-ethnic-lines-firming-can-anwar-turn-malay-nationalist-tide) reported that identity politics could decide the outcome of Malaysia's next national election.

On 14 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374416/malaysias-melaka-election-begins-anwars-ph-seeks-counter-resurgent-umno) reported that voters began casting ballots on Saturday morning to decide who will govern the southern Malaysian state of Melaka over the next five years.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-melaka-state-election-bn-pn-najib-razak-6545381) reported that former Prime Minister Najib Razak's conditional pardon sparked concerns over preferential treatment among some voters.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/former-malaysia-pm-najib-razak-house-arrest-sentence-6545056) reported that Najib Razak had submitted a written request for a second residence to be included in his house arrest arrangements, but this was not approved.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/malaysias-ex-pm-transferred-to-house-arrest-for-1mdb-graft-sentence?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak was transferred from prison to his Kuala Lumpur home for house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/former-malaysian-leader-najib-razak-returns-home-under-royal-pardon-but-faces-a-separate-15-year-prison-sentence/a-79913437?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Najib Razak returned home under a royal pardon but still faces a separate 15-year prison sentence.

On 11 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-najib-razak-house-arrest-anwar-ibrahim-umno-6542426) reported that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's anti-corruption agenda has taken a perceived hit despite him not having the final say in former premier Najib Razak's house arrest.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374042/taiwan-pauses-malaysia-investment-talks-after-anwar-remarks-spark-fury-taipei) reported that Malaysia is seeking to reassure Taiwanese investors that it remains a reliable destination for hi-tech manufacturing after Taipei suspended bilateral investment talks.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/10/malaysian-court-clears-former-pm-najib-razak-for-house-arrest-transfer?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Malaysian court cleared former PM Najib Razak for a house arrest transfer.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxORXB4UWVtZXBzZXM1eGhQa0tGX21hamxBcVpnR2lfMUUxV1dyc0RvdXZGQk9KSGxNQ2ZrNjJZSmJrcjNJSjVlZXRkZkVSUjk0NERGWTZSN3RzWFNYWENwdERHZDlQS1lRaF9PaG0tRmNfMW5yeGYyYzI3ZEx0d3Mxb25jeWlMQXF5SzNkdDNLZEl4N05JdmlGVjNBSWxLUms5OWNkYkUyUkNXVEl3cm9iOV84eG0wQlVodHhabkVLR0s0TFdsTTRMeFJR?oc=5) reported that a Malaysia court cleared the way for ex-PM Najib to start house arrest, according to Bernama.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/malaysian-court-clears-final-hurdle-for-former-pm-najib-razaks-transfer-to-house-arrest/article71686082.ece) reported that a Malaysian court cleared the final hurdle for former Prime Minister Najib Razak's transfer to house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-transport-minister-anthony-loke-resignation-take-effect-immediately-najib-house-arrest-6538901) reported that Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke's resignation takes effect immediately after the court granted Najib house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3373950/malaysia-court-clears-najib-begin-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's former prime minister Najib Razak arrived home after the High Court cleared the way for him to serve the remainder of his prison term under house arrest.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-ex-pm-najib-razak-released-prison-house-arrest-royal-pardon-6538231) reported that Najib Razak arrived home in Kuala Lumpur to serve the remainder of his jail term under house arrest after being released from Kajang Prison.
