reports.text: On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/eisenkot-netanyahu-must-leave-office/) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot demanded Benjamin Netanyahu's immediate departure and an investigation into allegations that his aides were involved in a school scheme.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-may-have-to-oust-security-chiefs-over-netanyahus-stolen-election-drive/000001a1-e623-d3ad-a5e3-e7fb6aa10000) reported that reports claimed the prime minister's office pushed allegations that Arab parties stole the vote and the Shin Bet chief sought to wiretap Joint List lawmakers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045063/israeli-leaders-slam-netanyahus-attempted-election-coup) reported that Israeli leaders criticized Benjamin Netanyahu over reports that his office tried to frame Arab-Israeli party members ahead of polls.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/is-israels-opposition-less-right-wing-than-netanyahu?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli government without Prime Minister Netanyahu may be close, but a government without his politics is far less certain.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/joint-list-calls-criminal-probe-netanyahu-after-expose) reported that the Joint List called for a criminal probe into caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following allegations of attempting to falsely incriminate Arab officials ahead of the election.

On 16 Nov 2026, [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/benjamin-netanyahu-gadi-eisenkot-call-for-investigation/107392590) reported that Gadi Eisenkot demanded an investigation into the Israeli Prime Minister's Office over election fraud claims.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-lapid-accuses-netanyahu-of-attempted-coup-through-targeting-arab-parties-in-israel/) reported that Israeli opposition figure Yair Lapid accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of seeking to stage an attempted coup by targeting Arab parties.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/israel-party-chiefs-say-netanyahus-election-fraud-claims-a-coup-attempt/) reported that party chiefs stated Netanyahu's election fraud claims were a coup attempt, while his Likud party denied the claims.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/netanyahu-allies-open-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-3725611), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-netanyahu-allies-open-door-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-report/) reported that associates of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Gadi Eisenkot's team that Likud would accept a unity government without Itamar Ben-Gvir's party.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/tibi-seeks-criminal-probe-of-netanyahu-over-alleged-election-interference-3725628) reported that Ahmad Tibi called for an immediate police probe into Netanyahu and his office following a Channel 12 investigation.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/16/eisenkot-calls-for-inquiry-into-alleged-netanyahu-role-in-election-day-arrests-of-arab-israeli-activists/), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-calls-for-probe-into-alleged-netanyahu-election-interference-3725614), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-eisenkot-says-netanyahu-threatens-democracy-pledges-probe-into-pms-office-role-in-election/) reported that opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot called for an inquiry into Benjamin Netanyahu's alleged role in election-day arrests of Arab Israeli activists.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/la-corrupcion-en-el-ine-morena-y-su-prisa-por-deslindarse-de-taddei/) reported that presidential approval in Mexico has suffered from wear according to Polls MX data.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/oposicion-israeli-pide-investigar-presunta-manipulacion-electoral-por-oficina-de-netanyahu-33152148), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/eisenkot-acuso-a-netanyahu-de-amenazar-la-democracia-y-pidio-investigar-una-presunta-maniobra-nid15112026/) reported that Israeli opposition figures, including Eisenkot, called for an investigation into alleged electoral manipulation by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office regarding the arrest of Arab activists during elections.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/pan-exige-investigar-presuntas-irregularidades-en-gestion-de-taddei-pide-un-ine-independiente-de-morena/) reported that the PAN party in Mexico presented a factual complaint to the FGR to investigate potential offenses related to public fund management under Taddei.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/oficina-netanyahu-planeo-detener-miembros-partidos-arabes-acusarlos-falsamente-fraude-electoral_202611166afabd97ea8d89799786fb0c.html) reported that a popular Israeli media outlet published information regarding a plan by Netanyahu's office to arrest Arab party members to falsely accuse them of electoral fraud.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-914926) reported that Naftali Bennett urged Gadi Eisenkot's bloc to pressure Haredi parties rather than beg them to join the government.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/netanyahu-ofrece-gobierno-unidad-iran-partidos-arabes-eisenkot-tacha-farol_202611146af8b8ccd3bddc0868b1f4c7.html) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot dismissed Benjamin Netanyahu's offer of a unity government without Arab parties as a bluff.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/netanyahu-pide-a-eisenkot-un-gobierno-de-unidad-ante-iran-que-excluya-a-los-arabes-llama-a-negociar-sin-condiciones/) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu asked Gadi Eisenkot to join a unity government that excludes Arab parties, while the opposition leader dismissed the offer as a bluff.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/mossad-chief-in-washington-as-israel-presses-trump-to-resume-iran-war-report-3725565) reported that Mossad Director Roman Gofman held talks with CIA Director John Ratcliffe in Washington.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/mossad-and-cia-discuss-iran-strategy-in-washington/), a state-run outlet, reported that representatives of Israeli and U.S. intelligence agencies met in Washington to evaluate scenarios regarding a new escalation against Iran.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/eisenkot-acusa-netanyahu-de-promover-racismo-contra-os-partidos-arabes.shtml) reported that Gadi Eisenkot accused Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu of promoting racism against Arab parties.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/eisenkot-accuses-netanyahu-of-racist-campaign-against-israels-arab-minority), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/14/eisenkot-accuses-netanyahu-of-racist-campaign-against-arab-israelis/) reported that prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot accused Benjamin Netanyahu of conducting a racist campaign against Israel's Arab minority.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640257/netanyahu-discusses-possible-resumption-of-attacks-on-iran-with-eisenkot-israeli-media), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/netanyahu-talks-possible-resumption-of-iran-attacks-with-eisenkot-israeli-media-3725556) reported that Israeli media outlets stated Benjamin Netanyahu discussed the possible resumption of attacks on Iran with Gadi Eisenkot.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640178/mossad-chief-visits-washington-as-israel-presses-trump-to-resume-iran-war-report) reported that Mossad chief Roman Gofman met with CIA Director Ratcliffe in Washington and is expected to hold talks with US envoy Witkoff in Miami.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/mossad-chief-visits-us-fears-grow-netanyahu-could-strike-iran-block-eisenkot) reported that Israeli opposition leaders fear Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could exploit the transition period to reignite the Iran conflict.

On 13 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217953), a Russian state outlet, reported that Mossad chief Gofman arrived in Washington for consultations on Iran and will meet with CIA Director John Ratcliffe.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/mossad-chief-meets-u-s-officials-to-discuss-iran-as-netanyahu-pushes-for-war/000001a1-d57c-da30-a7fb-ddfd4a810000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914818) reported that Mossad Director Gofman visited Washington, meeting the CIA director while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed to resume fighting against Iran.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eisenkot-netanyahus-campaign-against-arabs-is-racist-he-says/) reported that prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot accused caretaker Netanyahu of running a racist campaign against Arabs.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/israel-gadi-eisenkot-accuse-benyamin-netanyahou-de-mener-une-campagne-raciste-contre-la-minorite-arabe-20261113), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/13/israel-gadi-eisenkot-denonce-une-campagne-raciste-de-benyamin-netanyahou-contre-la-minorite-arabe_6809358_3210.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot accused Benjamin Netanyahu of conducting a racist campaign against the Arab minority.

On 13 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/world/middleeast/eisenkot-netanyahu-racism-arabs.html) reported that Eisenkot criticized Netanyahu days after the Israeli leader attacked Arab lawmakers in a speech.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-israels-eisenkot-denounces-racist-hostile-campaign-against-arab-citizens-cites-progress-in-coalition-talks/) reported that Eisenkot cited progress in coalition talks while denouncing the campaign.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914820) reported that Gadi Eisenkot backed MK Elisaf Peretz amid tensions over Arab party involvement in future coalitions.

reports.text: On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261116-should-ukraine-trade-donbas-for-nato-membership) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the United States asked him about a swap where Russia gets the Donbas and the rest of Ukraine gets NATO membership.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/zelenskyy-us-proposal-donbas-withdrawal-nato-membership/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated US negotiators raised the possibility of Ukraine withdrawing from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-volodymyr-zelensky-annonce-la-preparation-d-une-reunion-de-la-coalition-des-volontaires-qui-pourrait-s-averer-historique_6810982_3210.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced the preparation of a coalition of volunteers meeting to define the European position in future talks with Moscow.

On 15 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/russias-foreign-policy/2218325), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov stated that all participants in the Abu Dhabi talks viewed them positively, with the exception of Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218191), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Moscow believes staying out of EANA and other European forums serves the interests of Russian organizations.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-donbas-russia-war-map-frontline-update-b3085148.html) reported that fresh peace talks in Abu Dhabi failed to reach a meaningful breakthrough.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Burkina 24](https://burkina24.com/2026/11/15/guerre-en-ukraine-washington-evoque-le-donbass-en-echange-dune-adhesion-a-lotan-selon-zelensky/) reported according to Zelensky that Washington raised a possible withdrawal of Ukrainian forces from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/give-donbas-take-nato-seat-could-new-us-pitch-work-for-ukraine-russia?traffic_source=rss) reported that a US pitch involving Ukraine ceding Donbas to take a NATO seat is being considered.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/europe/us-floated-ukraine-ceding-donbas-nato-membership/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Kyiv would not concede territory but would put the question to a national referendum if Ukraine received security guarantees.
On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218183), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov took part in a conference on political affairs in Abu Dhabi.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218209), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian and UAE foreign ministers met in Abu Dhabi to discuss bilateral relations and Persian Gulf tensions.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/finland-rejects-reported-russian-demand-to-leave-nato-as-part-of-peace-talks/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Finnish Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen called the reported Russian demand for Finland to leave NATO outrageous.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90105) reported that Russia revived late-2021 security demands during peace talks with US envoys in Moscow, calling for NATO to withdraw troops to its 1997 borders.

On 14 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218103) reported that Russia’s permanent representative to the OSCE Dmitry Polyansky stated that Europeans came with old talking points and were mum on Abu Dhabi talks.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062819/) reported that a document presented by Russian officials during negotiations with US envoys in Abu Dhabi calls for NATO to return to its 1997 military positions.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640123/russia-demands-finland-leave-nato-in-abu-dhabi-talks-report), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/14/russia-demands-finland-leave-nato-bild-reports-moscow-denies-it-and-helsinki-is-outraged) reported that the German newspaper Bild stated Russia demanded Finland leave NATO during Abu Dhabi talks, while Moscow denied the report and Helsinki expressed outrage.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/us-suggested-ukraine-cede-parts-of-donbas-to-russia-to-become-part-of-nato?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-suggested-ukraine-cede-land-nato-zelensky-says) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the US suggested Ukraine cede parts of Donbas to Russia to join NATO.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-asked-ukraine-to-cede-donbas-in-exchange-for-nato-membership-zelensky-says-101794649702111.html) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky said he would put the question to a referendum if Ukraine received a comprehensive security package including security guarantees.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/14/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-les-dernieres-informations-au-14-novembre-2026_6808609_3210.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/flash-actu/guerre-en-ukraine-les-etats-unis-ont-propose-a-kiev-des-concessions-territoriales-en-echange-d-une-adhesion-a-l-otan-annonce-zelensky-20261114) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that the United States proposed territorial concessions to Ukraine in exchange for NATO membership.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261114-us-negotiators-suggest-ukraine-cedes-territory-in-exchange-for-nato-membership) reported that President Zelensky said the US had proposed ceding Ukraine's eastern city of Donbas to Russia in exchange for Ukrainian membership of NATO.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/us-floats-ukraine-ceding-land-to-russia-in-exchange-for-nato-membership-zelenskyy) reported that Putin has indicated Russia will not back down on territorial demands to control parts of Ukraine and has rejected the idea of foreign peacekeeping troops.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-proposes-ukraine-cede-territory-for-nato-membership-zelensky/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the US proposed Ukraine cede its Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership during recent peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/speciali/ansa-newsroom/2026/11/18/ansa-newsroom-fuori-tutti-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-caos-e-evacuazioni_732f890a-dda9-4cbc-9dca-a464e6d7c70b.html) reported that bomb alarms caused chaos and evacuations at schools.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915187) reported that more than 8,000 bomb hoaxes targeted schools, airlines, and media outlets across Europe, disrupting flights and classes.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxNN0Vsd0FkMFJLZl8zbklveDFFQW9XSEc3Q3dHMEZ6NjJFZ0dyYUIzOVdkam50a0lSYy00NEt5OGpCaG8wQTZ4RDlyTGVvaU1VMTlGNjk3aTdiZHVXcnloamEyTUZqbEhJWTlHbFJqTHNDWmVGN2JBT2FYTG44bWRIVXFfQ1E3LVdmeGRlczZETDFIUXlUSy04RXk0bDBlTHlIVm1ld2V3TnltenZZSXdBTm1ZV3NxUFVnTTRZWWRn?oc=5) reported that China seeks advanced Nvidia chips for AI weapons despite US curbs.
On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwq6e2qgvmlgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that new US rules restrict chip exports and access to their computing power.

On 17 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/business/southeast-asia-china-ai-chips.html) reported that new US restrictions could jeopardize billions in investment and force Southeast Asian countries to balance relations between Washington and China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/justicia-y-comercio-de-eeuu-investigan-a-megaspeed-por-venta-a-china-de-chips-restringidos_0_ihQtnQZ8QI.html) reported that the US Department of Justice and Commerce are investigating Megaspeed over the sale of restricted chips to China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-blocks-chinas-remote-access-to-ai-chips-after-nvidia-scandal-china-slams-move/article71711869.ece) reported that Nvidia's provision of chips to companies running data centres in Southeast Asia came under the spotlight amid questions surrounding founder Jensen Huang.

On 17 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmn504nq5033o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/us-investigates-singapore-firm-over-suspected-nvidia-chip-smuggling/) reported that the US government is investigating Nvidia partner Megaspeed over suspected export rule violations and shipments of high-end AI chips to China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/nvidia-warns-chip-buyers-of-legal-risks-china-ai-access-report-cnbc-artificial-intelligence-101794902005379.html) reported that Nvidia warned chip buyers of legal risks tied to China AI access, and noted that the RASA bill would give the US Commerce Department tools to stop Chinese firms from renting overseas data centers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640794/us-confirms-probing-megaspeed-over-chip-exports), [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-confirms-probing-singapore-based-firm-over-chip-exports/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-war/article/3374742/us-details-criminal-probe-nvidia-customer-megaspeed-over-potential-chip-diversion) reported that the US government confirmed an investigation into Singapore-based cloud firm and Nvidia customer Megaspeed over chip exports and potential diversion.
On 17 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915127) reported that US authorities began investigating Megaspeed in 2024 for suspected export violations.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-to-close-ai-chip-loophole-after-nvidia-scandal/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the United States announced tougher export controls on AI chips after a scandal involving Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/business/markets/us-chip-curbs-nvidia-uncertainty-weigh-on-asian-data-center-stocks), [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/17/tech/asia-data-center-chip-trump/) reported that Asian data center stocks and operators face pressure as U.S. chip curbs require government licenses to purchase advanced AI chips from Nvidia and other American manufacturers.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/technology/us-curb-china-access-ai-chips/) reported that the US Commerce Department worked to crack down on overseas data centers and chip smuggling to curb China's access to AI chips.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/17/us-moves-to-block-chinas-remote-access-to-ai-chips-amid-nvidia-scandal?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Trump administration introduced export licence requirements for Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore, and Brazil.

On 17 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/economics/article/3374665/singapore-seeks-us-talks-ai-chip-export-rules-amid-nvidia-fallout-megaspeed-probe) reported that Singapore has been engaging with the United States to explore ways to facilitate trusted access for local firms after a new measure was announced.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/singapore-seeks-trusted-access-to-ai-chips-after-new-us-curbs/article71710285.ece) reported that Singapore is at the center of controversy as cloud computing firm Megaspeed is suspected of helping Chinese firms circumvent US export controls.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-tightens-ai-chip-export-restrictions-ahead-of-trumps-visit-to-china-101794877777325.html) reported that the US tightening of AI chip export restrictions comes amid divisions within the Trump administration over regulating overseas sales of advanced American chips, especially those made by Nvidia.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/16/china-critical-minerals-latin-america/) reported that China's rare earth curbs have placed a new emphasis on Latin American investment.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxONGJmTGhQa3FRRDZtX3BqVk9SNlc1aHZ1QXZiUXdHMmlmZmdyUjFKS0hrREM1OFRrVDVjUGpSWnZfVTEtdlozVHVDc0h5Rld1cGVKQTFGYzVZOGJMdDNheWdEcFRhakxCVW1xcnQ3VHBzS2lRdWNPTGdtUkNxNVRnT1JUVzVKNzRXUlNuLUtBOVk2REZnZjMySER5NmhfNTliRjZsZ3B5TElrN0JU?oc=5) reported that the Trump administration moved to block China from indirect access to American AI technology.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/middle-east-allies-sign-us-ai-pact-nvidia-crisis-clouds-chip-race) reported that Israel, the UAE, and Qatar are deepening regional cooperation with Washington as the Trump administration seeks to blunt China's edge in technology.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNajk2S3gxMEdjVExKMzV3QmljQnVtYk1fN2Z2LUdldndlNjlkbVdrc2hhbnkzdFNtSFE0UzNUbjFYT1JQY2ZJRlpEalZXeW5XcDZCYW5NWjhCVUFqQldQTmg0ZUVfY1lYTHZnTHdNTTBqem12eC0zNE1NVVgyaVcxMi10WmdwVnlCUDNFY2ZRdnVrdURLTDctZTY2VkRLaWZ0d1A1VmFrd1pYbnl2NVhhV3Fn?oc=5), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/trump-compro-acciones-de-nvidia-antes-de-relajar-ventas-de-chips-a-china-segun-the-washington-post-previo-a-cambio-sobre-exportaciones/) reported that The Washington Post stated Donald Trump's stake in Nvidia grew to as much as $62 million prior to changes on chip exports.

On 16 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/us/politics/trump-china-ai-chip-loophole.html) reported that the Trump administration moved to close an AI chip loophole regarding sales to foreign data centers serving Chinese companies.

On 16 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3374639/us-tightens-ai-chip-export-curbs-close-chinas-overseas-data-centre-loophole) reported that the US Bureau of Industry and Security announced new restrictions on Chinese companies' remote access to advanced US artificial intelligence chips.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-administration-tightens-ai-chip-export-rules-to-restrict-chinas-access-to-nvidia-chips-101794844441729.html) reported that the Trump administration tightened AI chip export rules for five countries to prevent China from accessing advanced Nvidia chips through overseas data centres.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/eu-insta-a-nvidia-a-aclarar-si-eludio-restricciones-de-exportacion-de-chips-a-china-33148586), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/eeuu-insta-a-nvidia-a-aclarar-si-eludio-restricciones-de-exportaciones-de-chips-a-china_0_AE9CGxXJeX.html) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged Nvidia to clarify within 10 days whether it evaded export restrictions on chips to China and to answer regarding the internal investigation into Jensen Huang.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-lawmakers-push-tougher-ai-chip-export-curbs-on-china-after-nvidia-jensen-huang-scandal-101794757202582.html) reported that US lawmakers are pushing for tougher AI chip export curbs on China following the Nvidia scandal.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/companies/nvidia-crisis-scrutiny-agency/) reported that the US Congress is demanding answers about whether the Bureau of Industry and Security did enough to keep Nvidia's AI processors out of China's hands.

On 13 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/economy/global-economy/article/3374328/china-could-tighten-rare-earths-exports-if-us-escalates-chip-curbs-over-nvidia-analysts) reported that Chinese analysts stated China could retaliate with tighter rare earth export controls if Washington further restricts chip sales following the Nvidia saga.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-chinas-access-to-some-nvidia-chips-in-doubt-as-curbs-gain-traction-in-us/) reported that Chinese AI shares tumbled as investors worried that Jensen Huang's departure as Nvidia CEO could further restrict Chinese access to advanced US chips.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/world/china-access-nvidia-chips-doubt/) reported that China's access to advanced Nvidia chips is in doubt as curbs gain traction in the U.S. Congress.

stories.title: Paraguay ex-president moved to military jail amid special treatment reports
stories.label: Paraguay political and banking crisis

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-attorney-general-rolon-resigns/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay’s Attorney General Emiliano Rolon Fernandez resigned to stop an impeachment trial in the Chamber of Deputies.

On 17 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-moved-to-military-prison/), a state-media outlet, reported that a criminal guarantees judge ordered the immediate transfer of former president Santiago Peña to the Viñas Cué military prison in Asuncion.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/paraguay-ex-president-moved-to-military-jail-amid-special-treatment-reports?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was accused of corruption following the collapse of Ueno Bank earlier in the month.

On 17 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/santiago-pena-trasladado-carcel-militar-evitar-privilegios_1794875745) reported that Santiago Peña was transferred to a military jail to avoid privileges following an immediate transfer order by penal guarantee judge Osmar Legal.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-ex-president-pena-moved-vinas-cue-military-prison/) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña entered a military prison following a judge's transfer order in the Ueno Bank case.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/santiago-pena-ingresa-a-una-carcel-militar-en-paraguay-esposado-y-con-chaleco-antibalas-33164061) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was placed in preventive detention at a military prison.

On 16 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-escandalo-por-los-privilegios-de-santiago-pena-en-prision-fuerza-su-traslado-a-otra-carcel-nid16112026/) reported that the scandal over Santiago Peña's privileges in prison forced his transfer to another military jail in Paraguay.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/juez-en-paraguay-ordena-trasladar-al-expresidente-santiago-pena-a-carcel-militar-sera-recluido-en-la-prision-de-vinas-cue/) reported critics denounced alleged privileges granted to the former leader, including a gymnasium.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/entrega-jefe-juridico-banco-central-paraguay-investigado-caida-ueno-bank_1794790896) reported that Aldo Rodríguez, head of the legal department of the Central Bank of Paraguay, surrendered to a police station in Asunción after an arrest warrant was issued over an altered report in the Ueno Bank case.

On 15 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/asi-vive-la-principal-plaza-de-mercado-de-asuncion-la-crisis-financiera-por-la-caida-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-3600940) reported that sellers at Mercado 4 in Asunción stated sales have plummeted due to the Ueno Bank financial crisis.

On 14 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-caida-del-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-revela-el-avance-de-los-tecnomagnates-en-america-latina-nid14112026/) reported that the crisis of Paraguay's digital bank exposed links between technology entrepreneurs, governments, and far-right financing networks.

On 14 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

On 14 Nov 2026, [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

On 12 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

stories.title: Foreign Ministers of Oman, Iran and Uzbekistan Discuss Regional Developments
stories.label: Iran foreign minister international law remarks

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249509/Egypt-and-Oman-s-Foreign-Ministers-discuss-regional-de-escala), a state-media outlet, reported that Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and Omani counterpart Sayyid Badr Albusaidi discussed regional de-escalation.

On 17 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324848/Iran-Oman-and-Uzbekistan-discuss-maritime-freedom-and-transit), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249494/Iran-Oman-Uzbekistan-FMs-hold-trilateral-meeting-in-Muscat) reported that the foreign ministers of Iran, Oman, and Uzbekistan held a trilateral meeting in Muscat to discuss transit cooperation.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532269/Araghchi-meets-Sultan-of-Oman-in-Muscat-on-bilateral-ties-regional), a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi met with Sultan Haitham bin Tariq Al Said in Muscat.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249495/Araghchi-meets-Qatari-delegation-in-Muscat), a state-media outlet, reported that Abbas Araghchi met with a Qatari government delegation in Muscat.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582774/iranian-fm-meets-cdf-munir-over-regional-security/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir in Rawalpindi to discuss regional security.

On 17 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324340/Iran-Oman-FMs-meet-discuss-regional-developments) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Omani counterpart Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi met in Tehran to discuss bilateral ties and regional developments.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249470/Iran-China-discuss-regional-stability-cooperation) reported that Iran's deputy foreign minister for legal and international affairs discussed international developments, regional peace, and stability with China.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249475/Iran-Oman-FMs-discuss-regional-stability-in-Muscat) reported that the foreign ministers of Iran and Oman discussed bilateral relations and regional stability in Muscat.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323759/Araghchi-meets-Pakistan-s-Army-chief-to-discuss-regional-security), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249456/Araghchi-meets-Pakistan-s-Army-chief-to-discuss-reg-security) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with Pakistan Army Chief Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir to discuss regional security.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249454/ECO-FMs-support-Iran-s-initiative-to-permanently-end-war), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532222/ECO-Backs-Iran-Plan-to-End-Imposed-War) reported that the Council of Foreign Ministers of the Economic Cooperation Organization concluded in Islamabad with the adoption of support for Iran's initiative to end the war.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249453/Araghchi-and-Pakistani-counterpart-hold-talks-in-Islamabad), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323679/Iranian-and-Pakistani-foreign-ministers-hold-talks-in-Islamabad) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Pakistani counterpart Ishaq Dar held a bilateral meeting in Islamabad.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323628/Iran-Russia-FMs-hold-phone-talks-to-discuss-regional-developments), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249452/Araghchi-Lavrov-hold-call-to-discuss-regional-developments) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held a phone conversation to discuss regional developments.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323743/Araghchi-other-ECO-foreign-ministers-meet-Pakistani-PM), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249457/Araghchi-meets-with-Pakistani-PM-on-sidelines-of-ECO-meeting) reported that Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif held a joint meeting with the heads of delegations attending the 30th ECO Council of Ministers, including Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323837/Foreign-Minister-Araghchi-leaves-Islamabad-for-Tehran) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi departed Islamabad for Tehran after concluding the ECO meeting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323316/Iran-Pakistan-foreign-ministry-spokespersons-meet-in-Islamabad) reported that the foreign ministry spokespersons and foreign ministers of Iran and Pakistan met on the sidelines of the ECO summit in Islamabad.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323353/ECO-members-back-Iran-s-proposal-to-end-war-Foreign-Minister), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249448/ECO-members-throw-weights-behind-Iran-s-proposal-to-end-war) reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Economic Cooperation Organization member states backed Tehran's proposal to end the war.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-iran-committed-to-diplomacy-us-chose-different-path-foreign-minister-araghchi/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi stated Iran remains committed to diplomacy while the US chose a path of aggression and economic pressure.

On 15 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86322845/Araghchi-arrives-in-Islamabad-to-attend-ECO-summit), an Iranian state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi arrived in Islamabad at the head of a political-economic delegation to attend the 30th ECO summit.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249415/Iran-s-top-diplomat-to-travel-to-Pakistan-for-ECO-meeting), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/araghchi-travels-to-pakistan-to-attend-eco-meeting/), including a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi departed for Pakistan to attend the 30th Meeting of the ECO.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/araghchi-arrives-in-pakistan-set-to-visit-oman-on-tuesday/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Pakistan to participate in the 30th session of the Economic Cooperation Organization.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/iran-foreign-minister-abbas-aragchi-to-visit-muscat-hold-talks-with-omani-counterpart-101794748995709.html) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will hold talks with his Omani counterpart during a visit to Muscat on Tuesday.

On 15 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86322588/Araghchi-set-to-visit-Pakistan-and-Oman-Foreign-Ministry) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will visit Pakistan and Oman.
On 15 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-914945) reported that Iranian state news agency IRNA announced Araghchi's upcoming visit to Oman.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/iran-accuses-us-violating-international-law/) reported that Gholam-Hossein Darzi, Iran's representative to the United Nations, accused the United States of violating international law and the United Nations Charter.

On 13 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86320618/UN-Charter-under-fire-Why-US-attacks-on-Iran-violate-int-l-law), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/irans-foreign-minister-abbas-araghchi-accuses-us-and-israel-of-violating-international-law-in-attacks-101794597149372.html) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi accused the US and Israel of violating international law and breaking the UN Charter.

stories.title: Estonia to Close All Border Crossings With Russia After GRU-Linked Sabotage Attempt
stories.label: Estonia border closure and sabotage

reports.text: On 17 Nov 2026, [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185798-moldova-temporarily-closes-six-border-crossing-points-with-ukraine-following-russian-drone-attack.html) reported that Moldova temporarily closed six border crossing points with Ukraine following a Russian drone attack.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/estonia-s-president-urges-government-to-weigh-consequences-of-closing-russian-border) reported that Estonian President Ülle Madise urged the government to weigh the consequences of closing the border with Russia and avoid letting emotions drive the decision.

On 17 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261117-estonia-closes-its-border-with-russia-but-can-it-keep-moscow-out), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87486196) reported that Estonia will close border crossing points with Russia starting December 1 for national security reasons.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87330337) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia on December 1 and that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda warned Lithuania is not ruling out similar measures.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-estonia-to-close-russian-border-crossings-after-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/16/estonia-is-closing-its-border-with-russia-after-an-alleged-sabotage-attempt-and-preparing-to-move-government-services-to-the-cloud-in-case-of-invasion) reported that Estonia will close all border crossings with Russia starting December 1 following a suspected sabotage attack at Threod Systems.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063116/) reported that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda stated Lithuania may consider closing all border crossings with Russia if destabilisation efforts continue.

stories.title: Macron urges unity as Francophonie summit opens in Cambodia

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/bienvenue-a-phnom-penh-why-cambodias-francophonie-summit-matters/) reported that political divisions overshadowed the 20th Francophonie summit hosted in Cambodia.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261117-report-de-l-%C3%A9lection-du-secr%C3%A9taire-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-l-oif-des-n%C3%A9gociations-tendues-et-des-r%C3%A9formes-en-attente) reported that leaders of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie prolonged discussions and postponed the election of the secretary-general due to a lack of agreement.

On 17 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/cambodian-sins-overshadow-global-francophonie-summit-in-phnom-penh/) reported that French President Emmanuel Macron urged Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet to investigate the assassination of former Cambodian lawmaker Lim Kimya.

On 16 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-afrique-midi/20261116-report-de-l-%C3%A9lection-du-secr%C3%A9taire-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-l-oif-sur-le-fond-la-position-de-la-rdc-a-gagn%C3%A9) reported that regarding the postponement of the election of the secretary-general of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie, the position of the DR Congo has gained ground.

On 16 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-francophonie-summit-avoids-major-disaster-after-clash-over-leadership) reported that the Francophonie summit postponed the election of a new chief following a row between DR Congo and Rwanda.

On 16 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/dr-congo-rwanda-row-derails-francophone-summit-vote-6555176) reported that the DR Congo-Rwanda row derailed the vote for a new secretary general of the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie during talks in Phnom Penh.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/arts-et-culture/francophonie-lelection-du-secretaire-general-reportee-a-novembre-2027/) reported that the election of the secretary-general of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie was postponed to November 2027.

On 15 Nov 2026, [La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/15/a-phnom-penh-au-royaume-du-cambodge-la-tunisie-au-sommet-de-la-francophonie-aujourdhui/) reported that Dhia Khaled led the Tunisian delegation to the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/20e-sommet-de-la-francophonie-sur-fond-de-tensions-entre-kigali-et-kinshasa-une-gueguerre-qui-pourrait-couter-a-lafrique-le-poste-de-secretaire-general-de-linstitution/) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened on November 15, 2026, in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

On 15 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261115-tensions-and-economic-turbulence-in-cambodia-as-it-hosts-francophonie-summit) reported that the 20th Francophonie summit opened on November 15 in Phnom Penh amidst rising tensions with Thailand and declining tourism.

On 15 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261115-francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-overshadowed-by-tensions-in-africa) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, overshadowed by a leadership dispute.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-amid-rwanda-dr-congo-rift?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Francophone summit opened in Cambodia amidst a clash between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda over leadership.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/world/politics/francophone-summit-congo-rwanda/) reported that the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie summit opened with a Congo-Rwanda clash.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-leadership-as-francophone-summit-opens/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a summit of French-speaking nations opened amid a clash between DR Congo and Rwanda over the organization's leadership, with DR Congo threatening to quit.

On 14 Nov 2026, [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85895265), [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/phnom-penh-accueille-la-48e-conference-ministerielle-de-la-francophonie/) reported that Moldovan Prime Minister Vasile Tofan will attend the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-vote/) reported that DR Congo stated it will consider dropping its Francophonie candidate while Rwanda refused, and spokesman Patrick Muyaya responded ahead of the leadership vote.

On 14 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261114-dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-leadership-as-macron-seeks-compromise), [Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophone-top-job/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that DR Congo and Rwanda clashed over the leadership of the Francophonie.

stories.title: For a second day running, a merchant ship sinks off Bulgaria’s Black Sea coast
stories.label: Black Sea commercial ship drone strikes

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/lpg-tanker-that-sank-off-bulgaria-was-hit-by-projectiles-official/article71715541.ece) reported that an official stated the LPG tanker Gas Husky that sank off Bulgaria was hit by projectiles.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOU1RDM185endranZkZ1d1eF83NmxqSnNad2RzWGlrZU9UazRUaE83TlNpUjZ1SHowbURaWkpUSGJKeWhZQTFUV3c1NnNYSjNPaDlaaFFUaWdMN1BiOEpoMk5pYWtoN3ZhNTlnZzlpWmFpLXMtdDFlaWJFakRURVV4RFIta01EeWtMVDB2MHZEN3ljVWVWdUtEdVFZc3oyREFXMmZEWERUblo1VDg?oc=5) reported that a merchant ship sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast for a second consecutive day.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/19-people-rescued-after-gas-carrier-struck-in-black-sea) reported that 19 people were rescued after a gas carrier was struck in the Black Sea in an incident linked to Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/drones-have-hit-15-ships-in-natos-black-sea-waters-since-october/) reported that Russian drones have struck 15 merchant ships in the Black Sea off NATO members Romania and Bulgaria since October 5 according to a tally by The Defence Blog.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90372) reported that the cargo ship BETUL 8 sank in the Black Sea off Bulgaria after an attack by two naval drones, according to a Bulgarian maritime outlet.

On 17 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009860/lpg-tanker-reported-to-have-sunk-off-bulgaria-s-black-sea-coast/story/) reported that a liquefied petroleum gas tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast a few dozen miles from a previous incident, according to the country's defense ministry.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/second-tanker-in-two-days-sinks-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast-search-operation-under-way) reported that a second tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.

On 17 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/17/4980766_gazovoz_potuna_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska_zona_na/?ref=rss) reported that the tanker Gas Husky sank following a drone attack in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea.

On 17 Nov 2026, [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/leinster/2026/1117/1599491-vessel-wexford/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/17/six-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-vessel-ran-aground-off-coast-of-wexford/) reported that six crew members were rescued after an 88-metre cargo vessel ran aground off Roney Point on the Wexford coast.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast?traffic_source=rss) reported that all 12 crew members of a cargo ship that capsized off Bulgaria were rescued.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/cargo-ship-sinks-in-bulgarias-black-sea-after-reported-drone-attack-all-12-crew-rescued/) reported that authorities suspected a drone strike caused the vessel to capsize.

On 16 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/) reported that the ship was carrying 3,000 metric tons of wheat.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/16/4980351_turgovski_korab_potuva_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska/?ref=rss) reported that a merchant ship was sinking in the Bulgarian economic zone in the Black Sea near Kaliakra, according to the Ministry of Transport.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/sviat/voinata_v_ukraina/2026/11/15/4980175_dronove_udariha_tri_koraba_v_rumunski_vodi_v_cherno/?ref=rss) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial vessels in Romanian waters in the Black Sea near the Sulina canal.
On 15 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90153) reported that an unidentified drone attacked the Palau-flagged commercial vessel Larissa 1 inside Romanian territorial waters.
On 15 Nov 2026, [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90181) reported that Romanian Prime Minister Luca Niculescu condemned the drone attack on three commercial vessels near the Danube Delta.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/three-commercial-vessels-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-pm-says) reported that Romania's Prime Minister called the drone strikes on three commercial vessels near Romania's Black Sea unacceptable and a violation of international law.

On 15 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009606/3-ships-struck-by-drones-in-black-sea-near-romanian-shipping-canal/story/) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial ships in the Black Sea near Romania's Sulina canal and armed forces scrambled aircraft.

On 15 Nov 2026, [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/romanian-pm-condemns-unacceptable-drone-strikes-black-sea-ships/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/three-commercial-ships-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-coast-over-two-days/) reported that Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed the strikes on three commercial vessels near Constanța.

stories.title: US senator Chris Van Hollen to challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
stories.label: US Senate Majority Leader Leadership Challenge

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-senate-leadership-challenge-exposes-divisions-among-democrat) reported that incumbent minority leader Chuck Schumer is facing an insurgent leadership bid from Senator Chris Van Hollen as Democrats prepare to take control of the Senate.

On 16 Nov 2026, [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/16/nx-s1-6041687/chris-van-hollen-chuck-schumer-senate-leader) reported that US Senator Chris Van Hollen outlined his case for why he can defeat Chuck Schumer and change Senate Democratic leadership.

On 15 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/15/chris-van-hollen-senate-majority-leader) reported that progressive US Senator Chris Van Hollen stated he has a path to win the Senate leader post over Chuck Schumer.

On 15 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/us/politics/van-hollen-schumer-democrats-majority-leader.html) reported that Chris Van Hollen stated he has a wide-open path to unseat Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer.

On 14 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/14/world/politics/progressive-challenge-senate-schumer/) reported that a progressive challenge to Democratic Senate chief Schumer opened a fight for a bolder agenda.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/13/democrats-midterms-senate-leader) reported that Maryland senator Van Hollen's leadership challenge against Chuck Schumer could decide the direction of the Democratic party.

On 13 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmy4930jq749o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Maryland Senator Van Hollen stated new leadership is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/van-hollen-takes-on-schumer-as-democrats-split-over-israel/000001a1-d5d9-d59b-a1f3-dddd1c600000) reported that both progressives and moderates support Van Hollen's long-shot bid, bringing disputes over Israel and the Iran war into the leadership race.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/who-is-us-senator-chris-van-hollen?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Senator Chris Van Hollen is known for his antiwar positions and championing progressive causes as he seeks to lead Democrats.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-13/ty-article/israel-critic-van-hollen-to-challenge-schumer-for-u-s-senate-majority-leader/000001a1-d443-d59b-a1f3-dcd776dc0000) reported that Senator Chuck Schumer stated he has the votes to continue as the Democratic leader in the Senate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/van-hollen-schumer-senate-leader-b3084383.html) reported that Senator Van Hollen stated the American people called for change as he announced his challenge against Chuck Schumer.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/12/chris-van-hollen-chuck-schumer-senate-majority-leader), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/politics/van-hollen-schumer-democrats-majority-leader.html), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/us-senator-chris-van-hollen-to-challenge-chuck-schumer-for-senate-majority-leader) reported that Maryland Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen will challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-receives-largest-ever-lpg-shipment-of-15000-metric-tons-at-port-qasim/) reported that Pakistan received its largest-ever liquefied petroleum gas shipment of 15,000 metric tons at Port Qasim.

On 16 Nov 2026, [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640718/shehbaz-urges-collective-action-to-tackle-regional-security-threats) reported that Shehbaz Sharif urged collective action to tackle regional security threats and welcomed the adoption of the Islamabad Communique and Strategic Goals of Economic Cooperation 2026-2035.

On 16 Nov 2026, [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323911/FM-Araghchi-arrives-in-Muscat-for-talks), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249468/Araghchi-in-Muscat-for-talks-with-Omani-officials) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Muscat to hold talks with senior Omani officials on bilateral relations and regional matters after visiting Pakistan.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOWi1LV2I4TlpUM3MtenlKS3JLaENWR1BIVE8zLV8xNWQ4Y1g3dHJRLXE3bXNYTTlGbXJDcnJzUWFRclNBRDg0VzgwMFZITHdRMVg4UnphaXYwRjVvRlF4cmRWSjI2aXZLVTR3bTAxcW43RUJWUDNpM3NndndOUUFWSW9Id29lRGlMcy1idEh6Y1lHUHlZRW9lS05UcjJ1YVVUSmRJbFA0aTItb1R2alVwaS1XZG1sYXV3YjdiVG1B?oc=5) reported that ECO ministers called for stronger regional connectivity and resilient supply chains.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQM1d4OTVKckVwdzIwekRpQ0YySVpsSnlzeEJ3TUU5d25zTHhvWjAwaWZtWFRpMEMycDRGTGNhSW5wb0lMZ3BJOVczZmJxTVM0UnlyUDNLWC1LTXNPS3BLUGowajUzRjdQdDVpOUw3N1BGYkZUZy1udzZTRGc0UjlYOU03enNBMDdHWGxqTG14ZmgyZENLTjZ2QWY4V3FOcWcyd2xsUjBOUi0yOFVUaU9tX3lmazB5a3c?oc=5) reported that Pakistan urged ECO nations to strengthen regional security and economic ties.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Pakistan Today](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that Shehbaz vowed stronger ECO trade and connectivity as Pakistan hosted the meeting.

On 16 Nov 2026, [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249439/30th-ECO-Summit-kicks-off-in-Islamabad), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86322964/ECO-foreign-ministers-meeting-kicks-off-in-Islamabad-with-Iran-s) reported that the 30th meeting of foreign ministers of the Economic Cooperation Organization began in Islamabad with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in attendance.

reports.text: On 18 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-18/europa-pasa-de-inquietarse-por-las-libertades-en-ruanda-a-considerarlo-un-socio-fiable-donde-expulsar-a-migrantes.html) reported that five EU countries that previously questioned human rights conditions in Rwanda are preparing a migrant return center in Kigali.

On 17 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/vox-apoya-que-creen-centros-deportacion-ruanda-pide-desplegar-armada-defender-aguas-canarias_202611176afc509a103a0e0a474d8fad.html) reported that Spain's Vox party expressed support for creating a migrant return center in Rwanda.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-16/cinco-paises-europeos-crearan-en-ruanda-el-primer-centro-de-deportacion-fuera-de-la-ue.html), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/cinco-paises-da-ue-apresentam-projeto-para-criar-centro-para-migrantes-expulsos-em-ruanda.ghtml) reported that five European countries, including Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands, Greece, and Austria, reached an agreement to create the first migrant expulsion center outside the EU in Rwanda.

On 16 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/cinco-paises-europeos-presentan-un-polemico-proyecto-para-crear-un-centro-de-migrantes-expulsados-en-ruanda-pese-a-criticas-de-francia-y-oeneges-3601426) reported that the initiative is planned to begin in 2027 and has drawn criticism from France and non-governmental organizations.
